query: ¿Qué información personal necesito proporcionar para registrar a un beneficiario final en Qonto?
answer:
Para registrar a un beneficiario final en Qonto, necesitas proporcionar la siguiente información personal:

- Nombre
- Apellido
- Fecha de nacimiento
- Ciudad de nacimiento
- País de nacimiento
- Código postal de nacimiento
- País de residencia
- Nacionalidad

Además, se requiere una copia del documento de identidad del beneficiario final.

query: Can I use my Qonto card to set up my payment terminal for customer transactions?
answer:
No, you cannot use your Qonto card to set up your payment terminal for customer transactions. Qonto does not provide a direct debit card (or card of domiciliation), which is required to connect a payment terminal to a bank account. This type of card is typically used by merchants to process credit card payments, refunds, or cancellations.

However, Qonto has partnered with providers like Zettle, a leader in direct debit solutions for SMEs, to offer compatible services for your payment terminal needs. You can explore these partnerships for a suitable solution.

query: ¿Puedo usar mi tarjeta Qonto virtual en el móvil sin tener la tarjeta física?
answer:
Sí, puedes usar tu tarjeta Qonto virtual en tu móvil sin necesidad de tener la tarjeta física. Solo tienes que añadirla a Apple Wallet o Google Pay siguiendo estos pasos:

1. Ve a la sección "**Cuenta de la empresa**" y pulsa en "**Tarjetas**".
2. Selecciona la tarjeta virtual que deseas añadir.
3. Pulsa en "**Añadir a Apple Wallet**" o "**Añadir a Google Pay**" y sigue las instrucciones que aparezcan en pantalla.

Una vez añadida, podrás usar tu tarjeta virtual directamente desde tu móvil para realizar pagos de forma segura y rápida.

query: Kann eine Überweisung einfach so zurückgenommen werden, auch wenn das Geld schon auf meinem Konto ist?
answer:
Eine Überweisung kann nicht einfach so zurückgenommen werden, selbst wenn das Geld bereits auf Ihrem Konto gutgeschrieben wurde. Gemäß dem SEPA-Standard kann die Senderbank jedoch unter bestimmten Bedingungen einen Rückruf beantragen, beispielsweise wenn ein falscher Betrag oder eine falsche IBAN angegeben wurde oder die Überweisung versehentlich mehrmals ausgeführt wurde.

In einem solchen Fall prüft unser Team die Situation sorgfältig, und jeder Rückruf muss von einem Qonto-Kontoverwalter bestätigt werden, bevor er ausgeführt wird. Ohne diese Validierung wird die Überweisung nicht storniert. Bei Verdacht auf Betrug analysiert unser Team die Situation zusätzlich, bevor eine Stornierung genehmigt wird.

query: How do I get my IBAN in a different language?
answer:
You can download your account details, including your IBAN, in a different language (French, English, Spanish, Italian, or German) directly from the Qonto web app. Here’s how:

1. Go to the **"Business account"** section, then click on **"Transactions"**.
2. Click on the **"Account details"** button.
3. Select **"Download (PDF)"** and choose your preferred language from the available options.

This feature is currently only available on the web app. If you need your IBAN in a language not listed or require further assistance, you can contact our customer support via the chat bubble in the app or email us at [support@qonto.com](mailto:support@qonto.com).

query: Do I need to include my insurance details on every quote I send?
answer:
Whether you need to include your professional liability insurance details on every quote depends on your profession and local regulations. Some professionals are legally required to indicate their professional liability insurance on quotes, while others may not have this obligation. To ensure compliance, check the specific requirements for your country and profession.

You can find country-specific guidelines for [France](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947608620305) and [Italy](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947608620305) if applicable. If you're unsure, it's always best to include this information to maintain transparency and professionalism. You can easily add it in the **Additional notes** section when creating your quote.

query: Can I use emojis when naming my Qonto card?
answer: Yes, you can use emojis when naming your Qonto card! This feature allows you to add a fun and visual touch to your card names, making them even easier to identify. For example, you could name a travel card "✈️ Travel" or a marketing card "📢 Google Ads." Simply edit the card name in the app and include your preferred emojis.

query: What happens if I try to make a payment but don’t have enough money in my Qonto account?
answer:
If you try to make a payment but don’t have enough money in your Qonto account, the payment will be declined because your account cannot be overdrawn. Qonto always checks your balance before authorizing any transaction, so if your balance is insufficient, the payment—whether it's a card payment, transfer, or direct debit—will not go through.

Additionally, if your balance is too low to cover scheduled payments for the next 14 days, you’ll receive an alert. To resume making payments, you’ll need to top up your account. If your company is eligible, you may also consider using Qonto’s **Pay later** feature or exploring financing options available in the **Financing** section of the Qonto app.

query: What should I do if the support chat doesn't resolve my issue with Qonto?
answer:
If the support chat doesn't resolve your issue with Qonto, you can escalate your concern by filing a formal complaint. You have two options to do this:

1. **Online:** Send your complaint to [claims@qonto.com](mailto:claims@qonto.com).
2. **By post:** Send a registered letter with acknowledgment of receipt to:
   Qonto, Service Réclamations, 18 Rue de Navarin, 75009 Paris.

You will receive an acknowledgment of receipt within 5 business days. Your complaint will be processed as soon as possible, typically within 15 working days, though this may extend to 35 working days in exceptional cases involving the Legal team.

query: ¿Por qué no me llega el código de verificación si tengo WhatsApp instalado?
answer:
Si tienes WhatsApp instalado pero no recibes el código de verificación, sigue estos pasos para resolver el problema:

1. **Verifica tu cobertura**: Asegúrate de que tu teléfono tiene señal móvil.
2. **Doble SIM**: Si tu teléfono tiene dos tarjetas SIM, retira la que no está registrada en Qonto.
3. **Desactiva el roaming**: Si lo tienes activado, desactívalo, ya que puede interferir con la recepción del SMS.
4. **Ajusta la hora**: Confirma que la hora de tu teléfono coincide con la hora local de España si estás en el país.
5. **Reinicia tu teléfono**: A veces, un simple reinicio puede solucionar el problema.
6. **Bloqueo internacional**: Si estás fuera de tu país de residencia, contacta a tu operadora telefónica, ya que podría haber un bloqueo en la recepción de SMS.

Si después de seguir estos pasos el problema persiste, te recomendamos [contactar con nuestro equipo de soporte](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/es/articles/23951055377041-Si-necesito-ayuda-puedo-contactar-con-soporte) para obtener ayuda adicional.

query: Why does the purple line on the cash flow graph sometimes go below zero?
answer: The purple line on the cash flow graph represents your account balance over time. It can temporarily fall below zero when your outflows (expenses) exceed your inflows (revenue) within a given month. This indicates that you spent more money than you received during that period, resulting in a negative balance. The dotted line for the current month shows that the data is still being updated as transactions occur. This is a normal occurrence and helps you visualize months where expenses outweigh income.

query: Puis-je faire un virement depuis mon compte Lydia pour déposer mon apport en capital ?
answer: Non, les virements depuis un compte Lydia ne sont pas acceptés pour le dépôt de capital. Seuls les virements bancaires classiques (SEPA, SEPA Instantané ou SWIFT, sous conditions) sont autorisés. Les services de paiement électronique comme Lydia, PayPal ou Western Union ne sont pas compatibles avec cette procédure.

query: ¿Puedo cambiar el idioma de un presupuesto si mi cliente es extranjero?
answer:
Sí, puedes cambiar el idioma de un presupuesto si tu cliente es extranjero. Al crear o editar un presupuesto en Qonto, tienes la opción de seleccionar el idioma en el que se emitirá el documento. Puedes elegir entre inglés, francés, español, italiano y alemán.

Para hacerlo, al añadir la información del cliente, selecciona el idioma deseado en los ajustes del presupuesto. Esto es especialmente útil si tu cliente no habla el idioma del país donde está registrada tu empresa.

*Nota:* Si tu cliente está registrado en Francia, te recomendamos elegir el francés para cumplir con la normativa local sobre el idioma de los documentos.

query: Est-ce que je peux ouvrir un compte pour mon association même si elle n’a pas encore de numéro SIRET ?
answer: Non, Qonto n'accepte pas l'ouverture d'un compte pour une association qui ne possède pas encore de numéro SIREN ou SIRET. Ce numéro est obligatoire pour pouvoir créer un compte professionnel avec nous. Vous devrez donc obtenir ce numéro avant de pouvoir procéder à l'ouverture de votre compte.

query: ¿Puedo acceder a la sección de Financiación desde la app móvil de Qonto?
answer: No, la sección de Financiación solo está disponible a través de la **aplicación web** de Qonto, no en la app móvil. Para acceder, debes ser **Titular** de la cuenta o un **Admin** que sea director corporativo o socio mayoritario (UBO).

query: Posso invitare tutti i miei dipendenti in una volta sola tramite l'integrazione con la piattaforma HR?
answer: No, l'integrazione con la piattaforma HR non consente di effettuare inviti in gruppo. Dovrai selezionare manualmente ciascun dipendente affinché le sue informazioni vengano sincronizzate con il tuo conto Qonto. Tuttavia, questo processo semplifica l'onboarding, poiché non dovrai inserire manualmente tutte le informazioni dei dipendenti. Una volta aggiornata la lista, potrai attribuire un ruolo a ciascun membro individualmente dalla sezione *Gestione utenti*.

query: Est-ce que je dois payer quelque chose pour obtenir la carte X Métal avec l'offre promotionnelle ?
answer: Avec l'offre promotionnelle, la carte X Métal est gratuite pendant 3 mois. Vous ne paierez rien pour la carte durant cette période. Après ces 3 mois, la carte sera automatiquement facturée au tarif standard de 20 € HT par mois. Pour en profiter, il suffit d'utiliser le code promotionnel **XCARD3M** lors de l'ouverture de votre compte Qonto.

query: ¿Puedo hacer transferencias automáticas a mis proveedores con Zapier sin tener que confirmarlas cada vez en el móvil?
answer: Sí, puedes automatizar transferencias a tus proveedores con Zapier sin tener que confirmarlas manualmente cada vez en el móvil. Para ello, debes marcar previamente a tus beneficiarios como "de confianza" en Qonto. Esto evita que se active la autenticación reforzada (SCA) en cada transferencia. Puedes hacerlo siguiendo los pasos en [esta página](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/es/articles/23950947963793--C%C3%B3mo-puedo-marcar-a-un-beneficiario-como-de-confianza) o directamente desde la [API de Qonto](https://api-doc.qonto.com/docs/business-api/b3A6MjMyNzk4NTc-trust-a-list-of-beneficiaries). Una vez configurado, las transferencias a esos beneficiarios se realizarán automáticamente sin necesidad de validación adicional.

query: What do I do if I forgot to attach a receipt to my transfer?
answer:
You can easily add a receipt to your transfer even after creating it. Here’s how:

For **processed or processing transfers**:
1. Go to the **Business account** section in your Qonto account.
2. Click on the **Transactions** tab.
3. Select the transfer you want to update.
4. Upload the proof of payment.

For **scheduled transfers** (before they switch to "processing" status):
1. Go to the **Transfer** section in your Qonto account.
2. Select the transfer and click on **Edit**.
3. Upload the proof of payment.

Make sure the document is clear and readable. If you encounter any issues, contact us via the chat for assistance.

query: What happens if someone steals my card and makes purchases with it?
answer:
If your card is stolen and used for fraudulent purchases, you are covered by Qonto's fraud and phishing insurance. This protection applies to unauthorized transactions made with your physical card. There is no excess for this coverage, but the maximum benefit is limited to €3,000 per year per cardholder.

To ensure your protection, you must immediately report the theft to Qonto to block the card and secure your account. Follow Qonto's instructions, which may include changing your credentials, and file a report with the police. This will help resolve the issue and prevent further unauthorized transactions.

query: Can I send money to a freelancer in India using Qonto, and how long will it take?
answer:
Yes, you can send money to a freelancer in India using Qonto. Since freelancers are considered professionals, you can transfer funds to their account as long as you provide a contractual agreement highlighting the payment purpose.

To send money to India, you will need the following details:
- Beneficiary's full name
- Account number (minimum 5 digits, maximum 20 digits)
- IFSC code (11 characters, usually starting with 4 letters)
- Transfer purpose (required)
- Reference (up to 16 characters)

The transfer will typically take **up to 90 minutes on working days** if sent via a local bank transfer. If you use UPI, the transfer will be **instant**.

Ensure the transfer is submitted during market open hours, as banks do not process transfers on weekends or Indian bank holidays. The exact receiving time will be indicated on your app before you confirm the transfer.

query: What should I do if a SEPA Direct Debit from my Qonto account is incorrect or unauthorized?
answer:
If a SEPA Direct Debit from your Qonto account is incorrect or unauthorized, you can dispute it. For **SEPA Core Direct Debits**, you have the right to request a refund within 8 weeks of the debit date without providing a reason. If the debit was unauthorized, you can dispute it within 13 months. To do this, contact Qonto support or use the dispute option in your account.

For **SEPA Direct Debits B2B**, the process is different as these mandates require prior authorization. If you believe a B2B debit is incorrect, you should first verify the mandate details with the creditor and ensure the correct information was uploaded to your Qonto account. If the debit is still unauthorized, contact Qonto support for assistance.

You can find more details on disputing a SEPA Core Direct Debit [here](https://qonto9015-de.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949254140945).

query: How do I apply for a job at your company?
answer: To apply for a job at our company, visit our [job board](https://qonto.eu/en/careers) to explore available opportunities. If you find a position that matches your profile, you can apply directly online. We’re excited to review your application and look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team!

query: Pourquoi mon virement en devise étrangère prend-il plus de temps que prévu ?
answer:
Les délais de réception indiqués pour les virements en devise étrangère ne s'appliquent que pour les **jours ouvrés**. Plusieurs facteurs peuvent expliquer un retard :

1. **Jours fériés et week-ends** : Les banques ne traitent pas les transactions pendant ces périodes, ce qui peut prolonger le délai.
2. **Vérifications préalables** : Certaines transactions nécessitent des contrôles supplémentaires, ce qui peut allonger le temps de traitement. Nous faisons de notre mieux pour les traiter rapidement et vous contacterons si des informations complémentaires sont nécessaires.
3. **Réglementations locales** : Certaines devises ou pays imposent des règles spécifiques qui peuvent ralentir le processus.

Pour suivre l'état de votre virement, consultez l'article [Quels sont les différents statuts d’un virement sortant ?](https://help.qonto.com/fr/articles/4359575-quels-sont-les-differents-statuts-d-un-virement-sortant). Si le retard persiste, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre support directement depuis votre compte Qonto.

query: Wie kann ich sehen, wie viel Geld ich aktuell auf meinem Konto habe?
answer: Sie können Ihren aktuellen Kontostand direkt in der Qonto Web-App einsehen, indem Sie im Menü auf **Cashflow-Steuerung** klicken. In der mobilen App finden Sie diese Information unter "Mehr" (unten rechts) und dann im "Dashboard". Dort wird Ihnen der verfügbare Kontostand angezeigt, also das Geld, das Ihnen aktuell zur Verfügung steht.

query: What happens to my old card after I upgrade to a new one?
answer: After you upgrade to a new card, your old card will remain active for **1 month** from the date of the upgrade. For example, if you upgrade on June 14, your old card will automatically be deactivated on July 14. During this period, both cards will work, but the old card will display a mention indicating the date it will be deleted. You won’t be charged for the new card until the old one is deactivated. The new card will be active immediately for online and physical payments, and you can use the same PIN as your old card.

query: Combien de temps faut-il pour recevoir le certificat de dépôt après avoir signé la demande ?
answer: Après avoir signé votre demande de dépôt, vous recevrez votre certificat de dépôt sous 12 heures ouvrées pour la version numérique, envoyée par email. La version papier vous sera envoyée par voie postale sous 7 jours ouvrés. Ces délais commencent à compter de la réception de votre capital social par le notaire.

query: What happens if I dispute a transaction but the merchant doesn’t respond within the 7-day period?
answer: If the merchant does not respond within the 7-day period after you've contacted them about a commercial dispute, you can proceed to file a claim for the transaction directly through your app. The merchant's lack of response allows you to escalate the dispute for further resolution.

query: Can I transfer the share capital to my personal account before setting up the SRL?
answer: Yes, you can transfer the share capital to your personal account before setting up the SRL, provided that the transfer is non-revocable and complies with the requirements of Art. 2464 of the Italian Civil Code. The funds must either be credited to your account at the time of signing the deed of incorporation or, if not yet credited, the transfer must be irrevocable by the payer. This method is legally valid in Italy for the incorporation of an SRL or SRLS. For further details, you can refer to the guidelines provided by the Milan Notary Council.

query: Can I create a deposit invoice from a quote that hasn't been approved yet?
answer: No, you cannot create a deposit invoice from a quote that hasn't been approved yet. Only approved quotes can be converted into deposit invoices. To proceed, you'll need to ensure the quote is approved first.

query: ¿Puedo usar un archivo de Excel para hacer transferencias masivas a mis empleados?
answer: Sí, puedes usar un archivo de Excel para hacer transferencias masivas a tus empleados. Para ello, debes guardar el archivo en formato .CSV, que es compatible con Qonto. Puedes crear el archivo siguiendo el modelo proporcionado en la *app* o al final del artículo de soporte. Una vez completado, súbelo a la *app* y sigue los pasos para programar las transferencias. Además, si deseas que las transferencias se identifiquen como "nómina" en el banco receptor, asegúrate de seleccionar la categoría "Salarios" al ejecutarlas.

query: Perché nel grafico delle uscite vedo solo sei categorie e una settima generica, invece di tutte le mie spese?
answer:
I grafici "Entrate per" e "Uscite per" visualizzano fino a sette elementi, che rappresentano i più significativi della categoria selezionata. Se hai più di sette categorie di spese, il grafico ne mostrerà sei con i dettagli specifici e una settima categoria generica che raggruppa tutte le altre. Questo ti permette di avere una visione chiara delle spese più rilevanti, mantenendo il grafico leggibile e ordinato.

Per vedere i dettagli della categoria generica, puoi posizionare il mouse sulla sezione corrispondente dell'anello: apparirà un inserto con informazioni aggiuntive, come la percentuale, il numero di transazioni e l'importo totale. Se desideri analizzare ulteriormente le tue spese, puoi utilizzare i filtri avanzati o i tag personalizzati per suddividere i dati in modo più specifico.

query: Kann ich ein Angebot in einer anderen Sprache als Deutsch erstellen?
answer: Ja, Sie können ein Angebot in einer anderen Sprache als Deutsch erstellen. Qonto unterstützt die Erstellung von Angeboten in Englisch, Französisch, Spanisch, Italienisch und Deutsch. Wenn Ihr Kunde oder Ihre Kundin die Sprache des Landes, in dem Ihr Unternehmen registriert ist, nicht spricht, können Sie die gewünschte Sprache beim Hinzufügen der Kundeninformationen auswählen. Dies gilt auch für die Währung, die Sie für das Angebot festlegen können, falls diese nicht auf Euro lautet.

query: How long does it take for a transfer to my Qonto account to go through?
answer:
The time it takes for a transfer to your Qonto account depends on the type of transfer:

- **SEPA transfers** (within the SEPA zone) typically take **1 business day** for standard transfers and are **instant** for SEPA Instant transfers.
- **Transfers from outside the SEPA zone** (via SWIFT) usually take **1 to 5 business days**, depending on the sending bank and intermediary banks involved.

You can check the status of your transfer in your Qonto account under the **Transactions** section.

query: Can I edit the items on a credit note after creating it?
answer: No, you cannot edit the items on a credit note after it has been created. Once a credit note is generated, it cannot be modified or canceled. If you need to adjust the amount, you will have to create a new credit note for the correct amount. For example, if you issued a credit note with a lower amount by mistake, you can create a second one to cover the difference. Always review the details carefully before finalizing the credit note.

query: Warum haben die Gründer von Qonto sich entschieden, eine eigene Banklösung zu entwickeln?
answer:
Die Gründer von Qonto, Alex und Steve, haben sich entschieden, eine eigene Banklösung zu entwickeln, weil sie mit ihrer bisherigen Bankerfahrung bei der Gründung ihres ersten Startups frustriert waren. Sie fanden traditionelle Banken zeitaufwändig, undurchsichtig und nicht auf die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmern zugeschnitten.

Ihr Ziel war es, eine Lösung zu schaffen, die speziell für KMU und Startups konzipiert ist – vollständig online, einfach zu verwalten und mit effizienten Tools zur Finanzverwaltung. Qonto soll das Bankgeschäft für Unternehmer neu erfinden, indem es eine schnelle Kontoeröffnung, transparente Prozesse und exzellente Kundenbetreuung bietet.

query: Wie oft kann ich Rechnungsdaten mit dem DATEV Rechnungsdatenservice an DATEV übertragen?
answer: Mit dem DATEV Rechnungsdatenservice 1.0 können Rechnungsdaten nur einmalig an DATEV übertragen werden. Dies ist eine wichtige Einschränkung des Dienstes. Wenn Sie weitere Rechnungen übertragen möchten, müssen Sie den Exportprozess für neue Belege im nächsten Zeitraum aktualisieren und erneut durchführen.

query: What should I do if my recipient's name is in Latin letters but their bank requires katakana?
answer: If your recipient's name is in Latin letters but their bank requires katakana, you must convert the name to katakana before entering it into the transfer details. This is crucial because a mismatch in the name format can lead to delays or rejection of the transfer. You can use online tools or consult with the recipient to ensure the correct katakana spelling of their name. For example, if the name is "John Smith," it should be written in katakana as "ジョン・スミス." Always double-check with the recipient to confirm the exact spelling their bank uses.

query: Can I send an instant transfer to a friend in Spain on a Sunday?
answer: Yes, you can send an instant transfer to a friend in Spain on a Sunday. Instant transfers work every day, including weekends and holidays, as long as the transfer is within the SEPA zone (which includes Spain) and does not exceed €100,000. The funds will typically arrive in your friend's account within seconds. At Qonto, instant transfers are free of charge, depending on your plan.

query: Can I create an invoice in a different currency than euros?
answer: Yes, you can create an invoice in a different currency than euros. When setting up your invoice, you have the option to choose a different currency for the customer's quote and invoices if needed. This allows you to issue invoices in various currencies based on your client's requirements.

query: Est-ce que je dois vérifier les montants de TVA détectés automatiquement avant de les valider ?
answer: Oui, vous devez toujours vérifier les montants de TVA détectés automatiquement avant de les valider. Bien que l'algorithme de Qonto soit très fiable, cette étape de confirmation vous permet d'éviter toute erreur comptable en cas de détection incorrecte. Les informations de TVA ne seront pas exportées dans vos outils comptables ou vos fichiers CSV tant qu'elles n'ont pas été confirmées par vos soins. Vous conservez également la possibilité de modifier manuellement les taux de TVA si nécessaire.

query: Si j’ai plus d’argent sur mon compte que de dettes à payer rapidement, est-ce que mon entreprise va bien ?
answer: Oui, si les disponibilités de votre entreprise (argent en caisse, sur le compte bancaire et valeurs mobilières de placement) sont supérieures aux dettes à court terme (salaires, fournisseurs, charges sociales, etc.), cela signifie que votre trésorerie nette est positive. Votre entreprise est donc en bonne santé financière, car elle peut couvrir ses obligations immédiates sans avoir besoin de financements externes. Cela indique une situation saine et une capacité à faire face aux dépenses courantes.

query: Kann ich eine Lastschrift auch nachträglich wieder aktivieren, wenn ich sie versehentlich ausgesetzt habe?
answer: Ja, Sie können eine ausgesetzte Lastschrift nachträglich wieder aktivieren. In der Qonto Web App oder der mobilen Anwendung können Sie das betreffende Mandat auswählen und die Option zur Reaktivierung nutzen. In der Web App finden Sie diese Funktion unter **Geschäftskonto > Lastschriften**, indem Sie die entsprechende Lastschrift auswählen und die Reaktivierung bestätigen. In der mobilen App können Sie dies über die E-Mail-Benachrichtigung oder den Umsätze-Bereich tun, indem Sie auf eine frühere Lastschrift klicken und das Mandat erneut aktivieren.

query: Cosa succede se rifiuto una richiesta di bonifico senza lasciare un commento?
answer: Se rifiuti una richiesta di bonifico senza lasciare un commento, la transazione verrà semplicemente respinta e non verrà elaborata. Tuttavia, per una migliore comunicazione con il tuo team, è consigliabile aggiungere un commento per spiegare il motivo del rifiuto, in modo che il collaboratore possa comprendere la decisione e, se necessario, apportare modifiche o fornire ulteriori dettagli.

query: Se invito un'azienda che ha già un conto Qonto, posso comunque ricevere il premio?
answer: No, non puoi ricevere il premio se inviti un'azienda che ha già un conto Qonto. Il programma referral prevede che l'azienda invitata non abbia ancora un conto aperto con Qonto. Affinché il referral vada a buon fine, è necessario che il nuovo cliente si registri tramite il tuo link dedicato e apra un conto per la prima volta. Se il conto viene aperto direttamente tramite il sito senza utilizzare il link o se l'azienda è già cliente Qonto, non verrà accreditata nessuna ricompensa.

query: Do I need to manually calculate the reimbursement amount for mileage expenses, or is it done automatically?
answer: The reimbursement amount for mileage expenses is calculated automatically based on the pre-defined rates in Qonto’s system, using the location and vehicle details provided by the requester. You do not need to manually calculate or edit the amount.

query: Can I open separate accounts for different branches of my company with Qonto?
answer: At Qonto, each company can only have one account, as we base our system on the SIREN number (9 digits), which uniquely identifies your organization. However, you can use our [multiple accounts feature](https://qonto9015-es.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/23950983707409) to create sub-accounts with dedicated IBANs, account statements, and payment methods tailored to each branch or department. This allows you to manage different branches within a single Qonto account while maintaining separate financial tracking for each.

query: Can I submit an invoice that’s only a photo from my phone if it’s clear enough?
answer: Yes, you can submit an invoice that’s a photo from your phone as long as it is clear and all the required information is readable. However, we recommend using a PDF file instead of a photo (PNG/JPG) to ensure better quality and detection of the details. If you do submit a photo, make sure it is not blurry, the text is legible, and the file size is less than 15 MB. Handwritten invoices may still be rejected due to difficulties in data detection.

query: Can my client sign the quote without creating a Qonto account?
answer: Yes, your client can sign the quote without creating a Qonto account. They only need the secure email link sent to them, and they can sign with just one click. No additional software, registration, or complex identity verification is required. The process is designed to be quick and hassle-free for your client.

query: Can I add notes or extra details to a transaction in the new view?
answer: Yes, you can add notes or extra details to a transaction in the new **Transaction** view. Use the **Comments** column to add additional information by clicking the bubble icon next to the transaction. The "Additional Information" field from the previous view is still available in the sidebar if you need more space for details. This makes it easy to attach notes or context directly within the transaction list.

query: Comment puis-je connecter mon compte Qonto à Slack ?
answer:
Pour connecter votre compte Qonto à Slack, rendez-vous dans la section **Intégrations et Partenariats** accessible via **Paramètres** en bas à gauche de votre application web Qonto. Vous y trouverez l'intégration dédiée à Slack, spécialement développée par Qonto pour faciliter votre gestion financière. Suivez simplement les instructions d'installation pour lier les deux applications et automatiser vos notifications ou flux de travail.

Cette intégration vous permet de gagner du temps en centralisant vos informations financières directement dans Slack.

query: Kann ich die Einstellungen meines Dashboards auf meinem Handy und Computer unterschiedlich speichern?
answer: Ja, die Anzeigeoptionen, die Sie für Ihr Dashboard auswählen, werden auf jedem Endgerät separat gespeichert. Das bedeutet, dass die Einstellungen auf Ihrem Handy unabhängig von denen auf Ihrem Computer sind. Wenn Sie beispielsweise den Zeitraum eines Diagramms auf Ihrem Computer ändern, bleibt diese Einstellung nur auf diesem Gerät erhalten. Beim nächsten Login auf Ihrem Handy werden Sie die zuvor auf dem Handy gewählten Einstellungen vorfinden. Diese Geräteunabhängigkeit gilt auch für verschiedene Organisationen, falls Sie Zugriff auf mehrere Konten haben.

query: Kann ich eine Überweisungsanfrage auch ablehnen und warum?
answer:
Ja, Sie können eine Überweisungsanfrage ablehnen. Dies ist sinnvoll, wenn die Überweisung nicht den Unternehmensrichtlinien entspricht, das Budget überschritten wird oder weitere Informationen benötigt werden. Beim Ablehnen haben Sie die Möglichkeit, einen Kommentar hinzuzufügen, um die Gründe für Ihre Entscheidung zu erklären. So bleibt die Kommunikation transparent, und Ihr Team kann die Anfrage bei Bedarf anpassen oder korrigieren.

Diese Funktion gibt Ihnen als Manager oder Administrator die volle Kontrolle über die Ausgaben, während Ihr Team weiterhin flexibel arbeiten kann.

query: What happens if I don't have enough money in my account when a Pay Later installment is due?
answer:
If you don’t have enough funds in your account when a Pay Later installment is due, the following will happen:

1. **Failed Debit Attempt**: The installment will not be debited, and your account will be marked as **Overdue** in your Pay Later cockpit.
2. **Account Restrictions**: Your Qonto account usage will be restricted—credit card payments, direct debits, and transfers will be declined until the overdue amount is repaid.
3. **Late Repayment Fees**: Starting from 10:00 PM (Paris time) on the scheduled payment day, a daily late repayment fee will be applied based on the financing’s APR. This fee continues until the installment is fully repaid.
4. **Loss of Pay Later Eligibility**: If the payment remains overdue for more than five days, you will lose access to the Pay Later feature permanently, and your credit limit will be set to €0.
5. **Automatic Debit Attempts**: Qonto will attempt to debit your account twice daily (latest by 5:00 PM) to recover the total overdue amount plus fees. Partial payments are not possible—only the full amount will be debited if sufficient funds are available.
6. **Urgent Repayment Requirement**: If the payment is not regularized within eight days, you will be required to pay all outstanding or upcoming installments within 15 days.

To resolve this, top up your main account with the necessary funds and manually initiate the repayment via the **Pay Now** button in your Pay Later cockpit (available in the web or mobile app). You can choose to pay a single installment or the full financing amount with prorated interest.

query: Where do I find the three-digit security code on my card?
answer: The three-digit security code, also known as the CVV, is located on the back of your physical card, next to your signature. For virtual cards, you can find it in your Qonto account by going to the **‘Business Account’** section, clicking on **'Cards'**, selecting the card, and clicking **"Reveal"** after entering the security code sent to you by text. For security reasons, only the cardholder can access this information.

query: Kann ich Rechnungen einfach per E-Mail an Qonto schicken, damit sie automatisch zugeordnet werden?
answer: Ja, Sie können Rechnungen einfach per E-Mail an Qonto schicken, damit sie automatisch zugeordnet werden. Nutzen Sie dazu Ihre persönliche [E-Mail-Adresse zur Belegweiterleitung](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949199514385-Wie-funktioniert-die-E-Mail-zur-Belegweiterleitung). Qonto scannt die eingehenden Rechnungen automatisch mithilfe von optischer Zeichenerkennung (OCR), erfasst alle relevanten Informationen und verknüpft sie mit den passenden Transaktionen in Ihrem Konto. Auch die Mehrwertsteuer wird dabei automatisch erkannt. Falls eine Rechnung nicht automatisch zugeordnet werden kann, können Sie sie manuell im Abschnitt **Lieferantenrechnungen** der richtigen Transaktion zuweisen.

query: Can I use my Qonto card to withdraw money abroad without extra fees?
answer:
The ability to withdraw money abroad without extra fees depends on the type of Qonto card you have:

- **ONE Card**: Incurs a 2% foreign exchange commission on non-euro withdrawals, plus a 2€ (excl. VAT) fee per withdrawal.
- **Plus Card**: Incurs a 1% foreign exchange commission on non-euro withdrawals, with the first 5 withdrawals free each month, then 2€ (excl. VAT) per withdrawal.
- **X Card**: No foreign exchange commission on non-euro withdrawals and no additional fees for withdrawals up to €3,000 per month.

For fee-free withdrawals abroad, the **X Card** is the best option as it includes no foreign exchange fees and free withdrawals within the monthly limit.

query: How long do I have to cancel a transfer after I've sent it?
answer: You can cancel a transfer as long as Qonto has not yet requested Crédit Mutuel Arkéa to initiate the movement of funds to the beneficiary's bank. This window can vary from a few minutes to a few hours, depending on when the transfer was validated. Once the transfer request is sent to Crédit Mutuel Arkéa, cancellation is no longer possible. For more details, you can check the different transfer statuses [here](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949974922513).

query: Se ricevo una chiamata da Qonto che mi chiede di fare un bonifico per proteggere il mio conto, è una truffa?
answer: Sì, è una truffa. Qonto non ti chiederà mai di effettuare un bonifico per proteggere i tuoi fondi. Questo è un metodo comune utilizzato dai truffatori per convincerti ad approvare transazioni fraudolente. Se ricevi una chiamata del genere, riaggancia immediatamente e contattaci direttamente tramite la chat all'interno dell'applicazione Qonto per verificare l'autenticità della richiesta.

query: Why hasn't my transfer arrived yet if I sent it yesterday?
answer:
The arrival time of your transfer depends on the type of transfer you made:

- **Instant SEPA transfers** are received within 10 seconds.
- **Standard SEPA transfers** made before 10:30 AM are sent the same business day and usually arrive within 24 to 48 business hours. If sent after 10:30 AM, they are processed the following business day.
- **Non-euro SWIFT transfers** can take up to 5 business days.

If your account was debited but the beneficiary hasn’t received the funds yet, follow these steps:
1. Check your mailbox for any information requests from Qonto and respond if needed.
2. [Send the proof of transfer](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949975364625) to the beneficiary so they can ask their bank to investigate.
3. Contact our [Customer Service](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23950004508305) for further assistance.

You can also download a [proof of payment](https://qonto9015-it.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949975364625) for your records.

query: Cosa devo fare se il commerciante non risponde dopo averlo contattato per un problema con un ordine?
answer:
Se il commerciante non risponde dopo averlo contattato per un problema con un ordine, puoi procedere con la contestazione della transazione. Ecco i passaggi da seguire:

1. Assicurati di aver atteso almeno 7 giorni senza ricevere una risposta dal commerciante.
2. Accedi alla tua app Qonto, individua la transazione problematica e clicca su **"Hai bisogno di aiuto"**.
3. Seleziona l'opzione **"Ho avuto un problema con il pagamento, il prodotto o il servizio"**.
4. Carica le prove della tua comunicazione con il commerciante (ad esempio, screenshot o email) per dimostrare che hai tentato di risolvere il problema.
5. Clicca su **"Contesta questa transazione"** per avviare il processo.

Il nostro team esaminerà la tua richiesta e, se approvata, potresti ricevere un rimborso temporaneo. Ti terremo aggiornato sull'esito tramite le notifiche del tuo conto.

query: Cosa succede se sbaglio il PIN tre volte di seguito?
answer:
Se sbagli il PIN tre volte di seguito, la tua carta Qonto verrà bloccata per motivi di sicurezza. Per sbloccarla, dovrai reimpostare il codice PIN direttamente dall’app Qonto. Puoi farlo accedendo alla sezione **Conto business**, selezionando **Carte** e cliccando su **Reimposta il codice PIN**. Dopo aver configurato un nuovo PIN, dovrai effettuare un prelievo presso uno sportello bancomat per completare l’attivazione.

Se non ricordi il PIN iniziale e la carta non è ancora stata attivata, per motivi di sicurezza non sarà possibile modificarlo. In questo caso, ti consigliamo di eliminare la carta e ordinarne una nuova.

query: Est-ce que je peux utiliser une carte American Express pour ajouter des fonds à mon compte Qonto ?
answer: Non, il n'est pas possible d'utiliser une carte American Express pour ajouter des fonds à votre compte Qonto. Seules les cartes Visa ou Mastercard sont acceptées pour le crédit par carte, ainsi que les paiements via Google Pay ou Apple Pay. Les autres options pour alimenter votre compte incluent les virements SEPA (instantanés ou standard) ou la réception d'un paiement d'un tiers.

query: What happens if I reject a transfer request in Qonto?
answer: If you reject a transfer request in Qonto, the transaction will not be processed, and the funds will remain in the account. You have the option to add a comment explaining your decision when rejecting the request, which can provide clarity to the team member who initiated it. The request will then be removed from the **Pending** tab in the **Tasks** section. If needed, the team member can submit a new request with corrected details.

query: Can I use my Qonto account right away if I only have the notarized commercial register application, or do I need the full registration first?
answer: You can fully use and activate your Qonto account immediately with the notarized commercial register application. This allows you to avoid unnecessary waiting time. However, please note that outgoing SWIFT payments will only be possible after your company is fully registered in the commercial register. Qonto will monitor the registration process for you in the background for 70 days and handle the necessary steps.

query: Can I receive a payment from a client in Japan directly to my Qonto account in euros?
answer: Yes, you can receive a payment from a client in Japan directly to your Qonto account in euros. Qonto supports SWIFT transfers in over 50 currencies, including the Japanese yen (JPY). Your client will need to initiate a SWIFT transfer using your Qonto account details, including the IBAN, BIC, and the BIC of the intermediary bank (Wise). The funds will be automatically converted to euros upon receipt. Ensure your client includes Wise's BIC (TRWIBEB3XXX) as the intermediary bank to avoid any issues. The transfer typically takes up to 5 business days to be credited to your account.

query: ¿Puede mi banco quitarme el dinero de una transferencia que ya recibí en mi cuenta?
answer: Sí, en ciertos casos tu banco puede retirar el dinero de una transferencia que ya recibiste en tu cuenta. Esto se conoce como retrocesión de una transferencia y está regulado por la norma SEPA. Puede ocurrir si el remitente se equivocó al introducir el importe o el IBAN, si la transferencia se duplicó por error, o si hay sospecha de fraude. En estos casos, el banco de origen puede solicitar la devolución de los fondos, pero el proceso requiere una validación cuidadosa por parte de los administradores de cuentas para asegurarse de que la solicitud sea legítima. Sin su aprobación, la transferencia no se cancelará.

query: ¿Qué hago si no aparece el IVA en una compra que hice?
answer:
Si no aparece el IVA en una compra, puedes completarlo de dos formas: a nivel de la transacción o a nivel del proveedor.

Para hacerlo a nivel de transacción:
1. Ve al historial de transacciones y aplica el filtro de IVA faltante.
2. Haz clic en "Filtros", selecciona "IVA" como valor, elige "incluye" y "sin adjuntar" como criterios.
3. Selecciona la transacción y añade los datos del IVA en la sección derecha de la interfaz.

Si prefieres configurarlo a nivel del proveedor, puedes asignar un tipo de IVA único en la pestaña **Proveedores** dentro de la sección **Compras**, lo que automatizará el proceso para futuras transacciones. Puedes encontrar más detalles en [este artículo](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/es/articles/23950970965137--C%C3%B3mo-se-aplica-el-tipo-de-IVA-y-las-etiquetas-personalizadas-a-un-proveedor).

query: Why is part of my direct debit payment being held back and when will I get it?
answer:
Qonto holds a percentage of your direct debit collections for 8 weeks to ensure there are sufficient funds available in case of disputes or refunds. This is a standard security measure to protect both your business and financial transactions.

The held amount is determined based on your business's risk assessment, and you can see the specific percentage in your **Incoming Direct Debits** section. For example, if 30% is held from a €200 payment, €60 will be reserved. If no dispute or refund occurs, the held amount will be automatically released after 8 weeks—no action is required on your part.

You can monitor the status of your direct debits in your account, where it will change from **On hold** to **Completed** once the funds are released. This process ensures smooth financial operations without manual intervention.

query: Can I change the frequency of my team's budget from monthly to yearly after it's been created?
answer: No, it is not possible to change the frequency of a budget from monthly to yearly (or vice versa) after it has been created. If you need to switch the frequency, you must delete the current budget and create a new one with the desired frequency. Additionally, you will need to manually reallocate any expenses already linked to the old budget to the new one, if necessary.

query: Wird meine erste Abonnementgebühr direkt nach der Anmeldung abgebucht?
answer: Nein, Ihre erste Abonnementgebühr wird nicht direkt nach der Anmeldung abgebucht. Die erste Zahlung ist am Ende Ihres 30-tägigen Testzeitraums fällig, außer bei Firmengründungen, bei denen die erste Zahlung sofort bei der Anmeldung fällig wird. Die Abbuchung erfolgt dann je nach gewählter Abrechnungsart (monatlich oder jährlich) am ersten Tag des entsprechenden Abrechnungszeitraums.

query: ¿Puedo pagar una factura en dólares desde la sección de facturas de proveedores si no tengo permiso para hacer transferencias?
answer: No, actualmente no es posible solicitar el pago de una factura en dólares u otras divisas distintas del euro desde la sección de Facturas de proveedores si no tienes permiso para hacer transferencias. Para pagar este tipo de facturas, deberás ponerte en contacto con el Titular de la cuenta, un Administrador u otro Manager que sí tenga permiso de transferencia.

query: Why does the amount shown in my dashboard sometimes not match what I see in my account transactions?
answer: The amount shown in your dashboard may not match your account transactions because internal transfers are not included in the graphs when "All accounts" is selected. This ensures that the dashboard reflects only external inflows and outflows, providing a clearer view of your actual income and expenses. If you want to see all transactions, including internal transfers, you may need to check your account statement directly or adjust the view to a single account rather than all accounts combined.

query: Do I need to manually upload my OVH invoices to Qonto after setting up the integration?
answer: No, you don’t need to manually upload your OVH invoices to Qonto after setting up the integration. Once connected, your invoices will flow automatically into your Qonto account. The integration retrieves your invoices daily, so you won’t have to worry about manual downloads or uploads—everything is handled seamlessly in the background. If an invoice can’t be matched automatically, you’ll simply be asked to confirm it manually. This way, you can focus on your business while the integration keeps your invoices up to date.

query: Can I see my Qonto transactions in real-time on Notion?
answer: No, your Qonto transactions are not synchronized in real-time on Notion. The integration updates your transaction data every three hours. This means there may be a slight delay before new transactions appear in your Notion database.

query: Why can't I get the verification code on my phone even though I have WhatsApp installed?
answer:
If you have WhatsApp installed but still aren’t receiving the verification code, here are some steps to troubleshoot the issue:

1. **Check your network connection:** Ensure your phone has a stable network signal.
2. **Dual SIM phones:** If your phone has two SIM cards, remove the one not linked to your Qonto account.
3. **Disable roaming:** If roaming is enabled, turn it off and try again.
4. **Verify phone settings:** Make sure your phone’s date and time are set to automatic.
5. **Restart your phone:** Sometimes a simple restart can resolve connectivity issues.
6. **Contact your carrier:** If you're abroad, check with your mobile operator to ensure SMS services are active and unrestricted.

If the problem persists after trying these steps, please contact our support team via email or through the chat on your Qonto interface for further assistance.

query: Does dark mode save battery on my phone?
answer: Yes, dark mode can help conserve battery life on your phone, especially if your device has an OLED or AMOLED screen. These screens illuminate individual pixels, so darker colors require less power. By reducing the brightness of the display, dark mode can extend your battery life, particularly during prolonged use.

query: ¿Qué pasa si cierro mi cuenta Qonto con dinero pendiente de transferencia?
answer: Si cierras tu cuenta Qonto con dinero pendiente de transferencia, el cierre se aplazará automáticamente hasta el último día del mes siguiente. Además, se te cobrará otro mes de suscripción. Esto se debe a que, para cerrar la cuenta, el saldo debe ser de 0 euros y no debe haber operaciones pendientes, como transferencias, pagos con tarjeta o ingresos de cheques. Si hay movimientos pendientes, el proceso de cierre no se completará hasta que se resuelvan.

query: ¿Cómo puedo saber cuál es mi ID de cuenta de Google Ads para conectarlo con Qonto?
answer: Puedes encontrar tu ID de cuenta de Google Ads en la parte superior de tu panel de Google Ads. Este número único identifica tu cuenta y es necesario para conectarlo con Qonto. Si necesitas ayuda adicional, revisa la sección "Configuración de facturación" en el menú izquierdo de Google Ads, donde también aparecen los detalles de tu cuenta.

query: Can I use my driver's license as an identity document to open a Qonto account?
answer: No, Qonto does not accept a driver's license as a valid identity document for opening an account. We only accept official documents such as an ID card, passport, or residence permit to comply with regulatory requirements and ensure the security of your account. For more details, you can refer to the specific requirements based on your country of registration.

query: ¿Puedo usar la opción de pagar más tarde si mi factura es de 100 euros?
answer: No, no puedes usar la opción de pagar más tarde con una factura de 100 euros. La función Pagar más tarde de Qonto requiere que la factura tenga un importe mínimo de **150 €**. Si tu factura cumple con este requisito y otros criterios de elegibilidad, podrás financiarla en 3, 9 o 12 plazos. Para más detalles sobre los requisitos de las facturas, puedes consultar [este enlace](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/25317436448017).

query: Est-ce que je peux assurer mon commerce avec Orus même si je suis auto-entrepreneur ?
answer: Oui, vous pouvez assurer votre commerce avec Orus même en tant qu'auto-entrepreneur. Orus propose des solutions d'assurance adaptées à tous les professionnels indépendants, y compris les auto-entrepreneurs. Vous pouvez souscrire à des produits comme l'Assurance Responsabilité Civile Professionnelle (RC Pro), l'Assurance Multirisque Professionnelle pour commerçants, ou d'autres couvertures adaptées à votre activité. Le processus est simple et personnalisable selon vos besoins.

query: Peut-on créer plusieurs budgets pour la même équipe ?
answer: Non, il n'est possible de créer qu'un seul budget par équipe sur Qonto. Cependant, ce budget peut couvrir deux périodes de 12 mois chacune, qui peuvent se chevaucher entre l'année en cours et l'année suivante. Vous pouvez également définir une périodicité mensuelle ou globale pour ce budget, offrant ainsi une certaine flexibilité dans la planification.

query: What happens if I don’t receive the confirmation code when updating my phone number?
answer:
If you don’t receive the confirmation code when updating your phone number, you can try the following:

1. **Check your network connection** to ensure the SMS was not delayed.
2. **Request a new code** by clicking the resend option, if available.
3. **Verify the phone number** you entered for any typos.
4. **Check your spam or junk folder** if the code was sent via email.

If you have **Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)** enabled, the code will be sent to your associated device. If not, it may be sent to your previous phone number or email.

If you still don’t receive the code, contact Qonto support for assistance. They may ask you to verify your identity with a selfie, ID document, and additional details to ensure account security.

query: Est-ce que je peux mettre ma carte Qonto virtuelle dans mon portefeuille électronique ?
answer:
Oui, vous pouvez ajouter votre carte Qonto virtuelle à votre portefeuille électronique (Apple Wallet ou Google Wallet). Pour cela, suivez ces étapes :

1. Allez dans la section **‘Compte Pro’** de votre application Qonto.
2. Cliquez sur **‘Cartes’** et sélectionnez la carte virtuelle que vous souhaitez ajouter.
3. Appuyez sur **“Ajouter à Apple Wallet”** ou **“Ajouter à Google Wallet”** selon votre appareil, puis suivez les instructions à l’écran.

Cette procédure fonctionne pour toutes vos cartes Qonto, qu’elles soient physiques, virtuelles ou Instant.

query: How long does it take for my company to be validated for international transfers?
answer:
The validation time for international transfers depends on your company's situation:

- If your company was **recently registered**, our system checks public databases several times a week to verify your industry activity (e.g., NAF/APE code for French companies). Access is typically granted quickly once the information is available.
- If your company’s information is **not publicly available** (e.g., due to a privacy request), you can contact our support team to provide the required details privately, which will speed up the process.
- For **German companies**, validation may require additional registration information, which our team will review to ensure compliance with our third-party provider’s criteria.

If you need further assistance, our Customer Support team is available via chat to help resolve any delays.

query: What do I need to bring with me to deposit cash into my Qonto account using T-Bonifico?
answer:
To deposit cash into your Qonto account using T-Bonifico, you need to bring the following with you to an enabled point of sale:

1. The **QR code** generated from the form available [here](https://www.mooney.it/servizi/pagamenti/bonifici/t-bonifico-qr).
2. A valid **ID** (e.g., passport or identity card).
3. Your **health card** (Tessera Sanitaria).

Once at the point of sale, show the QR code and complete the transaction. The cash will be transferred to your Qonto account.

query: What should I do if the VAT rate is not automatically detected for one of my transactions?
answer:
If the VAT rate is not automatically detected for one of your transactions, you can manually add or modify it directly at the transaction level. Here’s how to do it:

1. Click on **Filters** in your transaction view.
2. Select **VAT** as the value, choose “is any of,” and set the criteria to “missing.”
3. Select the transaction where the VAT is missing and enter the VAT details in the right-side section of your interface.

Alternatively, you can also set a default VAT rate for a supplier to automate future transactions. This can be done in the **Suppliers** tab under the **Purchases** section. For more details, you can refer to [this guide](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949968718737).

If multiple VAT rates apply to a single transaction, you can add up to 8 different rates by clicking on “add VAT.” These will appear in the **Others** section when filtering transactions.

query: What kind of document should I upload if I'm paying my employee's salary?
answer: To justify a transfer for paying your employee's salary, you need to upload a **payslip** or the employee's **IBAN**. These documents ensure the transfer is properly documented and compliant with accounting requirements.

query: Come posso trovare rapidamente un cliente nella lista se non ricordo il suo nome completo?
answer: Puoi trovare rapidamente un cliente nella Lista clienti ordinando i tuoi clienti alfabeticamente per nome o per indirizzo email. Basta cliccare sull’intestazione della colonna corrispondente per riordinare la lista in base al criterio scelto. Inoltre, puoi utilizzare la barra di ricerca in cima alla lista per digitare le informazioni parziali che ricordi, come una parte del nome o dell’email, e filtrare i risultati in tempo reale. In questo modo, anche senza il nome completo, potrai individuare facilmente il cliente che stai cercando.

query: Why do I keep seeing ads for Qonto after visiting the website?
answer:
You are seeing ads for Qonto after visiting the website because we use targeting cookies to deliver personalized advertisements based on your interests and browsing behavior. These cookies are placed by third-party services like Facebook Ads, Google Adwords, and LinkedIn Insight Tag, which track your activity to show you relevant ads across different platforms.

If you prefer not to see these ads, you can manage or disable these cookies through your browser settings or by adjusting your preferences in the cookie consent banner on our website. However, disabling these cookies may limit the personalization of ads and other functionalities on our platform.

query: What happens if I try to make a payment but don’t have enough money in my Qonto account?
answer:
If you try to make a payment but don’t have enough money in your Qonto account, the payment will be declined. Your Qonto account cannot be overdrawn, so we always check your balance before authorizing any transaction. This applies to card payments, transfers, and direct debits.

If your balance is too low to cover scheduled payments in the next 14 days, you’ll receive an alert. To resolve this, you’ll need to top up your account to process new payments. If your company is eligible, you can also use our **Pay Later** feature or explore financing offers from our partners in the **Financing** section of the Qonto app.

query: Wie kann ich eine offene Penta-Rechnung bezahlen?
answer:
Um eine offene Penta-Rechnung zu bezahlen, überweisen Sie den ausstehenden Betrag bitte an folgende Bankverbindung:

**Empfänger:** Qonto Services GmbH
**IBAN:** DE92 1001 0123 0215 3334 56
**BIC:** QNTODEB2XXX
**Verwendungszweck:** Geben Sie unbedingt die Rechnungsnummer(n) an, um eine korrekte Zuordnung zu gewährleisten.

Falls Sie ein Abrechnungskonto in der Penta App hinterlegt haben, wird der Betrag automatisch von diesem Konto abgebucht. Bei weiteren Fragen können Sie sich schriftlich an den Rechnungsservice von Qonto wenden.

query: What should I do if I can't find an answer in the help center and need urgent help with my account?
answer:
If you can't find an answer in the Qonto Help Center and need urgent assistance with your account, you can reach our customer service in Germany through multiple channels:

- **Chat support**: Open the Qonto app and click on the chat bubble in the bottom right corner. Our team is available **24/7** to respond to your inquiries promptly.
- **Social media**: Send us a message on Facebook or Twitter for assistance.
- **Phone support**: Call us directly at **+49 3030807738** during our opening hours for immediate help.

We’re here to support you every day, so choose the option that works best for you!

query: Kann ich auch Rechnungen per WhatsApp schicken, die ich mit einer anderen Bankkarte bezahlt habe?
answer: Ja, das ist möglich, wenn Sie die Kontoaggregation bei Qonto nutzen. Wenn Sie Zahlungen mit anderen Bankkonten oder Karten tätigen, die bei Qonto zentralisiert sind, können Sie die Rechnungen einfach per WhatsApp an Qonto senden. Wir ordnen diese dann automatisch Ihren Zahlungen zu, auch wenn sie nicht direkt über Qonto abgewickelt wurden. So behalten Sie alle Ihre Belege an einem Ort und sparen Zeit bei der Verwaltung.

query: Can I change the budget from monthly to yearly after creating it?
answer: No, you cannot change the budget frequency from monthly to yearly (or vice versa) after creating it. If you need to switch the frequency, you must delete the current budget and create a new one with the desired frequency. Additionally, you will need to manually reallocate any existing transactions to the new budget if necessary.

query: Can I add my virtual Qonto card to my phone's wallet?
answer: Yes, you can add your virtual Qonto card to your phone's wallet. To do this, go to the **‘Business Account’** section, click on **‘Cards’**, select the virtual card you want to add, and then choose **‘Add to Apple Wallet’** or **‘Add to Google Pay’** and follow the instructions. This works for physical, virtual, and Instant Qonto cards.

query: Ho pagato una spesa aziendale con la mia carta personale, come faccio a farmi rimborsare?
answer:
Per richiedere il rimborso di una spesa aziendale anticipata con la tua carta personale, segui questi passaggi:

1. **Prepara la documentazione necessaria**:
   - Assicurati di avere la ricevuta della spesa (può essere digitale, poiché ha lo stesso valore legale di quella cartacea).
   - Verifica l’importo della spesa e l’IVA, che saranno inseriti automaticamente grazie alla tecnologia OCR, ma potrai modificarli manualmente se necessario.
   - Aggiungi una descrizione dettagliata della spesa per fornire maggiori informazioni all’Admin o al Manager.
   - Inserisci il tuo IBAN personale, che puoi salvare nel tuo profilo per future richieste.

2. **Invia la richiesta di rimborso**:
   - **Da computer**:
     - Vai su **Spese di team** nel menu a sinistra.
     - Clicca su **Rimborsi**, poi su **Fai una richiesta** e seleziona **Rimborso spese**.
     - Carica la ricevuta e verifica i dati precompilati, aggiungendo la descrizione e il tuo IBAN se non è già salvato.
   - **Da smartphone**:
     - Apri l’app Qonto, vai su **Menu > Rimborsi** e clicca sul simbolo **+**, poi su **Rimborso spese**.
     - Carica la ricevuta scattando una foto, scegliendola dalla libreria o dai file, e completa i dettagli come sopra.

3. **Monitora lo stato della richiesta**:
   - Puoi controllare lo stato della tua richiesta nella sezione **Richieste**.
   - Se approvata, riceverai il rimborso istantaneamente sul conto indicato.
   - Se rifiutata, riceverai una notifica con la motivazione del rifiuto.

Ricorda che la funzionalità Rimborsi è disponibile nei piani Smart, Premium, Business ed Enterprise, e dal 01/10/2024 anche per il piano Essential con le nuove tariffe.

query: Posso ricevere le notifiche di Qonto su Slack anche se non ho accesso all'account Qonto?
answer: Sì, puoi ricevere le notifiche di Qonto su Slack anche senza avere accesso all'account Qonto. Un utente con ruolo di Proprietario o Amministratore può configurare l'integrazione e invitare i membri del team a unirsi al canale Slack scelto per le notifiche. In questo modo, chiunque nel canale può monitorare le finanze in tempo reale, indipendentemente dall'accesso a Qonto.

query: Can I switch from email login to Google or Apple sign-in later if I already have a Qonto account?
answer:
Yes, you can switch from email login to Google or Apple sign-in later, even if you already have a Qonto account. Simply use the same email address associated with your Qonto account when selecting the "Sign in with Google" or "Sign in with Apple" option. For example, if you signed up with *jane.doe@gmail.com* and a password, you can still log in via Google using the same email address.

If you initially used Apple's "Hide My Email" feature, ensure you continue using the forwarded email address provided by Apple. Also, remember that if you revoke Qonto's access to your Apple email in the future, you should first update the email address linked to your Qonto account.

query: Will I lose my existing invoices if I cancel the Accounts Receivable add-on after April 1st?
answer: No, you will not lose your existing invoices if you cancel the Accounts Receivable add-on after April 1st. You will retain access to all standard invoicing features, including your previously created invoices, quotes, credit notes, and deposit invoices. The cancellation only removes access to the advanced features of the AR add-on, such as recurring invoices and automated payment reminders. Your historical data remains intact.

query: Can a manager edit a transfer that another team member has already approved?
answer: No, a manager cannot edit a transfer that has been initiated or approved by another team member, regardless of their transfer limits. Managers can only edit transfers that they have initiated or approved themselves. If a transfer needs to be modified after being approved by another member, an Admin or the Account Holder would need to handle the changes.

query: Comment puis-je accepter des paiements en ligne avec mon compte Qonto ?
answer: Pour accepter des paiements en ligne avec votre compte Qonto, vous pouvez utiliser des plateformes alternatives telles que Stripe ou PayPal, car Qonto ne propose pas encore de Contrat de Vente à Distance (VAD). Ces solutions vous permettront de gérer les transactions en ligne de manière sécurisée et efficace.

query: Quanto tempo ci vuole per un bonifico internazionale con Qonto e Wise?
answer: I tempi di esecuzione dei bonifici internazionali con Qonto e Wise sono generalmente rapidi. Alcuni trasferimenti vengono regolati entro un giorno lavorativo, mentre altri possono essere completati addirittura all'istante, a seconda della valuta e del paese di destinazione. Grazie alla partnership con Wise, Qonto garantisce un servizio efficiente e trasparente, fornendo anche una stima della data di ricezione del bonifico prima di avviare il trasferimento. Per maggiori dettagli, puoi consultare la lista dei paesi e delle valute supportate.

query: What personal information does Zendesk have access to when I contact Qonto support?
answer: Zendesk only has access to the information necessary to provide you with a customized and efficient service, such as your name, surname, and email address. It does not access your banking account data or any other personal or account information. This ensures that your sensitive details remain secure while allowing our support team to assist you effectively.

query: Why does my card get rejected when I try to pay at a parking machine?
answer:
Your card may be rejected at a parking machine because the payment terminal requires an internet connection to process the pre-authorization request with your bank. Without this connection, the terminal cannot verify the funds in your account, leading to a declined payment.

This issue commonly occurs with self-service machines, such as those in underground parking lots or at ticket vending machines. To avoid this, we recommend paying at a parking attendant's booth if available or subscribing to a Telepass device for seamless parking payments.

If you already have a Telepass, you can link it to your Qonto account for automatic charging. However, note that Qonto does not support Viacard or Telepass Business services directly—only consumer Telepass services can be charged to your Qonto account.

query: ¿Puedo cambiar un presupuesto después de que mi cliente lo haya aceptado?
answer: No, una vez que un presupuesto ha sido marcado como **Aceptado**, ya no se puede editar. Esto se debe a que el presupuesto adquiere un valor legalmente vinculante como contrato con tu cliente. Cualquier modificación posterior deberá ser acordada directamente con el cliente y no podrá realizarse unilateralmente a través de Qonto. Solo los presupuestos en estado **Pendiente** pueden ser editados.

query: Kann ich eine Rechnung in einer anderen Währung als Euro erstellen?
answer: Ja, Sie können eine Rechnung in einer anderen Währung als Euro erstellen. Beim Erstellen einer Rechnung in Qonto haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine andere Währung auszuwählen, falls Ihr Kunde nicht in Euro bezahlen soll. Dies können Sie im Bereich der Kundendetails festlegen, indem Sie die gewünschte Währung auswählen. Die Rechnung wird dann in der ausgewählten Währung erstellt und angezeigt.

query: Perché non riesco a richiedere una nuova carta di debito?
answer: Al momento non è possibile richiedere nuove carte di debito a causa di un ordine ricevuto da Banca d’Italia, che ha richiesto a Qonto di migliorare le misure anti-riciclaggio nella sua filiale italiana. Questa limitazione è temporanea e attualmente è consentito solo il rinnovo delle carte in scadenza o smarrite.

query: Wie lange dauert es, bis ich meine SCI bekomme, wenn ich in Frankreich bin?
answer: Wenn Sie in Frankreich ansässig sind, wird Qonto Ihre SCI (SEPA Creditor Identifier) bei der Banque de France beantragen. Die Bearbeitung dauert in der Regel bis zu 2 Arbeitstage. Die Banque de France berechnet dafür eine Gebühr von 50 EUR. Sobald die SCI erteilt wurde, können Sie die Lastschriftfunktion in Ihrem Konto einrichten.

query: Do I have to pay extra for the automatic receipt collection feature?
answer: No, the automatic receipt collection feature is entirely free and included in your Qonto subscription. There are no additional fees or need to subscribe to any of our partner services like Limpidius or Killbills. This feature is available to all Qonto customers regardless of their plan.

query: Can I send money to a friend in the UK using a SEPA transfer?
answer: Yes, you can send money to a friend in the UK using a SEPA transfer. The SEPA network includes the United Kingdom, allowing you to send euros within this area efficiently and conveniently. This means the transfer will be processed as a standard SEPA transaction, typically with lower fees and faster processing times compared to SWIFT transfers.

query: Do I need to provide identification documents for all members of the cooperative when opening a Qonto account?
answer: No, you do not need to provide identification documents for all members of the cooperative. Only the Chairman of the Board of Directors and the Deputy Chairman (if applicable) are required to submit valid identity documents. Additionally, the cooperative must provide the *Visura ordinaria* as part of the company-related documents. The account can only be opened by the President or a natural person expressly delegated by them.

query: ¿Puedo pedir un reembolso si pagué un gasto de la empresa con mi tarjeta personal?
answer:
Sí, puedes solicitar un reembolso si pagaste un gasto de la empresa con tu tarjeta personal. En Qonto, los miembros del equipo (Managers y empleados en los planes Business y Enterprise, o con el Módulo de gestión de gastos activado en el plan Essential) pueden presentar una solicitud de reembolso.

Para hacerlo, sigue estos pasos:
1. Ve a la sección **Reembolsos** en tu cuenta de Qonto.
2. Haz clic en **Solicitar un reembolso**.
3. Adjunta el recibo del gasto, indica el importe, añade una descripción y proporciona tu IBAN personal.

Una vez enviada la solicitud, los titulares, administradores o Managers avanzados con permisos de transferencia podrán aprobarla o rechazarla. Recibirás una notificación cuando se procese tu solicitud.

Si necesitas más detalles, puedes consultar [esta guía sobre cómo solicitar un reembolso](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/es/articles/23950938065681--C%C3%B3mo-puedo-pedir-el-reembolso-de-los-gastos-de-empresa-que-he-hecho-con-mi-propio-dinero).

query: How do I share my Qonto account details with my accounting software?
answer:
To share your Qonto account details with your accounting software, you can provide your **API login** and **secret key** for read-only access. These credentials are different from your email and password and are specifically designed for secure integrations with third-party tools.

Here’s how to find them:

1. Go to the **Settings** icon at the bottom left of your Qonto web app.
2. Click on **Integrations and Partnerships** > **API key**.
3. If you have a **Basic plan**, you’ll see your organization’s name followed by a number (your login), and you can click **Generate** to create your secret key.
4. For **Smart, Premium, Essential, Business, or Enterprise plans**, your login and secret key are automatically generated and available in the same section.

If you’ve enabled **Strong Customer Authentication**, you’ll receive a confirmation request on your associated phone before accessing the key.

Once shared, your accounting software will have read-only access to your Qonto account data. If you ever need to revoke access, you can regenerate your secret key, which will disable all previous integrations using the old key.

For more details on compatible apps and specific credentials, you can [check this list](https://qonto9015.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947685520145).

query: Do I need to manually enter my Amazon Business purchases into Qonto, or does the integration handle it automatically?
answer: The integration between Amazon Business and Qonto handles the process automatically. Once set up, your Amazon Business invoices are imported and reconciled with your Qonto transactions without any manual data entry. Invoices are automatically attached to the corresponding transactions in your Qonto account, saving you time and simplifying your accounting. Synchronization occurs daily between 21:00 and 22:00 (Paris time, CET), ensuring your records stay up to date.

query: What happens if I accidentally give an integration access to my Qonto account?
answer: If you accidentally give an integration access to your Qonto account, you can easily revoke its access at any time. Simply go to the "Partners & Integrations" menu in your Qonto account and remove the integration’s permissions. Additionally, all integrations are designed with security in mind—they only have access to the specific information they need, and sensitive actions require Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for extra protection. If you need assistance, you can contact the support team directly from the integration’s details in the menu.

query: Est-ce que je peux prendre en photo un ticket de caisse et l’associer à une transaction depuis mon téléphone ?
answer: Oui, vous pouvez prendre en photo un ticket de caisse et l’associer à une transaction directement depuis l’application mobile Qonto. Pour cela, sélectionnez la transaction concernée dans l’onglet **Historique**, puis cliquez sur **Ajouter** sous l’intitulé **Reçus** pour joindre la photo de votre ticket. Cette fonctionnalité est simple et rapide, et vos reçus sont ensuite stockés et certifiés à valeur probante si vous disposez d’un plan Smart ou supérieur.

query: Comment faire pour envoyer un virement à un nouveau bénéficiaire sans facture ?
answer:
Pour envoyer un virement à un nouveau bénéficiaire sans facture, suivez ces étapes simples :

1. **Sur l'application web ou mobile**, accédez à la section **Virements**.
2. Cliquez sur **+ Effectuer un virement** (icône noire en haut à droite).
3. Sélectionnez **Ajouter les détails du virement**, puis **Virement SEPA en euros**.
4. Choisissez le **compte à débiter**.
5. Ajoutez un **nouveau bénéficiaire** en saisissant son **nom complet** (tel qu’indiqué sur son RIB) et son **IBAN**. Le bénéficiaire sera automatiquement enregistré pour vos prochains virements.
6. Indiquez le **montant** et une **référence** (jusqu’à 135 caractères).
7. Si nécessaire, programmez une **date d’exécution** ou une **récurrence**.
8. (Optionnel) Ajoutez une pièce jointe, un libellé TVA/analytique, ou activez la notification au bénéficiaire.
9. Vérifiez les informations, puis validez le virement. Une confirmation par authentification forte (via votre téléphone) sera requise.

💡 **Bon à savoir** : Par défaut, le virement est instantané, mais vous pouvez choisir un virement classique (délai jusqu’à 48h). Si le montant dépasse 100 000 € ou si le bénéficiaire n’est pas éligible au SEPA instantané, le virement sera traité en mode classique.

query: What happens if I send euros to an account that doesn’t use euros?
answer: When you send euros to a non-euro account, the receiving bank automatically converts the amount to the local currency using their own exchange rate, which often includes hidden markups. This means the beneficiary may receive less money than expected, and you won’t have visibility or control over the final amount they get. Additionally, the conversion fees applied by the receiving bank are typically higher than Qonto’s transparent fees.

query: ¿Puedo guardar un filtro que uso mucho para no tener que volver a configurarlo cada vez?
answer: Sí, puedes guardar un filtro que uses frecuentemente como una **vista personalizada** para no tener que configurarlo cada vez. En el apartado **Cuenta de la empresa**, haz clic en **"Añadir una vista personalizada"** en la lista de vistas. Define el nombre y los criterios del filtro, como fechas, importes, etiquetas u otros parámetros. Una vez configurado, haz clic en **"Guardar y aplicar"**. Esta vista quedará guardada y podrás acceder a ella en cualquier momento, editándola si es necesario. Así, podrás aplicar tus filtros favoritos con un solo clic.

query: ¿Puedo ver los archivos adjuntos de mis transacciones de Qonto en Agicap?
answer: No, no puedes recuperar los archivos adjuntos de tus transacciones de Qonto con la integración de Agicap. La conexión permite seguir tus pagos, categorizar transacciones y gestionar tu tesorería en tiempo real, pero no incluye la visualización de archivos adjuntos.

query: Can I let a team leader manage their own team members in Qonto?
answer: Yes, you can let a team leader manage their own team members in Qonto. To do this, you can assign the Manager role to a team leader within a specific team. This allows them to invite and manage team members, as well as perform pre-defined financial and administrative tasks for their assigned team. Simply add the member with the Manager role to an empty team, and they will be able to build and manage their own team. Note that only one member with a Manager role can be added per team.

query: Puis-je envoyer un brouillon de facture à mon client pour qu'il vérifie les détails avant que je l'envoie officiellement ?
answer: Oui, vous pouvez envoyer un brouillon de facture à votre client sous la forme d'une facture pro forma. Cela lui permet de vérifier les détails avant l'émission de la version définitive. Pour ce faire, depuis un ordinateur, cliquez sur **Envoyer le brouillon** dans l'onglet Factures, saisissez l'adresse e-mail de votre client, personnalisez votre message et envoyez-le. Vous pouvez aussi copier le lien du document pour le partager via un autre canal. Depuis l'application mobile, sélectionnez les trois points en haut à droite, choisissez **Envoyer le brouillon**, puis sélectionnez le canal de partage et personnalisez votre message. Cette version provisoire n'a aucun effet comptable et ne nécessite aucune action de la part de votre client.

query: What happens if I switch from an annual plan to a monthly one before the year is over?
answer: If you switch from an annual plan to a monthly one before the year is over, you will be immediately billed for your new monthly plan, prorated for the current month. However, the annual plan you already paid for will not be refunded.
