answer: Adding a minor as a shareholder during company registration is possible but comes with certain restrictions due to regulatory requirements. Qonto can accept minors as shareholders only under specific conditions. For detailed guidelines on what must be observed in the case of shareholders who are minors, please refer to the following link: [What must be observed in the case of shareholders who are minors?](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949180081681). This will provide you with the necessary information to proceed correctly.

query: Can I export my transactions to use with my accounting software like Xero or Sage?
answer:
Yes, you can export your transactions to use with accounting software like Xero or Sage. Qonto supports multiple export formats, including **QIF** (compatible with Xero, Cegid, and Sage) and **CSV/Excel** (which can be imported into Sage and other tools). For Xero, you can also use the **OFX** format if you’ve set up Qonto as a bank account within the software.

To export, go to the **Transaction section** in your Business account, apply any necessary filters, and choose the appropriate format for your accounting software. If you’re on the Smart plan or higher, you can even create custom export templates for more tailored integration.

For step-by-step guidance, you can refer to these resources:
- [How to import a QIF file into Xero](https://central.xero.com/s/article/Import-a-QIF-bank-statement-UK-GL)
- [How to import a CSV file into Sage](https://help.accounting.sage.com/en-gb/accounting/banking/importing-bank-statement.html)

query: Do I need to pay anything for my first visit to an airport lounge with my X card?
answer: No, your first visit to an airport lounge with your X card is free. This allows you to try the service and see if you enjoy it. Subsequent visits will be charged at a discounted rate of €30 per entry. Just present your physical X card at the lounge reception and mention that you have LoungeKey access.

query: Se non mi piace il piano Smart dopo la prova gratuita, posso tornare al piano Basic senza costi aggiuntivi?
answer: Sì, puoi tornare al piano Basic senza costi aggiuntivi in qualsiasi momento prima della scadenza del periodo di prova gratuita del piano Smart. Basta accedere al tuo conto Qonto dal computer, andare su **Impostazioni > Piano e fatture > Dettagli del piano**, cliccare su **Cambia piano** e selezionare il piano Basic. Se hai attivato funzionalità esclusive del piano Smart (come l'accesso per il commercialista o un conto secondario), dovrai prima disattivarle. Dopo la scadenza della prova, se non hai effettuato il downgrade, ti verrà addebitata la differenza tra i due piani in proporzione ai giorni rimanenti del mese.

query: Wie oft werden die Google Ads-Rechnungen in Qonto aktualisiert?
answer: Die Google Ads-Rechnungen werden in Qonto täglich zu einem festgelegten Zeitpunkt automatisch abgerufen und aktualisiert. Dadurch bleibt Ihr Buchhaltungsworkflow stets auf dem neuesten Stand.

query: What happens if I approve a transaction notification that I didn’t initiate?
answer:
If you approve a transaction notification that you didn’t initiate, you risk validating a fraudulent operation. Fraudsters may trick you into approving unauthorized transactions, such as money transfers, adding new administrators, changing your password, or authorizing new devices. This could compromise the security of your Qonto account and lead to financial loss or unauthorized access.

Always carefully verify the details of each transaction before approving it. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not approve the notification and contact Qonto support immediately. Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) is designed to protect your account, but your vigilance is essential to prevent fraud.

query: Ho fatto un bonifico stamattina dopo le 10:40, quando arriverà al destinatario?
answer: Il bonifico SEPA ordinario in euro effettuato dopo le 10:40 verrà inviato il giorno lavorativo successivo e arriverà al destinatario entro 24/48 ore lavorative dall'invio. Se il bonifico è istantaneo, invece, dovrebbe essere già stato ricevuto dal beneficiario entro 10 secondi. Se hai dubbi o necessiti di ulteriori dettagli, puoi controllare la tua casella email per eventuali richieste di informazioni da parte di Qonto o contattare il nostro Servizio Clienti per assistenza.

query: Pourquoi est-ce que je ne peux pas utiliser l'argent de mon entreprise pour augmenter son capital via Qonto ?
answer:
Si vous utilisez les fonds de votre société pour augmenter son capital, cela constitue une **augmentation de capital par incorporation de réserves**. Ce type d'augmentation ne nécessite pas de certificat de dépôt de fonds et ne relève pas du service proposé par Qonto.

Qonto accompagne uniquement les **augmentations de capital par apports en numéraire**, où les fonds doivent provenir d’un **compte personnel au nom du souscripteur personne physique** ou d’un compte professionnel **au nom de la société pour un souscripteur personne morale**.

Pour une augmentation par incorporation de réserves, nous vous conseillons de consulter votre comptable ou votre formaliste.

query: Kann ich die Qonto App auch ohne Google- oder Apple-Konto nutzen?
answer:
Ja, Sie können die Qonto App auch ohne Google- oder Apple-Konto nutzen, indem Sie die Android-Anwendung direkt über diesen [Link](https://qonto-mobile-app.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/public/latest/qonto-release.apk) herunterladen.

Dazu müssen Sie in den Einstellungen Ihres Geräts die Installation von Apps aus unbekannten Quellen erlauben (Einstellungen > Sicherheit > Unbekannte Apps zulassen). Beachten Sie jedoch, dass Sie selbst für die Updates der App verantwortlich sind, da diese nicht automatisch über den Play Store oder App Store erfolgen. Zudem können wir keine optimale Funktionsweise garantieren, da die App für die Nutzung über den [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.qonto.qonto&hl=fr) oder [App Store](https://itunes.apple.com/fr/app/qonto/id1214811644?mt=8) optimiert ist. Diese Option sollte daher nur als letzte Lösung in Betracht gezogen werden.

query: What should I do if the name on my transfer doesn’t match the beneficiary’s account details?
answer: If the name on your transfer doesn’t match the beneficiary’s account details, the transfer may be declined. To resolve this, ensure that the name of the beneficiary you have registered matches exactly the one indicated on the RIB (Relevé d'Identité Bancaire). Double-check for any spelling errors or discrepancies and correct them before attempting the transfer again. If you continue to experience issues, you can contact our Customer Support Team for further assistance.

query: Can I schedule multiple reminders for the same unpaid invoice?
answer: Yes, you can schedule up to 5 automated payment reminders for the same client. You can customize the timing of each reminder, such as sending the first reminder a few days before the due date, another on the due date, and additional follow-ups after the due date. This allows you to create a sequence of reminders to ensure your client is notified multiple times about the unpaid invoice.

query: What happens if I block my card temporarily but then find it later?
answer:
If you temporarily block your card and then find it later, you can easily unblock it to use it again. The temporary suspension does not permanently disable the card, and you can reverse the action by following these steps:

1. Go to the **‘Business Account’** section and click on **'Cards'**.
2. Select the card you want to unblock.
3. Click on **'Unblock card'**.
4. Enter your password and confirm by selecting **'Unblock this card'**.

Once unblocked, your card will be active again, and you can use it as usual. Note that if you are an employee, you may need approval from your Admin or Manager to unblock the card.

query: Est-ce que je peux utiliser le terminal Zettle avec mon téléphone portable ?
answer: Oui, vous pouvez utiliser le terminal Zettle avec votre téléphone portable. Le terminal Zettle Reader 2 est conçu pour fonctionner avec un smartphone ou une tablette, vous permettant de gérer vos encaissements où que vous soyez. Il vous suffit de connecter le terminal à votre appareil via Bluetooth et d'utiliser l'application Zettle pour accepter les paiements par carte, y compris les cartes à puce, sans contact, ainsi que les paiements mobiles comme Apple Pay, Google Pay et Samsung Pay. Assurez-vous simplement d'être connecté à un réseau 3G, 4G ou WiFi pour utiliser le service.

query: What do I do if I forgot my PIN and can't remember it at all?
answer: If you forgot your PIN and can't remember it at all, you won't be able to reset it for security reasons. In this case, you will need to delete the card and order a new one. You can do this by following the steps to [delete your current card](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23950991107345) and then [order a new one](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23951014900881). Once you receive the new card, you will be able to set a new PIN.

query: Do I need to manually upload my OVH invoices to Qonto after setting up the integration?
answer: No, you don’t need to manually upload your OVH invoices to Qonto after setting up the integration. Once connected, your OVH invoices will flow automatically into your Qonto account. The integration retrieves invoices daily and uses smart technology to match them to your transactions, eliminating the need for manual downloads or uploads. If an automatic match isn’t possible, you’ll simply be asked to confirm it manually. This ensures seamless and hassle-free invoice management.

query: Can I still use my free trial if I switch from an annual to a monthly billing plan?
answer: Yes, you can still be eligible for the Smart Plan free trial if you switch from an annual to a monthly billing plan, as long as you have never used the free trial before. The eligibility is based on whether you've previously activated the trial, not on your billing cycle. Once you switch to monthly billing, you can proceed to activate your free trial by following the steps in your Qonto account.

query: Can I still edit a quote after it has expired but hasn't been approved yet?
answer: Yes, you can still edit a quote after it has expired if it is still in the **Pending approval** status. To do so, click on the quote from your quotes list, then select the **Edit quote** button to modify the details, such as extending the validity date. Once you’ve made the necessary changes, save the quote and share it again with your client. A quote remains editable as long as it hasn’t been transformed into an invoice.

query: Est-ce que je peux déposer des espèces sur mon compte Qonto ?
answer: Non, le dépôt d'argent liquide n'est pas autorisé sur un compte Qonto. Contrairement à une banque traditionnelle, Qonto est un établissement de paiement qui ne propose pas cette fonctionnalité. Vous pouvez cependant effectuer des virements, des prélèvements ou déposer des chèques pour alimenter votre compte.

query: How long does it take to get a SEPA Creditor Identifier if my company is based in France?
answer: If your company is based in France, Qonto will request the SEPA Creditor Identifier (SCI) from the Banque de France on your behalf. This process takes up to 2 business days. The Banque de France charges a fee of 50 EUR (60 EUR VAT included) for issuing the SCI.

query: ¿Puedo enviar una foto de un ticket de compra por WhatsApp para que se asocie a un pago en Qonto?
answer: Sí, puedes enviar una foto de un ticket de compra por WhatsApp para que se asocie a un pago en Qonto. La integración con WhatsApp permite compartir fotos y documentos (en formatos como HEIC, HEIF, JPEG, JPG, PNG o PDF) para que se importen automáticamente a la sección de facturas de proveedores. Qonto extraerá los datos del ticket y lo asociará con el pago correspondiente, siempre que el pago esté registrado en tu cuenta Qonto o en una cuenta agregada. Asegúrate de que el archivo no supere los 15 MB y de que la empresa correcta esté vinculada a tu número de teléfono si tienes varias cuentas.

query: Perché non riesco a trovare la sezione Finanziamenti sull'app mobile di Qonto?
answer:
La sezione **Finanziamenti** è disponibile esclusivamente sull'app Web di Qonto e non sull'app mobile. Puoi accedervi solo da computer, tramite il tuo browser, se sei un Admin o un Titolare del conto Qonto e rappresentante dell’impresa o titolare effettivo.

Per utilizzare questa funzione, collegati alla versione web di Qonto dal tuo computer e cerca la sezione dedicata ai finanziamenti nel menu.

query: Perché mi arriva un codice via SMS quando pago online con la carta Qonto?
answer:
Il codice che ricevi via SMS durante un pagamento online con la carta Qonto è parte del sistema di sicurezza **3D Secure (3DS)**, che protegge le tue transazioni da frodi.

Se l'esercente utilizza la versione precedente di 3DS (e non quella più recente, 3DSv2) o se hai abilitato solo l'**autenticazione a due fattori (2FA)** sul tuo conto Qonto, il sistema invia un codice univoco al numero di telefono associato al tuo conto. Questo codice deve essere inserito nella pagina di pagamento per confermare la transazione.

Questo meccanismo garantisce che solo tu, il legittimo titolare della carta, possa autorizzare il pagamento, aggiungendo un ulteriore livello di sicurezza. Se preferisci un metodo più avanzato, puoi abilitare l'**autenticazione forte (SCA)** per ricevere notifiche dirette sull'app Qonto invece di un SMS.

query: Why hasn't my deposit been released yet after my rental?
answer:
The release of a deposit depends on the amount and the process involved:

- If the deposit was **less than €1,000**, it will be automatically released within a **maximum of 9 calendar days** from the pre-authorization date. The merchant controls this process, and Qonto cannot intervene to speed it up.

- If the deposit was **€1,000 or more**, it will be released within a **maximum of 31 calendar days**. However, if you provide us with **the closing card receipt** from the merchant (which must include the last 4 digits of the card and the file number), we can release the funds earlier.

Please check the amount and the timeline based on the date of pre-authorization. If you have a closing receipt for a deposit of €1,000 or more, you can send it to us to expedite the release.

query: Est-ce que je peux utiliser ma carte Qonto avant de l'avoir reçue physiquement ?
answer:
Oui, vous pouvez utiliser votre carte Qonto avant de la recevoir physiquement. Dès sa création, votre carte est utilisable en ligne pour des achats sur internet. Vous pouvez également l'ajouter à **Apple Pay** ou **Google Pay** pour effectuer des paiements en magasin sans avoir la carte physique en votre possession.

Pour utiliser votre carte en ligne, vous aurez besoin des détails de la carte (numéro, date d'expiration et CVV), que vous pouvez trouver directement dans votre application Qonto. Consultez [cet article](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947724365073-Comment-conna%C3%AEtre-le-num%C3%A9ro-de-sa-carte-son-CVV-et-sa-date-d-expiration) pour savoir où les trouver.

Si vous souhaitez payer avec votre carte physique avant de la recevoir, vous pouvez suivre les instructions détaillées dans [cette FAQ](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947627043729-Comment-payer-avec-ma-carte-physique-avant-de-la-recevoir).

query: What should I do if my SEPA Direct Debit is rejected because my account balance is too low?
answer: If your SEPA Direct Debit is rejected due to a low account balance, you should top up your Qonto account as soon as possible. The direct debit will remain pending for 48 working hours, giving you time to add funds and avoid rejection. To prevent this in the future, regularly monitor your balance using the Qonto mobile app or your online dashboard. If you need further assistance, you can contact Qonto support via chat, phone, or social media.

query: ¿Por qué mi familiar recibió menos dinero del que le envié en una transferencia internacional?
answer:
En las transferencias internacionales en divisa, es posible que el beneficiario reciba un importe diferente al enviado debido a comisiones aplicadas por el banco receptor o bancos intermediarios. Estas comisiones pueden ser cobradas de dos formas:

1. **Facturadas por separado**: El banco receptor cobra la comisión directamente al beneficiario, reduciendo así el monto recibido.
2. **Deducción directa**: El banco receptor resta la comisión del importe total de la transferencia antes de entregarlo al beneficiario.

Por ejemplo, si envías 1.000 dólares y el banco receptor cobra una comisión de 15 dólares, tu familiar podría recibir 985 dólares en lugar de los 1.000 enviados. Esto ocurre porque Wise utiliza el modo **SHA** ("costes compartidos"), donde las comisiones de los bancos intermediarios o receptores pueden afectar el monto final.

Para evitar sorpresas, te recomendamos consultar las tarifas del banco beneficiario antes de realizar la transferencia.

query: Cosa succede se sbaglio a inserire i dati dell'autofattura?
answer:
Se sbagli a inserire i dati dell’autofattura, potresti ricevere un rifiuto dal Sistema di Interscambio (SdI). In questo caso, Qonto ti invierà un’email automatica con le indicazioni su come correggere l’errore. Se l’autofattura risulta **Rifiutata** o **Non inviata**, dovrai verificare i dati inseriti e riprovare, eventualmente con l’assistenza del Servizio clienti.

Ricorda che puoi controllare lo stato dell’autofattura nella sezione **Documenti correlati** della fattura del fornitore estero, dove troverai anche lo **Stato SdI**. Se necessario, puoi eliminare l’autofattura contattando il Servizio clienti di Qonto.

query: Comment puis-je trouver une assurance pour mon matériel informatique depuis mon compte Qonto ?
answer: Pour trouver une assurance pour votre matériel informatique depuis votre compte Qonto, rendez-vous dans la **section Assurances** de votre espace client. Cette section propose des offres adaptées à votre secteur d'activité, y compris des assurances pour l'équipement informatique. Sélectionnez l'offre qui vous intéresse, consultez les détails, puis cliquez sur “Obtenir un devis”. Vous serez redirigé vers la plateforme de l'assureur partenaire (comme Stello) pour finaliser votre souscription ou être contacté par un agent. Cette démarche est simplifiée et centralisée directement depuis votre compte Qonto.

query: Do I need to share my Qonto password directly with Evoliz to set up the integration?
answer: No, you do not need to share your Qonto password directly with Evoliz. The integration is facilitated through secure aggregators like Libeo or Bridge by Bankin, which handle the connection. When setting up the integration, you will enter your Qonto credentials within the Evoliz platform, but the process is encrypted and compliant with PSD2 regulations to ensure your data remains protected. This means your login information is secure, and no one can access your credentials or data.

query: Est-ce que je peux utiliser le Paiement fractionné pour une facture de 100 € ?
answer: Non, le montant minimum pour utiliser la fonctionnalité Paiement fractionné est de 150 €. Les factures inférieures à ce montant ne sont pas éligibles. Vous pouvez consulter les critères de validité des factures pour plus de détails.

query: Wenn mein Unternehmen zu 20 % mir und zu 80 % einer ausländischen Firma gehört, wer gilt dann als wirtschaftlich Berechtigter?
answer:
In Ihrem Fall gilt die ausländische Firma als wirtschaftlich Berechtigte, da sie mit 80 % einen Anteil von mehr als 25 % am Unternehmen hält. Da es sich bei der ausländischen Firma jedoch um eine juristische Person handelt, müssen Sie die natürlichen Personen identifizieren, die diese Firma kontrollieren. Dies erfolgt nach den gleichen Kriterien wie bei Kapitalgesellschaften:

1. **Anteilseigner**: Natürliche Personen, die direkt oder indirekt mindestens 25 % der Anteile an der ausländischen Firma halten.
2. **Kontrollmechanismen**: Falls keine natürliche Person 25 % oder mehr hält, werden die Personen berücksichtigt, die die Mehrheit der Stimmrechte kontrollieren, dominierenden Einfluss ausüben oder vertragliche Befugnisse zur Leitung der Firma besitzen.

Sie müssen daher die Eigentums- und Kontrollstruktur der ausländischen Firma offenlegen, um die wirtschaftlich Berechtigten gemäß den gesetzlichen Vorgaben zu bestimmen.

query: Can I use a different email address to sign in with Google or Apple than the one I used to create my Qonto account?
answer:
No, you must use the same email address associated with your Qonto account when signing in with Google or Apple. For example, if you registered with **jane.doe@gmail.com**, you need to use that same email address to log in via Google or Apple. This ensures consistency and security for your account access.

If you used Apple's "Hide My Email" feature during account creation, you must continue using the forwarded email address provided by Apple to sign in.

query: ¿Cómo puedo enviar mi currículum para trabajar en Qonto?
answer: Para enviar tu currículum y postularte a un puesto en Qonto, puedes revisar nuestras [ofertas de trabajo disponibles](https://qonto.com/es/careers) en la página de carreras. Allí encontrarás las vacantes abiertas y podrás presentar tu candidatura directamente a través del formulario en línea. Estamos siempre en busca de talento y nos encantará conocer tu perfil y lo que puedes aportar al equipo.

query: Perché alcune fatture non vengono abbinate automaticamente alle transazioni e come posso risolvere il problema?
answer:
Alcune fatture potrebbero non essere abbinate automaticamente alle transazioni per diversi motivi, come informazioni illeggibili, dati mancanti o una dimensione del file superiore a 15 MB. Per risolvere il problema, puoi seguire questi passaggi:

1. **Verifica lo stato della fattura**: Accedi alla sezione **Fatture dei fornitori** e controlla se la fattura è presente nella cartella **Importate**. Qui troverai le fatture che non sono state abbinate automaticamente, ordinate per data di scadenza.

2. **Collega manualmente la fattura alla transazione**:
   - Clicca sulla fattura che desideri associare.
   - Premi il pulsante **Segna come pagata**.
   - Seleziona la transazione corretta dall’elenco o, se non vuoi collegarla a nessuna transazione, clicca su **Continua senza transazioni**.

3. **Controlla i dettagli del documento**: Assicurati che la fattura sia leggibile e contenga tutte le informazioni necessarie, come il numero di partita IVA e l’importo. Se il file è troppo grande, riduci la dimensione e riprova a importarlo.

Se la fattura non è presente nelle sezioni **Importate** o **In elaborazione**, puoi anche caricarla manualmente nella sezione **Transazioni** cliccando sulla transazione corrispondente.

query: Warum brauche ich eine UMR-Nummer für meine SEPA-Lastschrift?
answer:
Die UMR (Unique Mandate Reference) ist ein eindeutiger Code, der jede SEPA-Lastschrift identifiziert und sicherstellt, dass Abbuchungen korrekt Ihrem spezifischen Vertrag oder Ihrer Vereinbarung mit dem Händler zugeordnet werden.

Da ein Händler mehrere Dienstleistungen oder Verträge mit Ihnen haben kann (z. B. separate Abonnements für Mobilfunk und Internet), ermöglicht die UMR eine klare Unterscheidung zwischen diesen verschiedenen Zahlungen. Ohne die UMR wäre es nicht möglich, die Abbuchungen eindeutig zuzuordnen, was zu Verwirrung oder Fehlern führen könnte.

Die UMR ist somit ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des SEPA-Lastschriftmandats, um Transparenz und Sicherheit bei wiederkehrenden Zahlungen zu gewährleisten.

query: J’ai acheté un ordinateur portable avec ma carte Qonto PLUS, mais il est tombé en panne après quelques semaines. Est-ce que l’assurance achat peut le couvrir ?
answer: Oui, votre ordinateur portable est couvert par l'assurance achat de votre carte Qonto PLUS, car il s'agit d'un produit acheté intégralement avec votre carte et il entre dans la catégorie des biens éligibles (appareils électroniques). L'assurance couvre les dommages accidentels, y compris les pannes, à condition que l'achat soit supérieur à 50 €. Vous pouvez prétendre à une indemnité allant jusqu'à 1 250 € par demande, dans la limite de 2 500 € par an. Pour faire valoir votre droit, vous devrez fournir les preuves d'achat et un rapport de panne.

query: What happens if I don’t recognize a direct debit that was taken from my account?
answer:
If you don’t recognize a direct debit taken from your account, you can request a refund. For a SEPA Core Direct Debit, you have up to 8 weeks to dispute the transaction without needing to provide a justification. If the transaction was unauthorized, you have up to 13 months to dispute it.

To request a refund, you can do so directly from your computer or mobile app. On your desktop, go to the **Business Account** in the **History** tab, select the debit, and click **Request a refund** in the transaction details. On your mobile, you can initiate the refund by clicking on the email announcing the upcoming direct debit.

Once requested, the refund will typically be processed within 24 hours on working days. However, note that this process does not apply to SEPA B2B Direct Debits, as they cannot be disputed.

query: Can I withdraw money from an ATM with my Qonto card?
answer: Yes, you can withdraw money from any ATM using your Qonto card. Qonto offers physical cards that allow you to make cash withdrawals at ATMs. However, please note that Qonto does not process cash deposits or offer a cash float for security reasons.

query: Can I use a virtual card to make payments in physical stores?
answer: Yes, you can use a virtual card to make payments in physical stores by adding it to **Apple Pay or Google Pay**. However, it is not possible to withdraw cash with a virtual card.

query: Perché la mia transazione Tap to Pay su iPhone è stata rifiutata anche se la carta è supportata?
answer:
La tua transazione Tap to Pay su iPhone potrebbe essere stata rifiutata per diversi motivi, anche se la carta è supportata. Ecco le possibili cause e come risolverle:

1. **Posizione errata della carta**: Assicurati che il cliente tenga la carta in posizione orizzontale sopra il simbolo contactless nella parte superiore del tuo iPhone. Se necessario, chiedi di far scorrere la carta per centrare il chip sopra la tacca del dispositivo.

2. **Timeout di lettura**: La carta potrebbe non essere stata tenuta abbastanza a lungo. Chiedi al cliente di mantenere la carta sopra l’iPhone per alcuni secondi per completare la lettura.

3. **Pagamento contactless disabilitato**: Anche se la carta è supportata, la funzione contactless potrebbe essere disattivata. Consiglia al cliente di verificare nell’app della sua banca o di contattare l’emittente per abilitarla.

4. **Rifiuto dell’emittente**: La banca del cliente potrebbe aver bloccato la transazione per motivi come saldo insufficiente o limiti di sicurezza. Suggerisci al cliente di controllare il saldo o contattare la banca per maggiori dettagli.

5. **Carta danneggiata**: Se l’iPhone non rileva la carta e non visualizza messaggi, l’antenna contactless potrebbe essere danneggiata. In questo caso, prova con un’altra carta o metodo di pagamento.

Se il problema persiste, verifica che l’iPhone sia compatibile (modello XS o successivo con iOS 18.0 o superiore) e che la connessione Internet sia stabile. Per ulteriori assistenza, contatta il nostro servizio clienti.

query: Can I change the amount of a scheduled international transfer after I've set it up?
answer: No, you cannot change the amount of a scheduled international transfer after it has been set up. If you need to modify the amount, you will have to cancel the existing transfer and create a new one with the updated details. Other aspects like the account to be debited and the beneficiary also cannot be edited once the transfer is scheduled. However, you can still edit certain details such as the frequency and end date of a recurring transfer.

query: Can I change the VAT rate for a supplier after I've already added them?
answer: Yes, you can change the VAT rate for a supplier after adding them. To do this, go to the **Supplier List** section, click on the three dots next to the supplier’s name, and select **"✏️ Edit supplier."** In the legal information section, you can update the VAT rate and save your changes. The new VAT rate will apply to future transactions, though you can still adjust it at the transaction level if needed.

query: How do I check if my business qualifies for automatic payment collection from clients?
answer:
To check if your business qualifies for automatic payment collection from clients, follow these steps:

1. Ensure you are the **Owner** or an **Admin** on the Qonto account.
2. Go to the **Business Account** section in your Qonto dashboard.
3. Click on **Incoming direct debits**.
4. If the button **"Start setting up"** appears on the screen, your business is eligible for direct debit collection.

Additionally, your business must meet the following eligibility criteria:
- Registered for at least **9 months**.
- A Qonto customer for at least **6 months**.
- Fully operational (not in the process of closing).
- **2-step authentication** activated on your Qonto account.
- No history of being a debtor or having account seizures.
- A **refund rate** for direct debits lower than **20%** (if previously used).

Eligibility is reassessed monthly, so check your status regularly. If eligible, you can proceed with setting up direct debit collection. For more details, refer to the [direct debit setup guide](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/25012107576209).

query: ¿Puedo conectar Qonto con Evoliz sin usar Libeo o Bridge?
answer: No, actualmente la conexión entre Qonto y Evoliz solo es posible a través de los agregadores Libeo o Bridge. Estos intermediarios garantizan una transferencia segura de tus datos, cumpliendo con los estándares de protección como la directiva PSD2 de la UE. Tanto Libeo como Bridge encriptan la información, por lo que tus credenciales y transacciones permanecen seguras durante el proceso.

query: Quels documents dois-je fournir si un investisseur étranger participe à mon augmentation de capital ?
answer:
Pour un investisseur étranger participant à votre augmentation de capital, vous devez fournir les documents suivants :

1. **Un justificatif d'immatriculation** de la société étrangère, en version originale et traduite en anglais. Voici quelques exemples selon le pays :
   - **États-Unis** : *Certificate of Good Standing*
   - **Royaume-Uni** : *Certificate of incorporation*
   - **Allemagne** : *Eintragungsnachweis (des Handelsregisters)*
   - **Espagne** : *Escrituras de constitución*
   - **Italie** : *Certificato di iscrizione nella sezione ordinaria*

2. Si l'investisseur est un fonds d’investissement, vous devrez également fournir :
   - L’extrait AMF du fonds (si applicable)
   - Le règlement du fonds
   - Le Kbis de la société de gestion (daté de moins de 3 mois)

Ces documents sont nécessaires pour valider la participation de l'investisseur étranger dans le cadre de votre augmentation de capital.

query: Wie lange habe ich Zeit, um die fehlenden Dokumente nach der Kontoeröffnung bei Qonto nachzureichen?
answer: Sie haben 60 Tage Zeit, um die fehlenden Dokumente nach der Kontoeröffnung bei Qonto nachzureichen. Falls die Dokumente nach Ablauf dieser Frist nicht vorliegen, wird Ihr Konto für weitere 60 Tage gesperrt, während derer Sie nur noch Einsicht haben, aber keine Transaktionen mehr durchführen können. Innerhalb dieser 60 Tage können Sie die fehlenden Unterlagen nachträglich hochladen. Geschieht dies nicht, muss das Konto leider endgültig geschlossen werden.

query: Se elimino una cartella su OneDrive, i giustificativi al suo interno verranno persi definitivamente?
answer: Se elimini una cartella nel tuo spazio di archiviazione OneDrive, i giustificativi associati a quella cartella verranno cancellati definitivamente dal tuo spazio di archiviazione. Per recuperarli, sarà necessario riconfigurare l'integrazione tra Qonto e OneDrive.

query: Comment savoir si ma voiture est considérée comme 3 CV ou plus pour le remboursement des frais kilométriques ?
answer:
Pour déterminer la puissance fiscale de votre voiture (exprimée en CV ou chevaux fiscaux), vous pouvez consulter votre carte grise (certificat d'immatriculation). La puissance fiscale est indiquée dans la case **P.6** de ce document.

Si vous ne disposez pas de votre carte grise, vous pouvez également trouver cette information sur votre certificat d'assurance ou en contactant votre assureur.

Une fois que vous connaissez la puissance fiscale de votre véhicule, vous pouvez vous référer au barème des frais kilométriques pour connaître le taux de remboursement applicable en fonction de la distance parcourue.

query: Wie lange dauert es, bis sich mein Lastschrift-Einzugslimit erhöht, nachdem ich ein externes Konto verknüpft habe?
answer: Die Erhöhung Ihres Lastschrift-Einzugslimits nach der Verknüpfung eines externen Kontos erfolgt in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten. Die genaue Anpassung hängt jedoch von der Höhe der Einzahlungen auf Ihren Konten sowie der Gesamtbewertung der Kontoaktivitäten und des Risikos durch Qonto ab.

query: Wie lange dauert es, bis eine beantragte Karte nach der Genehmigung nutzbar ist?
answer: Sobald ein Kartenantrag genehmigt wurde, ist die Karte in der Regel sofort nutzbar. Virtuelle Karten und Instant Cards stehen dem Mitarbeiter unmittelbar nach der Freigabe zur Verfügung, sodass keine zusätzliche Wartezeit entsteht. Die Karte kann dann direkt für die vorgesehenen Ausgaben verwendet werden.

query: ¿Qué pasa si no tengo documentos para justificar la disputa de un pago?
answer:
Si no tienes documentos para justificar la disputa de un pago, aún puedes presentar la reclamación. Sin embargo, es importante que proporciones la mayor cantidad de detalles posibles en la descripción del problema. Cuanta más información incluyas sobre la transacción, el motivo de la disputa y cualquier interacción con el comerciante, mejor podremos evaluar tu caso.

Aunque los documentos son útiles para respaldar tu reclamación, nuestro equipo revisará la situación basada en la información que proporciones. Si surge alguna duda o necesitas asistencia adicional, nuestro equipo de atención al cliente estará disponible para ayudarte en el proceso.

query: Can I use a regular Excel file to make multiple payments at once, or do I need a specific format?
answer: To make multiple payments at once using a bulk transfer, you need to use a specific format. While you can create the file in Excel, it must follow Qonto's .CSV template to ensure compatibility. This template is designed to structure your payment details correctly for upload. Alternatively, you can use the .XML format if you're exporting data directly from accounting or payment tools like PayFit. Both formats are supported, but a regular Excel file without the proper template won't work. You can download the .CSV template from the Qonto app or at the end of [this article](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949961425937).

query: What happens if I accidentally change something in the transaction tab of my Qonto Google Sheets?
answer:
If you accidentally edit the **`Sync. Transactions - Do not edit`** tab in your Qonto Google Sheets, the connection will break, and the automatic synchronization of your transactions will stop. To avoid this, you should create a separate tab in the spreadsheet for any modifications and reference the data from the protected tab instead of editing it directly.

If the connection is already broken, you may need to reconfigure the integration by following the setup steps again in the **Integrations and Partnerships** section of your Qonto app.

query: What happens if I accidentally send money to the wrong account?
answer:
If you accidentally send money to the wrong account, you can request a recalled transfer. This involves your bank asking to cancel the transaction, provided the mistake was due to an incorrect amount or IBAN, or if the transfer was executed multiple times by accident.

To proceed, your bank will submit a recall request, and our team will analyze it. For the cancellation to be approved, a Qonto account Admin must validate the request. If validated, the transfer will be canceled, and the funds may be refunded to the emitter. If the request is not validated, the transfer will remain as is, and the funds will not be returned.

In cases where fraud is suspected, our team will investigate further before deciding whether to approve the cancellation.

query: Can I create multiple projects for the same client at the same time?
answer: Yes, you can create multiple projects for the same client simultaneously. This allows you to manage different deals or sales opportunities independently within a single client relationship. Each project can have its own status, linked documents, and tracking details, giving you flexibility in organizing your sales pipeline.

query: Kann ich das Guthaben auf meiner Instant Card nachträglich erhöhen?
answer: Ja, Sie können das Guthaben auf Ihrer Instant Card nachträglich erhöhen, solange die Karte noch gültig ist. Gehen Sie dazu in den Bereich **Geschäftskonto > Karten**, wählen Sie die entsprechende Instant Card aus und passen Sie das Zahlungslimit an. Beachten Sie jedoch, dass das Ablaufdatum der Karte nicht geändert werden kann.

query: Can I approve or reject Qonto requests directly from Slack without opening the app?
answer: Yes, you can approve or reject Qonto requests directly from Slack without opening the app. The Slack Requests integration allows you to handle pending requests for flash cards, virtual cards, transfers, and multi-transfers right within your Slack workspace. Once you receive the daily notification at 8:00 AM, you can take action directly in Slack, and your decision will be automatically reflected in the Qonto app.

query: Kann ich als Teamleiter die Ausgaben meiner Mitarbeiter einsehen, ohne Admin zu sein?
answer:
Ja, als Teamleiter mit der Managerrolle auf Qonto können Sie die Ausgaben Ihrer Teammitglieder einsehen, ohne Admin zu sein. Mit dieser Rolle haben Sie Zugriff auf die **Teammitglieder, Umsätze und Karten** des von Ihnen betreuten Teams. So können Sie Transaktionen filtern, Kartennutzungen verfolgen und die Ausgaben Ihres Teams in Echtzeit überwachen.

Hinweis: Pro Team kann nur ein Mitglied mit Managerrolle hinzugefügt werden. Diese Funktion steht in den Tarifen Essential, Business und Enterprise zur Verfügung.

query: Can I use payment links for recurring payments from the same customer?
answer:
Payment links in Qonto are designed primarily for one-time or standalone payments rather than recurring payments. However, you can create a **reusable standalone payment link** that allows multiple payments from different clients, including the same customer if needed.

If you require a dedicated recurring payment solution, you may need to explore alternative options, as payment links are not specifically tailored for automated recurring billing. For recurring payments, consider setting up direct debits or other automated payment methods supported by your business tools.

You can track all payments received through a reusable payment link in the payment link details screen, where you’ll see the payer’s email and payment date.

query: Why can't I find the Qonto app on my phone?
answer:
There could be a few reasons why you can't find the Qonto app on your phone:

1. **Incompatible Operating System**: Your phone's operating system (OS) might be outdated. The Qonto app requires a minimum OS version to function properly. Check the [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.qonto.qonto) for Android or the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/qonto-business-finance-app/id1214811644) for iOS to see the minimum required version for your device.

2. **App Not Updated or Installed**: If you previously had the app but can't find it now, it might have been accidentally uninstalled. You can download it again from the respective app store.

3. **Device Compatibility**: Some older devices may not support the latest versions of the Qonto app due to hardware or software limitations. If your device is too old and cannot be updated to the required OS version, you may need to use a different device.

4. **Search Issue**: Try searching for "Qonto" directly in the app store. If it still doesn't appear, your device might not meet the requirements.

To resolve this, ensure your device is running the latest OS version and meets the minimum requirements listed in the app store. If you continue to experience issues, consider using a compatible device or accessing Qonto through the [web version](https://app.qonto.com/signin), though some features may require the mobile app for authentication.

query: What do I need to do to get my money back for a work expense I paid myself?
answer:
To get your money back for a work expense you paid yourself, follow these steps on Qonto:

1. **Complete your registration** on Qonto using the personal link sent to your email (if you haven’t already).
2. Go to the **Requests** section and click on **Expense Report**.
3. **Upload your receipt** by taking a photo or importing it, then fill in the required details for your request.
4. **Track the status** of your expense report in real time. Once approved, you’ll receive your reimbursement.

For additional guidance, refer to [this FAQ article](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949201770897).

query: Kann ich für jedes Unterkonto eine separate Karte bekommen?
answer: Ja, für jedes Unterkonto können Sie separate Zahlungsmittel, einschließlich Karten, einrichten. Das bedeutet, dass Sie für jedes Ihrer Unterkonten eine eigene Karte beantragen und verwalten können. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Ausgaben zu trennen oder verschiedenen Teams oder Projekten dedizierte Karten zuzuweisen. Die Verwaltung der Karten erfolgt dabei unabhängig voneinander über die Qonto-App.

query: What happens if I dispute a transaction but the merchant doesn't respond within the 7-day period?
answer: If the merchant does not respond within the 7-day period after you've contacted them regarding a commercial dispute, you can proceed to file a claim for the transaction through your app. The lack of response from the merchant allows you to escalate the dispute for further resolution. Ensure you have documentation of your attempt to resolve the issue with the merchant before initiating the claim.

query: Why don't I see the option to filter transactions with missing receipts?
answer:
The option to filter transactions with missing receipts is available under the **Custom views** button on the **Transactions** page in your Qonto account. If you don’t see this option, it could be due to one of the following reasons:

1. **Plan Limitations**: Missing-receipt reminders and filtering options are available only on the **Smart, Premium, Essential, Business, and Enterprise plans**. If you’re on a different plan, you may not have access to this feature.
2. **Permissions**: Ensure you have the necessary permissions (e.g., Admin, Account Holder, or Manager) to view or filter transactions with missing attachments.
3. **Custom Views Setup**: Click on **Custom views** in the **Transactions** section, then select **Missing attachments** to filter transactions without receipts. If this option isn’t visible, check if your account settings or filters are configured correctly.

If you still can’t see the option, contact Qonto support for further assistance.

query: What do I need to do to get a higher spending limit on my advertising card?
answer:
To request a higher spending limit on your advertising card, you need to meet the following eligibility criteria:

1. Maintain an average balance of over €1,000,000 in your account over the last 3 months.
2. Spend over €100,000 on online advertising for 3 consecutive months using any payment method.

If you meet these conditions, you can request a higher limit by emailing hello@qonto.com with:
- Your name
- Your company name
- The desired limit amount
- A brief explanation of why you need the higher limit

Our team will review your request and guide you through the next steps. Approval is subject to Qonto's evaluation.

query: ¿Puedo usar mi cuenta de Qonto para ingresar el dinero de una ampliación de capital de mi empresa?
answer: No, no puedes utilizar tu cuenta Qonto para ingresar el dinero de una ampliación de capital de tu empresa. Según la normativa española, tanto el depósito inicial como las ampliaciones de capital deben realizarse en una entidad de crédito, ya que Qonto es una entidad de pago y los documentos que emitimos no tienen validez legal ante notario. Te recomendamos acudir a un banco tradicional para este trámite.

query: Wie oft werden meine Belege von Qonto zu OneDrive synchronisiert?
answer: Ihre Belege werden täglich um 23:30 Uhr von Qonto zu OneDrive synchronisiert. Bestehende Belege werden sofort nach der Einrichtung exportiert, während neue Belege im Rahmen der täglichen Synchronisation übertragen werden.

query: Can I deposit cash into my Qonto account?
answer: No, Qonto does not allow cash deposits into your account. Unlike traditional banks, Qonto operates as a payment institution and focuses on digital banking solutions, such as debit cards, transfers, and online payments. If you need to deposit cash, you would need to use a traditional bank account that offers this service.

query: Does my insurance cover purchases made with a virtual card?
answer: No, purchases made with a virtual card are not covered by insurance. Insurance coverage is only available for transactions made with physical cards. However, if you also have a physical card in your name, all your card transactions—including those made with virtual cards—will benefit from the insurance coverage corresponding to your physical card’s level.

query: What should I do if I forget my Qonto card PIN?
answer: If you forget your Qonto card PIN, you can easily retrieve it through the Qonto mobile app. Your PIN code is available at any time in the app, so you can check it whenever you need to. Simply open the app, navigate to your card details, and you’ll find your PIN there. This ensures you can always access it securely without any hassle.

query: Can I edit a beneficiary's details after I've already sent them a transfer?
answer:
Yes, you can edit a beneficiary's details even after sending them a transfer. Any changes you make will apply to all future transfers to that beneficiary.

To edit the details, go to the **Transfers** section in your Business Account on the web app or mobile app. Select the beneficiary, click on the three dots (or swipe left on mobile), and choose **Edit**. Update the information and save the changes. The updated details will be used for all subsequent transfers to this beneficiary.

If you have Strong Customer Authentication enabled, you may need to confirm the changes on your associated phone.

query: Can I change the role of an existing team member without inviting them again?
answer: No, if you want to change the role of an existing team member to another role, such as switching an accountant to an admin or manager, you will need to re-invite the user to the Qonto account. In this case, please contact Qonto support for assistance. This is necessary to ensure the proper permissions and security checks are applied for the new role.

query: Can I automatically send receipts from my Gmail to Qonto even if they don’t have attachments?
answer:
The automation process for sending receipts from Gmail to Qonto is designed to work with emails that have attachments, as it specifically looks for invoices or receipts attached to the email. If the receipts you receive do not have attachments, the filter may not capture them correctly.

However, you can still try setting up the filter without ticking the "Has attachment" box. This way, the filter will forward all emails from the specified sender to your Qonto address, even if they don’t include attachments. Keep in mind that this might result in non-receipt emails being forwarded as well, so you may need to manually verify the paired transactions in Qonto afterward.

For the best results, ensure that the receipts or invoices are included as attachments in the emails you want to automate. If they are embedded in the email body or sent as links, the automatic pairing might not work as intended.

query: What happens if I accidentally pay a bill twice using pagoPA?
answer:
Double payment with pagoPA is not possible because the system checks the existence of the debt position and its consistency at the time of payment. However, if you paid a tax both through pagoPA and another method (such as an F24), you must request a refund from the creditor body.

If the duplicate payment was made using pagoPA, the refund can be processed through pagoPA (reversing the operation) on the same day. If the request is made later, the creditor body will arrange the refund through other means.

query: Do I need to use my Qonto card for every purchase to be covered by the insurance?
answer: Yes, to be eligible for insurance coverage, all transactions must be made with your Qonto card. This is one of the main conditions for the assistance and insurance benefits to apply.

query: ¿Puedo ingresar dinero en mi cuenta Qonto desde un cajero automático?
answer: No, Qonto no permite depósitos en efectivo en cajeros automáticos ni en ninguna otra forma. Por motivos de seguridad y al ser una entidad de pago, solo puedes retirar dinero en efectivo con tus tarjetas Qonto, pero no ingresarlo. Para añadir fondos a tu cuenta, deberás hacerlo mediante transferencia bancaria u otros métodos electrónicos disponibles.

query: Why do I keep getting asked to log in again after some time on the Qonto platform?
answer: This is due to security measures implemented through cookies on the Qonto platform. One of the purposes of the cookies we use is to implement security measures, such as requiring you to log in again after a certain period of time. This helps protect your account and ensure that your session remains secure. You can adjust your cookie settings through your browser if you prefer, but please note that this may affect the functionality and security of your access to the platform.

query: Can I set up a recurring international transfer in the app?
answer: Yes, you can set up a recurring international transfer in the app. When creating an international transfer, tap on **Schedule** and enable the **Transfer recurrence** toggle. You can then select the interval (e.g., weekly, monthly) and set an end date if needed. Once configured, tap **Set schedule** to save your settings. This allows you to automate regular international transfers conveniently.

query: ¿Puedo hacer transferencias masivas a cuentas fuera de la zona SEPA con un archivo .XML?
answer: No, no es posible hacer transferencias masivas a cuentas fuera de la zona SEPA utilizando un archivo .XML en Qonto. El archivo debe contener únicamente IBANs pertenecientes a la zona SEPA. Si incluye algún IBAN fuera de esta zona, el sistema lo marcará como error y no se procesará la transferencia.

query: What do I need to do if I want to set up automatic payments for my business taxes?
answer:
To set up automatic payments for your business taxes using a SEPA B2B direct debit mandate, follow these steps:

1. **Sign the B2B mandate** provided by the tax authority (e.g., DGFIP, URSSAF).
2. **Log in to your Qonto mobile app** or **web application**:
   - **Mobile app**: Go to **Menu** > **Outgoing direct debits**, tap the **+** button, and upload the signed mandate. Enter the **Unique Mandate Reference (RUM)**, **SEPA Creditor Identifier (ICS)**, and select the payment frequency (one-off or recurring).
   - **Web app**: Navigate to **Business account** > **Outgoing direct debits**, click **Set up a new direct debit**, and fill in the required details (RUM, ICS, and payment type).
3. **Validate the mandate**. If you have strong authentication enabled, confirm the action via your associated phone.

**Note**: B2B mandates are irreversible—disputes must be resolved directly with the creditor. Ensure the mandate includes the phrase *"Inter-enterprise SEPA Direct Debit Mandate"* and states that refunds are not permitted.

For a visual guide, refer to the demo: [Qonto Direct Debit Setup](https://app.qonto.com?tdm=create-sdd-mandate).

query: What happens if I accidentally give an integration too much access to my Qonto account?
answer: If you accidentally grant an integration more access than intended, you can easily revoke or adjust its permissions at any time. Simply go to the "Partners & Integrations" section in your Qonto account and modify or remove the access as needed. This ensures you maintain full control over your data and account security. Additionally, all integrations are designed with targeted access, meaning they only interact with the necessary information, and sensitive actions require double authentication (SCA) for added protection. If you need assistance, our support team is available to help you manage these settings.

query: Wie bekomme ich meine alten Kontoauszüge von meinem Penta-Konto?
answer: Für Ihre alten Kontoauszüge des Penta-Kontos müssen Sie sich an die Solaris SE wenden, da diese die Bankdokumente rechtlich archiviert. Nutzen Sie bitte das [Kontaktformular der Solaris SE](https://support.solarisgroup.com/hc/de/requests/new?tf_4413551343634=penta_support), um Ihre Anfrage zu stellen. Weitere Informationen finden Sie auch in den [FAQs der Solaris SE](https://support.solarisgroup.com/hc/de/sections/14799643380242-Penta-Kundenservice).

query: Est-ce que je peux envoyer un virement sans avoir de facture ?
answer:
Oui, vous pouvez soumettre une demande de virement SEPA sans facture. Pour cela, accédez à la section **Virements SEPA en euros**, puis suivez les étapes suivantes :
1. Choisissez ou ajoutez un nouveau bénéficiaire.
2. Remplissez les informations requises (compte à débiter, montant, catégorie, référence).
3. Configurez éventuellement la date d'exécution, une récurrence, ajoutez des pièces jointes ou des détails comptables.
4. Validez votre demande, qui sera transmise aux administrateurs ou managers avancés pour approbation.

Une fois approuvée, le virement sera initié automatiquement.

query: What happens if my customer’s card doesn’t work when I try to use Tap to Pay on my iPhone?
answer:
If your customer’s card doesn’t work when using Tap to Pay on your iPhone, there are several possible reasons and steps you can take:

1. **Incorrect Card Position**: Ensure the customer holds their card or device horizontally above the contactless symbol at the top of your iPhone. If it still doesn’t work, ask them to slide the card to center the chip directly over the device's notch.

2. **Reading Timeout**: The card might not have been held long enough. Ask the customer to hold it steady for a few seconds to allow the NFC to read it properly.

3. **Unsupported Card**: Currently, only Visa and Mastercard are supported. If the customer is using a different card type (e.g., American Express), the transaction will not go through.

4. **Contactless Payment Disabled**: The customer’s card may not have contactless payments enabled. They should check their banking app or contact their bank to activate this feature.

5. **Issuer Decline**: The customer’s bank may have blocked the transaction due to reasons like insufficient funds or security concerns. Advise them to check their balance or contact their bank for more details.

6. **Damaged Card**: If the card still isn’t read and no error message appears, the card’s contactless antenna might be damaged, or the card may not support contactless payments at all.

If the issue persists, you can suggest alternative payment methods or contact Qonto’s customer support for further assistance.

query: Dove posso trovare i termini e condizioni che ho accettato quando ho aperto il conto?
answer: Puoi trovare i Termini e Condizioni (TOS) che hai accettato durante l'apertura del conto Qonto nell'email di benvenuto con l'oggetto **"Benvenuto in Qonto"**, inviata al termine della registrazione. In alternativa, puoi consultarli direttamente nella sezione **[Documenti legali](https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents)** sul nostro sito web. Se non trovi l'email, ti consigliamo di controllare anche la cartella dello spam.

query: What happens if I forget to upload a receipt for a transaction?
answer:
If you forget to upload a receipt for a transaction, the following will happen based on the rules set by your Admin or Owner:

1. **Late Receipt Notification**: The receipt will be marked as late after a certain number of days (as defined in the policy).
2. **Card Blocking Risk**: If you accumulate a specified number of late receipts, your card will be automatically blocked. You will receive warnings via email and push notifications before this happens.
3. **Notifications**: You will be notified when a receipt is late and when your card is at risk of being blocked (3 days and 1 day before blocking).

To avoid card blocking, you can upload the missing receipts. If your card is already blocked, you can either ask an Admin/Owner for a temporary unblock or upload the missing receipts to unblock it permanently. You can check your late receipts in the **Late receipts** section on the mobile or web app.

query: ¿Puedo ver las facturas de mis proveedores en la app móvil de Qonto o solo en el ordenador?
answer:
Actualmente, la gestión de las facturas de proveedores importadas desde el Sistema de Intercambio (SDI) solo está disponible en la versión de **ordenador** de Qonto. Para acceder a ellas, debes iniciar sesión desde un navegador web, hacer clic en **Compras** en el menú de navegación y luego seleccionar **Facturas de proveedores** en el menú desplegable. Desde allí, podrás ver, pagar y gestionar todas tus facturas de manera centralizada.

Si necesitas consultar estas facturas desde tu móvil, te recomendamos acceder a la versión web de Qonto a través del navegador de tu dispositivo.

query: Do I need to pay extra VAT on my Qonto subscription if my business is based in France?
answer: If your business is registered in France, a 20% VAT is added to your Qonto subscription cost. However, this VAT is deductible from the VAT you collect through your business activities. Essentially, you can offset the VAT you pay on your Qonto subscription against the VAT you charge your customers. Just make sure to keep your Qonto invoices for your records to use in the calculation: **VAT collected - deductible VAT = VAT to pay**. This way, you won’t be paying extra VAT out of pocket.

query: How much money will be left in my account if it gets seized?
answer:
If your company is eligible for the **Solde Bancaire Insaisissable (SBI)**, the amount left in your account after a seizure will be equal to the current RSA (Revenu de Solidarité Active) amount, regardless of your family situation. You can find the exact RSA amount on the [French government's website](https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1437?lang=en).

If your account balance is lower than the SBI amount, no funds will be seized. However, the SBI applies only once per seizure (across all banks) for a period of one month. If a new seizure occurs in the same month, the SBI will not apply, and the entire balance may be seized.

To confirm your eligibility, check if your company's legal form is listed among those entitled to the SBI, such as individual entrepreneurs (EIRL), artisans, traders, or liberal professions. Companies like SARLs, SASUs, or associations are not eligible.

query: Si je loue un local commercial pour le siège social de ma société, quel document dois-je fournir pour justifier la domiciliation ?
answer:
Pour justifier la domiciliation de votre société dans un local commercial, vous devez fournir l'un des documents suivants :

- Un **bail commercial signé**,
- Un **titre de propriété** de moins de 3 mois,
- Ou un **justificatif de domicile** à l'adresse du local.

Assurez-vous que le document soit lisible, en couleur, et au format PDF, JPEG ou PNG.

query: Est-ce que je peux utiliser ma carte Qonto sans faire un retrait ou un paiement avec le code PIN ?
answer:
Oui, vous pouvez utiliser votre carte Qonto sans faire de retrait ou de paiement avec le code PIN pour les transactions sans contact ou en ligne. Cependant, pour activer pleinement votre carte et bénéficier de toutes ses fonctionnalités, comme les plafonds de paiement mensuels supérieurs à 20 000 € pour les cartes PLUS et X, il est nécessaire d'effectuer une première opération avec votre code PIN (paiement physique ou retrait).

Si vous souhaitez éviter les frais de retrait, vous pouvez annuler la transaction après avoir saisi votre code PIN.

query: Do I need to manually enter my Amazon Business purchases into Qonto, or does the integration do it automatically?
answer: You don’t need to manually enter your Amazon Business purchases into Qonto. The integration automatically imports and reconciles your Amazon Business invoices with your Qonto transactions, eliminating the need for manual data entry. Once set up, the synchronization happens daily, and invoices are attached to the corresponding transactions in your Qonto account. You can find them in the **Invoices → Supplier Invoices** section.

query: Can I transfer my old invoices to Qonto without using an integration?
answer:
Yes, you can transfer your old invoices to Qonto without using an integration by manually uploading them. Here’s how:

1. Go to the **Client invoices** section in your Qonto account.
2. Click on **Import items** at the top right of the page, or simply drag and drop your files.
3. Upload your invoice files in PDF, PNG, or JPEG format.

This allows you to import your past invoices directly without needing to connect an external tool. If you encounter any issues, you’ll receive an email with details about any unsuccessful imports.

query: Can I use Quick Actions to send money to a new beneficiary I haven't added yet?
answer: No, you cannot use Quick Actions to send money to a new beneficiary that hasn't been added yet. The beneficiary must already exist in your Qonto account before you can initiate a transfer using the Quick Actions feature. You can type a prompt like `Send [amount] euros to [@name of the existing beneficiary] for [reason]` and select the beneficiary by typing `@` followed by their name. If the beneficiary is not already saved, you will need to add them first through the regular transfer process.

query: Si j'ai payé avec Google Pay, est-ce que je peux contester une transaction frauduleuse ?
answer: Oui, vous pouvez contester une transaction frauduleuse effectuée avec Google Pay. Les paiements via Google Pay sont éligibles à un remboursement par chargeback, au même titre que les transactions par carte classique. Vous devez signaler la fraude dans un délai de **8 semaines** après l'autorisation de la transaction. Qonto analysera votre demande en fonction des critères techniques, des méthodes d'authentification et des éléments contextuels pour déterminer votre éligibilité au remboursement.

query: Kann ich meine Belege einfach als Foto hochladen oder müssen sie in einem bestimmten Format sein?
answer: Sie können Ihre Belege als Foto im PNG- oder JPG-Format hochladen, da Qonto diese automatisch ins PDF-Format konvertiert. Wichtig ist jedoch, dass das Dokument lesbar, unkomprimiert und originalgetreu ist – also keine Veränderungen, Beschnitte oder Farbverfälschungen aufweist. Zudem müssen alle relevanten Informationen wie Rechnungsdetails, Mehrwertsteuerangaben und Verkäuferdaten klar erkennbar sein. So stellen Sie sicher, dass die digitale Version den rechtlichen Anforderungen entspricht und beweiskräftig beglaubigt werden kann.

query: Si je bloque ma carte Qonto parce que je ne la trouve plus, est-ce que je peux la débloquer plus tard si je la retrouve ?
answer: Non, le blocage de votre carte Qonto est une action irréversible. Une fois que vous avez déclaré votre carte comme perdue ou volée, elle est définitivement désactivée et ne peut pas être débloquée, même si vous la retrouvez. Vous devrez commander une nouvelle carte si nécessaire. Le coût de remplacement est de 6 € HT, sauf si la carte a été perdue lors de l'expédition.

query: What documents do I need to send to Qonto once my company becomes active?
answer:
Once your company becomes active, you need to send one of the following documents to Qonto within 90 days (for registrations before 03/07/2022) or 180 days (for registrations after 04/07/2022) from the opening of your account:

1. An **ordinary Chamber of Commerce extract** (*Visura camerale ordinaria*) not older than three months, showing the business activity status as **active**.
2. The **receipt of acceptance of the single communication** attached to the outcome of the protocol evasion (*Ricevuta di accettazione di comunicazione unica unita all'esito evasione protocollo*).
3. The **single communication for the establishment of the company** (*comunicazione unica per la nascita d'impresa*), where the section "Start of activity for a company already registered in the Business Register" is checked.

You can send the document via email to [iscrizione@qonto.com](mailto:iscrizione@qonto.com) or through the chat in your Qonto interface. If you don’t provide an official document within the deadline, your account will be automatically closed.

query: Do I need to have a specific type of account to use direct debit collection?
answer: To use direct debit collection, you don’t need a specific type of account, but you must meet certain eligibility criteria. These include having a **SEPA Creditor Identifier (SCI)**, being a Qonto customer for at least 6 months, and ensuring your company is registered for at least 9 months and fully operational. Additionally, your account must have 2-step authentication activated, and you must not have a refund rate exceeding 20% for direct debits. Nonprofit organizations and accounts with past debt issues are not eligible. You can check your eligibility in the **Business Account** section under **Incoming direct debits**.

query: Why do I keep getting rejected when I upload my ID photos?
answer:
Your ID photos may be getting rejected due to common issues that make the information unreadable or the document invalid. Here are the most frequent reasons and how to avoid them:

1. **Blurry or out-of-focus images** – Ensure the photo is sharp and all details are clear. Clean your phone's camera lens and hold the device steady while taking the picture.

2. **Cropped or incomplete document** – The entire ID must be visible, including all four corners. Avoid cutting off edges or important details.

3. **Glare or reflections** – Light reflections can obscure text. Take the photo in a well-lit area but avoid direct light sources that cause glare.

4. **Dark or poorly lit photos** – The document should be bright and legible. Use natural light or a well-lit room to avoid shadows.

5. **Crooked or angled shots** – The ID should be flat and straight in the frame. Place it on a stable surface and align your camera directly above it.

6. **Damaged or worn documents** – If your ID is torn, faded, or has missing information, use a different, undamaged document.

Before uploading, double-check that all text and details are clearly visible. If unsure, retake the photo to ensure the best quality. This will help avoid delays in processing your registration.

query: Warum werden meine Belege nicht in Zoho Books angezeigt?
answer:
Damit Ihre Belege von Qonto in Zoho Books angezeigt werden, müssen Sie zunächst die synchronisierten Transaktionen in Zoho Books kategorisieren. Sobald Sie eine Kategorie auf Ihre Transaktionen angewendet haben, werden die dazugehörigen Anhänge automatisch beim nächsten täglichen Synchronisationsvorgang um 20:30 Uhr hinzugefügt.

Falls die Belege weiterhin nicht erscheinen, überprüfen Sie bitte, ob die Transaktionen korrekt kategorisiert wurden und ob die Synchronisation erfolgreich stattgefunden hat. Sollten Sie weitere Hilfe benötigen, können Sie die Integration auch zurücksetzen, indem Sie die Verbindung trennen und erneut einrichten.

query: Can I use one of my additional accounts to pay for my Qonto subscription?
answer: No, all your monthly fees for your Qonto subscription and off-subscription operations will be charged exclusively on your first Qonto current account. Additional accounts cannot be used for this purpose.

query: ¿Qué pasa si no mando los documentos que me pide Qonto a tiempo?
answer: Si no proporcionas los documentos solicitados por Qonto a tiempo, es posible que tu cuenta sea suspendida temporalmente o que se apliquen restricciones mientras esperamos tu respuesta. Además, según el artículo 9.2 de tu contrato con Qonto, si no hay respuesta después de un cierto período, esto podría llevar al cierre de la cuenta. También podríamos rechazar transacciones pendientes de validación. Es importante enviar la información requerida para evitar estas medidas y garantizar el cumplimiento normativo.

query: Can I still use basic invoice features if I don't get the Accounts Payable add-on?
answer: Yes, you can still use basic invoice features without the Accounts Payable add-on. All Qonto plans include essential accounts payable functionalities such as uploading and paying supplier invoices, reconciling documents to transactions, and exporting information for reporting and bookkeeping. The add-on provides additional advanced features, but the core invoice management tools remain available in your standard plan.

query: Est-ce que mes justificatifs sont automatiquement envoyés vers OneDrive tous les jours ?
answer: Oui, vos justificatifs sont automatiquement envoyés vers OneDrive tous les jours. Les reçus existants sont exportés immédiatement lors de la configuration de l'intégration, et les nouveaux reçus sont synchronisés quotidiennement à 23h30. Vous n'avez donc pas besoin de les exporter manuellement.

query: ¿Cómo puedo acceder al contrato que firmé al abrir mi cuenta en Qonto?
answer:
Al registrarte en Qonto, aceptaste nuestras Condiciones Generales de Uso (CGU) marcando el campo correspondiente, lo que formaliza el contrato entre Qonto y el cliente. No se envía un contrato físico, sino que el acuerdo se basa en la aceptación de las CGU.

Puedes consultar las CGU en cualquier momento en la sección de documentos legales de nuestra página web: [Documentos legales](https://qonto.com/es/legal-documents). Si necesitas una copia del correo de bienvenida que recibiste al registrarte, te recomendamos revisar tu bandeja de entrada o la carpeta de correo no deseado.

query: Perché non riesco a modificare la password se ho fatto l'accesso con Google?
answer:
Se hai effettuato l'accesso con Google o Apple e non hai impostato una password specifica per il tuo account Qonto, non è necessario modificarne una, poiché l'accesso tramite questi servizi è già sicuro. Per questo motivo, il pulsante **Modifica la password** risulterà disattivato.

Se desideri comunque impostare una password, dovrai prima disattivare l'accesso tramite Google/Apple nelle impostazioni di sicurezza del tuo account.

query: Can I get my money back if I disagree with the seizure on my account?
answer: If you disagree with the Administrative Seizure by Third Parties (SATD) on your account, you can contest it by contacting the requesting tax authority (e.g., DGFIP, SIE) as soon as possible. If you reach an agreement with them, they must provide Qonto with a release act. Once received, Qonto can partially or fully refund the isolated amount based on the agreement. Without this release act, the funds will be transferred to the tax authorities after 30 days.

query: Comment savoir si mon entreprise peut obtenir un prêt via Qonto ?
answer:
Pour savoir si votre entreprise peut obtenir un prêt via Qonto, vous devez d'abord vérifier que votre entreprise est enregistrée depuis au moins six mois, car c'est un critère d'accès à la section **Financement** de l'application Qonto. Ensuite, l'éligibilité dépend des critères spécifiques de chaque partenaire financier, tels que l'ancienneté de votre compte Qonto, votre localisation, votre chiffre d'affaires ou votre historique commercial.

Pour vérifier votre éligibilité, connectez-vous à la section **Financement** depuis l'application web Qonto (accessible uniquement aux rôles **Titulaires** et **Admin**, sous réserve d'être dirigeant ou bénéficiaire effectif). Consultez les pages des partenaires pour connaître leurs conditions détaillées. Si vous avez des questions sur votre éligibilité ou souhaitez suivre votre demande, contactez directement le partenaire concerné.

Qonto ne garantit pas l'obtention d'un prêt et ne recommande aucune offre en particulier. Pour plus d'informations sur les offres disponibles, vous pouvez consulter [cet article](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947605128849-Quels-sont-les-diff%C3%A9rents-types-d-offres-disponibles-via-la-section-Financements).

query: What should I do if I receive a security code by SMS but didn’t request it?
answer:
If you receive a security code by SMS without having requested it, do not share it under any circumstances. This could be an attempt at fraud, such as SIM swapping, where someone tries to gain unauthorized access to your account.

Here’s what you should do:
1. **Do not enter the code** anywhere or share it with anyone.
2. **Change your password** immediately to secure your account.
3. **Contact Qonto support** directly via the chat in your Qonto app to report the incident and get further assistance.

For added security, ensure that **Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)** is activated on your account, as it provides better protection than SMS-based 2-step verification. You can find steps to set it up in our dedicated article.

query: ¿Puedo enviar dinero a otro país con mi cuenta de Qonto y cuánto tarda en llegar?
answer:
Sí, con tu cuenta de Qonto puedes enviar dinero a otro país gracias a la asociación con Wise, que permite realizar transferencias internacionales. El tiempo de llegada varía según el país y la divisa, pero algunas transferencias pueden completarse en **un día o incluso al instante**. Antes de realizar la transferencia, Qonto te proporcionará detalles sobre las comisiones y la fecha estimada de recepción para mayor transparencia.

Puedes enviar dinero a más de **130 países en más de 20 divisas**. Para más información sobre los plazos y las divisas disponibles, consulta [este enlace](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/es/articles/23951030976017).

query: Can I submit an invoice that's a photo taken with my phone?
answer:
Yes, you can submit an invoice that's a photo taken with your phone, but it must meet specific criteria to be valid. The image quality must be high, ensuring all details—such as the issue date, amount, supplier's name, and identification number—are clearly readable. Avoid blurriness or shadows that could obscure critical information. Additionally, the file size must be less than 15 MB.

For best results, we recommend using a PDF file instead of a photo (PNG/JPG), as it reduces the risk of poor image quality. Handwritten invoices or those with low clarity may be rejected because the system has difficulty detecting the necessary data. If you choose to submit a photo, double-check that all required details are legible and properly framed.

query: Can I use letters or symbols in my invoice numbers if I choose manual numbering?
answer: Yes, you can use letters or symbols in your invoice numbers if you choose manual numbering. When you disable the automatic numbering toggle in the **Settings** section, you have full flexibility to customize your document numbers according to your needs. This allows you to include prefixes, suffixes, or any specific formatting that suits your business requirements. However, if you plan to match your invoices with incoming payments, ensure your numbering follows one of the recognized patterns listed in the FAQ to avoid any issues.

query: Can I use a photo of my invoice for the Pay Later option if it's clear enough?
answer: While you can use a photo of your invoice for the Pay Later option, we recommend importing a **PDF file** instead, as it ensures better readability and detection of the required information. If you choose to use a photo (PNG or JPG), make sure the image is **clear and not blurry**, with all details—such as the issue date, amount, supplier's name, and identification number—easily visible. Additionally, the file size must be **less than 15 MB**. Handwritten invoices may be rejected due to difficulties in data detection.

query: Perché mi avete chiesto di aggiornare i documenti del conto se li ho già caricati quando ho aperto l’account?
answer:
L'aggiornamento periodico dei documenti del conto è necessario per garantire la sicurezza e la conformità con le normative vigenti. Come istituto di pagamento, siamo tenuti a verificare e aggiornare regolarmente le informazioni aziendali e personali associate al tuo conto business. Questo processo è fondamentale per prevenire interruzioni nei servizi e assicurare che tutti i dati siano sempre corretti e aggiornati.

Anche se hai già fornito i documenti durante l'apertura dell'account, le normative e le nostre procedure di sicurezza richiedono verifiche periodiche. Potremmo quindi richiedere l'aggiornamento delle informazioni per confermare che tutto sia ancora valido e conforme. Una volta ricevuti i nuovi documenti, il nostro team procederà alla verifica e ti comunicherà l'esito tramite email. In alcuni casi, potrebbe essere necessario richiedere ulteriori dettagli o documentazione per completare l'aggiornamento.

query: Warum funktioniert meine Karte nicht, obwohl ich genug Geld auf dem Konto habe?
answer:
Es gibt mehrere mögliche Gründe, warum Ihre Karte nicht funktioniert, obwohl genug Geld auf dem Konto ist. Hier sind die häufigsten Ursachen und Lösungen:

1. **Kartenlimits**: Überprüfen Sie, ob die [Zahlungs- oder Abhebungslimits](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949285427345-Was-sind-die-Zahlungs-und-Abhebungslimits-der-Qonto-Card) Ihrer Karte überschritten wurden.

2. **Karteneinstellungen**:
   - Bei kontaktlosen Zahlungen: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die [Option für kontaktlose Zahlungen aktiviert](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949240934417-Wie-passe-ich-die-Einstellungen-meiner-Qonto-Karte-an) ist und das Limit von 150 € für aufeinanderfolgende kontaktlose Zahlungen nicht erreicht wurde.
   - Bei Auslandszahlungen: Prüfen Sie, ob die [Option für Auslandszahlungen aktiviert](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949240934417-Wie-passe-ich-die-Einstellungen-meiner-Qonto-Karte-an) ist.

3. **Kartensperrung**:
   - Die Karte könnte nach [drei falschen PIN-Eingaben gesperrt](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949244242449-Wie-kann-ich-meinen-PIN-Code-einsehen-oder-zur%C3%BCcksetzen) sein.
   - Ein Kontoinhaber, Administrator oder Manager könnte die Karte vorübergehend gesperrt haben.

4. **Technische Probleme**:
   - Bei physischen Zahlungen: Prüfen Sie, ob das Zahlungsterminal eine stabile Internetverbindung hat.
   - Bei Online-Zahlungen: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Kartendaten (Gültigkeitsdatum, CVV, Name) korrekt eingegeben wurden und keine Werbeblocker die Zahlung behindern.
