5. **Sensible Länder**: Falls Sie im Ausland sind, könnte das Land, in dem Sie die Karte verwenden, auf der [Liste der sensiblen Länder](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949285570705-Kann-ich-meine-Qonto-Karte-im-Ausland-verwenden) stehen.

Falls keine dieser Lösungen hilft, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte direkt über den Chat in Ihrer Qonto-Oberfläche, indem Sie auf die Sprechblase in der rechten unteren Ecke klicken. Wir helfen Ihnen gerne weiter!

query: Warum bekomme ich den Bestätigungscode nicht, wenn ich meine Telefonnummer ändern will?
answer:
Wenn Sie den Bestätigungscode nicht erhalten, kann dies verschiedene Gründe haben. Hier sind die häufigsten Ursachen und Lösungen:

1. **Falsche Telefonnummer**: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die eingegebene Telefonnummer korrekt ist und keine Tippfehler enthält.
2. **Netzwerkprobleme**: Überprüfen Sie Ihre Internetverbindung oder versuchen Sie, den Code erneut anzufordern.
3. **Verzögerte SMS-Zustellung**: Manchmal kann es einige Minuten dauern, bis die SMS eintrifft. Warten Sie kurz und prüfen Sie Ihren Posteingang erneut.
4. **Starke Kundenauthentifizierung (SCA)**: Wenn Sie SCA aktiviert haben, wird der Code möglicherweise an Ihr authentifiziertes Gerät gesendet. Überprüfen Sie Ihr Telefon oder Ihre E-Mail auf die Bestätigungsanfrage.
5. **Blockierte oder ungültige Nummer**: Manche Mobilfunkanbieter blockieren automatische Nachrichten. Versuchen Sie, den Code stattdessen per E-Mail zu erhalten, falls diese Option verfügbar ist.

Falls das Problem weiterhin besteht, kontaktieren Sie bitte unseren Support, damit wir Ihnen weiterhelfen können.

query: Que faire si je ne suis pas satisfait de la réponse du service client après un échange par chat ?
answer:
Si vous n'êtes pas satisfait de la réponse obtenue lors d'un échange par chat avec notre service client, vous pouvez formuler une réclamation officielle. Pour cela, vous avez deux options :

1. **En ligne** : Envoyez votre réclamation à l'adresse suivante : [réclamations@qonto.com](mailto:réclamations@qonto.com).
2. **Par courrier** : Envoyez une lettre recommandée avec accusé de réception à l'adresse : Qonto, Service Réclamations, 18 Rue de Navarin, 75009 Paris.

Vous recevrez un accusé de réception sous 5 jours ouvrés. Votre réclamation sera traitée dans un délai maximal de 15 jours ouvrables, sauf cas exceptionnels nécessitant l'intervention de notre équipe juridique, auquel cas vous serez informé et recevrez une réponse définitive sous 35 jours ouvrables au maximum.

*Note* : Si vous agissez en tant que professionnel, vous n'êtes pas éligible à la procédure de médiation.

query: Wie kann ich mir die Arbeit mit Qonto erleichtern, indem ich andere Tools anschließe?
answer:
Im Bereich **Integrationen und Partner**, den Sie **unten links bei den Einstellungen** in Ihrer Qonto Web-App finden, bieten wir Ihnen sorgfältig ausgewählte Partnerangebote und Anwendungsintegrationen an. Diese helfen Ihnen, zeitraubende Aufgaben zu automatisieren und Ihre Finanzverwaltung zu optimieren.

Dort finden Sie:
- **Moderne Integrationen** wie Slack, um Ihre Prozesse zu vereinfachen.
- **Buchhaltungstools**, die sich nahtlos mit Qonto verbinden lassen, um Ihre Finanzverwaltung zu erleichtern.
- **Exklusive Partnerangebote** für Finanzdienstleistungen, Buchhaltungsservices und Zahlungsterminals.

Diese Tools und Integrationen sparen Ihnen wertvolle Zeit, sodass Sie sich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: die Entwicklung Ihres Unternehmens. Alle Integrationen durchlaufen eine umfassende Sicherheits- und Qualitätskontrolle, um höchste Standards zu gewährleisten.

Falls Sie weitere Tools vermissen, können Sie uns gerne Ihre Vorschläge an [partners@qonto.com](mailto:partners@qonto.com) senden.

query: What kind of documents can I use to prove my income if I'm a freelancer and don't have all the tax forms?
answer:
As a freelancer, you can use alternative documents to prove your income if you don’t have all the tax forms. Here are the options you can provide:

- **Recent invoices** sent to clients in the last 6 months.
- **Bank statements** for the last 3 months that clearly show your business income.
- **Receipts from professional associations** if you are a member.

You don’t need to submit every document—just provide what is available and relevant to your situation. If you have any doubts about which documents qualify, feel free to reach out for assistance.

query: What happens if I deposit more checks than what's included in my plan?
answer: If you deposit more checks than the number included in your plan, each additional check will be charged €2, excluding VAT. These fees are automatically deducted when the check amount is credited to your current account. We recommend using transfers for your regular transactions, as they are faster and more secure. You can find more details about check cashing and related fees on our rates page.

query: How do I make sure my receipts from my monthly subscriptions get automatically sent to Qonto?
answer:
To automatically send your receipts from monthly subscriptions to Qonto, follow these steps:

1. **Save your Qonto email address in Gmail:**
   - Go to your Gmail settings, then the "Forwarding and POP/IMAP" section.
   - Click "Add a forwarding address" and enter your dedicated Qonto address (found [here](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949947229841)).
   - Verify the address by entering the 9-digit confirmation code sent to your inbox.

2. **Create a filter for subscription receipts:**
   - In Gmail settings, go to "Filters and Blocked Addresses" and click "Create a new filter."
   - Enter the email address of the subscription service that sends you receipts.
   - Check the "Has attachment" box to ensure only emails with receipts are forwarded.
   - Click "Create filter," then select "Forward it to" and choose your Qonto address.

3. **Verify the paired attachments:**
   - Qonto will send you an email confirmation to check that each receipt is correctly matched.

You can repeat this process for any other subscription services. If any receipts aren’t automatically matched, you can find them in the [Supplier Invoices](https://qonto9015-it.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949920163473) section.

query: ¿Cómo puedo pagar impuestos a la Agencia Tributaria usando el número de referencia (NRC) en Qonto?
answer:
Para pagar impuestos a la Agencia Tributaria usando el número de referencia (NRC) en Qonto, sigue estos pasos:

1. **Accede a la sección "Agencia Tributaria"**: Dentro de tu cuenta Qonto, ve a **"Impuestos y tasas" > "Agencia Tributaria"**.
2. **Haz clic en "Paga impuesto"**: En la parte superior derecha de la pantalla, selecciona esta opción.
3. **Selecciona el modelo de impuesto**: Dependiendo del tipo de modelo, se te pedirán diferentes detalles:
   - Para **"Impuestos y liquidaciones"**, indica el *Importe* y el *Número de Justificante*.
   - Para **"Autoliquidaciones"**, especifica el *Ejercicio y Período* y el *Importe*. Si es una pre-declaración, añade también el *Número de Justificante*.
4. **Confirma los datos**: Selecciona el IBAN desde el que deseas realizar el pago, verifica la información del contribuyente y firma el pago con autenticación reforzada (SCA).

Una vez completado, el pago aparecerá en la sección **"Completados"** con el número NRC y el justificante de pago adjunto, que podrás descargar directamente desde Qonto.

💡 *Con este método, también puedes pagar impuestos de otras empresas usando tu IBAN de Qonto, e incluso fraccionar el pago del Modelo 100 en dos plazos activando esta opción en la vista "Detalles del formulario".*

query: Can I turn off notifications for specific transactions but keep others active?
answer: Yes, you can customize your notifications to turn off alerts for specific transactions while keeping others active. To do this, go to **Settings** (on a computer) or the **Menu > Settings** (on the mobile app), then navigate to **Notifications**. From there, you can select which types of notifications you want to receive—whether by email, push notification, or both—and disable the ones you don’t need. This allows you to tailor your alerts to only the transactions that matter most to you.

query: Wie kann ich mehrere Rechnungen für eine einzige Transaktion in Qonto mit Dropbox verknüpfen?
answer:
Die Integration von Qonto mit Dropbox ermöglicht es nicht, mehrere Lieferantenrechnungen mit einer einzigen Transaktion zu verknüpfen. Wenn Sie mehrere Rechnungen für dieselbe Transaktion hochladen, wird nur eine davon automatisch abgeglichen. Die weiteren Rechnungen bleiben im Ordner „Processing“ (in Bearbeitung) gespeichert.

Falls Sie mehrere Rechnungen in einer einzigen Datei zusammenfassen möchten, ist dies möglich, solange die Datei unter 15 MB groß ist und eines der unterstützten Formate (JPEG, PNG oder PDF) hat. Alternativ können Sie die zusätzlichen Rechnungen manuell in Qonto mit der Transaktion verknüpfen, indem Sie im Bereich „Einkäufe“ unter der Registerkarte „Lieferantenrechnungen“ die entsprechende Aktion durchführen.

query: Come faccio a ottenere una prova di pagamento per un bonifico effettuato con Qonto?
answer:
Per ottenere una prova di pagamento per un bonifico effettuato con Qonto, segui questi passaggi:

1. Accedi al tuo account Qonto tramite l'app web o mobile.
2. Vai alla sezione **Bonifici**.
3. Seleziona la transazione per cui desideri la prova di pagamento.
4. Clicca sull'opzione per scaricare la prova di bonifico, che sarà disponibile in formato PDF.

Se non riesci a trovare la prova di pagamento nella sezione bonifici, puoi richiederla direttamente all'Assistenza Qonto tramite la chat nell'app, specificando il bonifico di interesse.

query: Do I need to manually update my Qonto transactions in Xero every day?
answer: No, you don’t need to manually update your Qonto transactions in Xero every day. The integration automatically syncs your transactions three times a day at 9am, 4pm, and 11pm CET. This ensures your Qonto transactions are consistently and effortlessly imported into Xero, saving you time and reducing manual work.

query: Can I deposit my car as part of the capital for my company with Qonto?
answer:
Yes, you can deposit your car as part of the capital for your company with Qonto, provided it is an in-kind contribution that meets certain conditions. Qonto accepts in-kind contributions for SARL, EURL, SAS, and SASU entities, but only if they are combined with a cash contribution.

For your car to be accepted as an in-kind contribution, it must either be evaluated by a contribution appraiser or meet the following criteria:
- The value of the car does not exceed €30,000.
- The total value of all in-kind contributions (including the car) does not exceed half of the share capital.
- You provide a supporting document for the car's value.

For more details, you can refer to Qonto's dedicated article on [in-kind contributions](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947618303889).

query: Why is the total VAT on my invoice slightly different from what I calculated?
answer: The slight difference in the total VAT on your invoice is due to rounding practices applied to each line item before summing them up. VAT calculations can result in fractions of a cent, which must be rounded to the nearest tenth of a cent to comply with accounting standards. Qonto uses the "sum of the roundings" method, where VAT is rounded for each individual product line before being added together. This ensures greater precision and transparency, especially for invoices with multiple items. While this may cause minor variations compared to calculating VAT on the total amount, it aligns with regulatory guidelines and provides clearer breakdowns for your records.

query: Kann ich das Add-on für Kundenrechnungen auch nur für einen Monat testen, bevor ich mich für ein Jahr festlege?
answer:
Ja, Sie können das Add-on für Kundenrechnungen zunächst für einen Monat testen, bevor Sie sich für eine jährliche Abrechnung entscheiden. Das Add-on ist sowohl mit monatlicher als auch mit jährlicher Abrechnung verfügbar.

Die monatliche Abrechnung kostet regulär 45 € pro Monat (zzgl. MwSt.) oder aktuell im Sonderangebot 35 € pro Monat (zzgl. MwSt.) bis zum 31. August. Sie können das Add-on jederzeit in Ihren Einstellungen aktivieren oder deaktivieren, ohne langfristige Verpflichtung. Falls Sie sich später für die jährliche Option entscheiden, können Sie diese ebenfalls über Ihre Kontoeinstellungen buchen.

So können Sie das Add-on flexibel testen und später wechseln, falls gewünscht.

query: How can a company quickly get money if they have unexpected expenses?
answer: A company can quickly access funds for unexpected expenses by utilizing its treasury, which includes cash in current accounts, savings or investment accounts, and marketable securities. Marketable securities, such as shares or bonds, can be liquidated (sold) quickly to generate cash when needed. This allows the company to cover short-term financial needs without disrupting its operations. Treasury is specifically designed to handle such situations, unlike turnover or profit, which represent revenue and earnings but not immediately available funds.

query: Why was my online payment declined even though I have enough money in my account?
answer:
There are several possible reasons why your online payment was declined even with sufficient funds in your account. Here are the most common ones to check:

1. **Incorrect Card Information**: Ensure that the card details entered are accurate, including the expiration date, CVV number, and that the card is correctly identified as a debit card (not a credit card). Also, verify that the billing address and name match those registered with your Qonto account.

2. **3DS Authentication Issue**: Confirm that the phone number linked to your card for 3D Secure authentication is correct and accessible. A mismatch or unreachable number can cause the payment to fail.

3. **Browser or Plugin Interference**: Some ad blockers or browser plugins may interfere with the payment process. Try disabling them temporarily and attempt the payment again.

4. **Card Settings**: Ensure that your card is activated and that there are no temporary blocks or restrictions (such as limits on online payments) applied to it. If needed, contact the account Owner, Admin, or Manager to adjust these settings.

5. **Merchant Restrictions**: Some merchants may have specific requirements or restrictions for debit cards, such as blocking the full amount temporarily or refusing installment payments.

If you’ve checked all these points and the issue persists, please contact our customer support directly via the chat in your Qonto interface for further assistance.

query: How can I transfer my existing direct debit mandates to my new Qonto account?
answer:
To transfer your existing direct debit mandates to your new Qonto account, follow these steps:

1. **Inform your payees**: Download and fill in the [bank account details certificate](https://qonto-assets.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/intercom_faq/Bank+Account+Deatils+for+Account+Switch+-++Direct+Debit+-+Qonto+(1).pdf) with your new Qonto IBAN. Send this to all your payees so they can update their records.

2. **For SEPA Core Direct Debits**: This step is usually sufficient, as your payees will handle the transfer of the mandate to your new account.

3. **For SEPA B2B Direct Debits**: Your payee must provide a new mandate version, which you will need to upload in your Qonto app. You can do this by following the instructions [here](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947628012433).

This ensures a smooth transition of your mandates to your new Qonto account.

query: Can I withdraw money from an ATM with my Qonto card?
answer: Yes, you can withdraw money from any ATM using your Qonto card. Qonto offers physical cards that allow ATM withdrawals. However, please note that cash deposits are not supported for security reasons.

query: ¿Qué pasa si no subo un recibo a tiempo y me bloquean la tarjeta?
answer:
Si no subes un recibo a tiempo y tu tarjeta es bloqueada, recibirás notificaciones por correo electrónico y en la aplicación (push) con antelación: 3 días antes y 1 día antes del bloqueo. Una vez bloqueada la tarjeta, también se te notificará.

Para desbloquearla, tienes dos opciones:
1. **Subir los recibos atrasados**: Una vez que los adjuntes, la tarjeta se desbloqueará automáticamente, aunque puede tardar unos minutos u horas.
2. **Solicitar un desbloqueo temporal**: El Administrador o Propietario de la cuenta puede desbloquear la tarjeta temporalmente, pero volverá a bloquearse hasta que subas los recibos pendientes o seas eliminado de las reglas.

Puedes ver cuántos recibos tienes atrasados en la sección **Tarjetas del equipo** o filtrando las transacciones por "Recibos atrasados". Si necesitas más detalles sobre cómo gestionar los recibos pendientes, puedes consultar [este artículo](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/es/articles/23950917134609--C%C3%B3mo-puedo-tener-una-mejor-visibilidad-de-los-justificantes-que-faltan).

query: Can I open a Qonto account for my company if I'm still in the process of forming it?
answer:
Yes, you can open a Qonto account for your company even if it is still in the formation process. Qonto offers foundation accounts for companies in Germany that are in the start-up phase, specifically for legal forms such as Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung (GmbH) and Unternehmergesellschaft (UG), as well as their non-profit variants (gGmbH and gUG in Gründung).

The process involves four simple steps: registration with your company details and foundation documents, depositing the share capital, submitting the trade register application, and activating your account once the notarized commercial register application is uploaded. This allows you to start using your account even before the final commercial register entry, avoiding unnecessary waiting time.

query: Pourquoi Qonto refuse-t-il les fonds venant de certains pays pour une augmentation de capital ?
answer: Qonto refuse les fonds provenant de certains pays pour une augmentation de capital afin de respecter les réglementations en vigueur, notamment en matière de lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et le financement du terrorisme. Ces restrictions sont mises en place pour garantir la sécurité et la conformité de notre écosystème financier, en accord avec les normes internationales. Les pays concernés sont ceux identifiés comme présentant des risques accrus selon les critères de conformité. Cette mesure permet de protéger l’ensemble de nos clients et de maintenir un environnement transactionnel sécurisé.

query: What do I need to do to connect my old bank account to Qonto for the transfer?
answer:
To connect your old bank account to Qonto for the transfer, follow these steps:

1. **Access the Account Transfer Service**: Go to the account transfer page by clicking [this link](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23950851565329) or navigate to **Settings** in the bottom left of your Qonto dashboard and click on the **Account transfer** button.

2. **Enter Your Bank Details**: Fill in the required details of your old bank account to connect it to Qonto using the secure aggregation tool, Bridge by Bankin'.

3. **Sync Your Transactions**: Bridge will scan your transactions from the past 12 months to identify actions needed for the transfer, such as updating direct debits or notifying customers.

4. **Book a Meeting with an Agent**: After syncing, you’ll be prompted to schedule a meeting with a Qonto agent who will analyze your needs and prepare your customized account transfer plan.

If you encounter any issues, such as an error message when reconnecting, contact Qonto’s Customer Support for assistance.

query: What details from my Visura Camerale do I need to provide when signing up for Qonto?
answer:
When signing up for Qonto, you will need to provide the following details from your *Visura Camerale*:

- **Company name** (*Ragione Sociale*): The official name of your company as registered in the Commercial Register.
- **Legal form**: The type of legal structure of your company (e.g., SRL, SPA, SAS, Sole proprietorship).
- **Legal registration date** (*data d'iscrizione*): The date when your company was officially registered with the chamber of commerce.
- **Company's registration number**: This is the REA number, typically located below the PEC address on your *Visura Camerale*. If you are a freelancer, you will need to provide your tax code instead.
- **EU VAT number** (*Partita Iva comunitaria*): The VAT number used for intra-community transactions within the European Union.

These details are necessary to complete your registration with Qonto.

query: Can I use my expired residence permit to open a Qonto account if I have a receipt for my renewal application?
answer:
Yes, you can use your expired residence permit to open a Qonto account if you have a receipt for your renewal application. Here’s how:

1. **Verify your identity** with your valid passport using our partner Fourthline.
2. **Send us a photo** of your expired residence permit along with your receipt of the renewal application to [onboarding@qonto.com](mailto:onboarding@qonto.com).

We accept receipts such as the confirmation of your residence permit renewal application or a favorable decision notice for the renewal. This allows you to proceed with opening your account while your new permit is being processed.

query: Can I get a proof of transfer for a payment I received in my account?
answer: To obtain a proof of transfer for an incoming payment, you will need to contact our customer support team via chat or email. They will assist you in retrieving the necessary documentation. Proofs for outgoing transfers can be downloaded directly from your Qonto interface, but for incoming transfers, our support team will handle your request.

query: Cosa succede se provo a pagare un bollo già saldato con pagoPA?
answer: Se provi a pagare un bollo già saldato con pagoPA, il sistema ti mostrerà un messaggio di errore, poiché non è possibile effettuare lo stesso pagamento due volte. Questo meccanismo evita duplicati e garantisce che ogni avviso venga pagato una sola volta.

query: Can I use my promotional code after my subscription has already renewed?
answer: No, you cannot use your promotional code after your subscription has already renewed. For annual subscriptions, you must enter your promotional code before the renewal date—either during the month preceding the renewal or at the latest in the month of renewal, before the actual renewal date. Once the subscription has renewed, the promotional code can no longer be applied to that billing cycle. For monthly subscriptions, the code must be entered before the next billing cycle begins to take effect.

query: Perché la mia carta non funziona con il contactless durante la manutenzione?
answer: Durante il periodo di manutenzione, i pagamenti contactless potrebbero non funzionare a causa della migrazione tecnica in corso. Stiamo già lavorando a una soluzione per ripristinare questa funzionalità il prima possibile. Nel frattempo, puoi continuare a utilizzare la tua carta per i pagamenti tradizionali.

query: ¿Qué pasa si no sé exactamente cuánto dinero voy a mover en mi cuenta de autónomo al año?
answer: Si no estás seguro del volumen exacto de dinero que moverás en tu cuenta de autónomo al año, puedes seleccionar el rango más aproximado a tu estimación y utilizar los comentarios para explicar tu situación. Qonto entiende que, como autónomo, tus ingresos y gastos pueden variar, por lo que acepta proyecciones basadas en tus expectativas. Lo importante es proporcionar una estimación realista y ajustada a tu actividad profesional. Si necesitas ayuda, el equipo de soporte está disponible para orientarte.

query: Se supero il limite mensile per i bonifici, posso comunque inviare un bonifico SEPA ricorrente?
answer: No, se superi il limite mensile per i bonifici, non puoi inviare un bonifico SEPA ricorrente. I Manager non possono effettuare o approvare bonifici SEPA ricorrenti, indipendentemente dai limiti stabiliti. Inoltre, i bonifici che superano i limiti mensili o per singolo bonifico vengono convertiti in richieste di bonifico, che devono essere approvate da un Admin, tranne nel caso dei bonifici SWIFT. Per i bonifici SEPA ricorrenti, dovrai sempre coinvolgere un Admin o il Titolare del conto per l'approvazione.

query: Se cancello per sbaglio una fattura dalla cartella Dropbox, viene automaticamente ripristinata?
answer: Se elimini un file dalla cartella Dropbox, questo verrà importato nuovamente nel tuo account Dropbox automaticamente durante la sincronizzazione successiva. Tuttavia, se elimini una cartella intera, le ricevute al suo interno verranno eliminate definitivamente e dovrai riconfigurare l'integrazione per ripristinarle.

query: Perché la mia fattura è stata rifiutata se è stata emessa meno di 60 giorni fa?
answer:
Una fattura può essere rifiutata anche se emessa meno di 60 giorni fa per diversi motivi. Ecco i principali:

1. **Data di scadenza non valida**: Se la fattura ha una data di scadenza, questa non deve essere anteriore a più di 10 giorni prima della richiesta di finanziamento.
2. **Informazioni mancanti o illeggibili**: La fattura deve includere chiaramente la data di emissione, l'importo, il nome del fornitore e il suo numero di identificazione (Partita IVA o codice fiscale). Se uno di questi elementi manca o non è leggibile, la fattura potrebbe essere rifiutata.
3. **Formato non conforme**: Se la fattura è in formato immagine (PNG/JPG) e le informazioni sono sfocate o di bassa qualità, potrebbe non essere accettata. È preferibile caricare un file PDF.
4. **Tipo di documento non valido**: Le fatture proforma non sono accettate se il fornitore ha sede in Spagna o Italia. Inoltre, il documento deve essere una fattura ufficiale e non un preventivo o un altro tipo di documento.
5. **Discrepanze**: Potrebbero esserci discrepanze tra l'importo della fattura e quello richiesto, oppure il pagamento potrebbe riguardare servizi non ammissibili (come stipendi, tasse, affitti, ecc.).

Se la tua fattura è stata rifiutata, controlla questi aspetti e assicurati che sia conforme a tutti i requisiti indicati.

query: ¿Cómo puedo saber si el reembolso de mi domiciliación SEPA lo hizo la empresa o yo mismo?
answer:
Para saber si el reembolso de tu domiciliación SEPA lo realizó la empresa acreedora o tú mismo, puedes verificar lo siguiente:

1. **Revisa el historial de tu aplicación Qonto**: Si solicitaste el reembolso tú, encontrarás un registro de la acción al seleccionar la domiciliación en la pestaña **Historial**. Allí aparecerá la opción **Solicitar un reembolso** si fue iniciado por ti.

2. **Si no hay registro de tu parte**, es probable que el reembolso haya sido realizado de manera espontánea por la empresa o institución acreedora.

Si no encuentras información clara en la app, puedes contactar con el servicio de atención al cliente de Qonto para obtener más detalles sobre el origen del reembolso.

query: Can I edit the VAT information for a transaction directly in the Transaction view?
answer: Yes, you can edit the VAT information for a transaction directly in the Transaction view. The "VAT" column allows you to quickly view and modify the VAT details associated with each transaction without needing to open additional panels or sections. Simply locate the transaction in the list, click on the VAT field in its corresponding row, and make your changes. This feature is designed to streamline the process and make transaction management more efficient.

query: Can I set a spending limit for my virtual card?
answer: Yes, you can set a spending limit for your virtual card. Admins or Managers can customize the monthly limit (up to €20,000) and the transaction limit. Additionally, if you have the Expense & Spend Management add-on, you can also set a daily limit. These settings can be adjusted in the card settings section under **‘Business Account’ > ‘Cards’** by selecting the specific virtual card.

query: Kann ich ein Projekt für einen Kunden erstellen, auch wenn ich noch kein Angebot erstellt habe?
answer: Ja, Sie können ein Projekt für einen Kunden erstellen, auch wenn noch kein Angebot erstellt wurde. Die Funktion "Projekte" in Qonto ermöglicht es Ihnen, Verkaufschancen von den frühesten Phasen an zu verfolgen und zu verwalten. Sie können ein neues Projekt direkt über die Schaltfläche **„Projekt erstellen“** im Bereich **„Rechnungen > Projekte“** anlegen oder auch aus der Kundenliste heraus. Dies gibt Ihnen die Flexibilität, Ihre Vertriebspipeline bereits im Vorfeld zu organisieren, selbst wenn noch keine konkreten Dokumente wie Angebote oder Rechnungen existieren.

query: Quali sono le differenze tra un admin e un titolare del conto?
answer: Il **titolare del conto** e l'**admin** hanno diritti molto simili su Qonto, ma con una differenza fondamentale: il titolare del conto è l'unico ruolo che può richiedere la chiusura del conto. L'admin, invece, non ha questa possibilità, pur avendo accesso completo a tutte le altre funzionalità e sezioni del conto, proprio come il titolare. Entrambi i ruoli possono gestire le impostazioni, i membri del team e le operazioni finanziarie, ma solo il titolare ha il potere di terminare definitivamente il rapporto con Qonto.

query: What happens if I don’t have enough money in my account when the Pay Later installment is due?
answer:
If you don’t have enough money in your account when a Pay Later installment is due, the repayment will fail, and your account will be immediately affected. Here’s what happens:

1. **Account Restrictions**: Your Qonto account will be blocked, meaning you won’t be able to make card payments, transfers, or direct debits until the overdue installment is paid.
2. **Late Fees**: Starting from 10:00 PM Paris time on the due date, a daily late repayment fee of 0.04% will be applied to the unpaid installment capital. This fee continues until the full amount is repaid.
3. **Loss of Pay Later Access**: Your eligibility for the Pay Later feature will be revoked, and your credit limit will be set to €0. If the delay exceeds five days, you’ll permanently lose access to Pay Later for future purchases.
4. **Automatic Debit Attempts**: Qonto will attempt to debit your account twice daily (latest by 5:00 PM) to recover the total amount, including fees. Partial payments aren’t possible—only full repayment will resolve the issue.
5. **Urgent Action Required**: You must top up your main account with the necessary funds and manually initiate the repayment via the **Pay Now** button in the **Financing > Pay later** section of your app. Choose to pay either the single overdue installment or the full financing amount (with recalculated interest).

If the situation isn’t resolved within 8 days, you’ll be required to pay all outstanding installments within 15 days. To avoid these consequences, ensure your account is sufficiently funded before each due date.

query: Comment puis-je régler mes factures si je ne peux pas avoir une LCR avec Qonto ?
answer:
Qonto ne propose pas encore la possibilité d'émettre une Lettre de Change Relevé (LCR), mais vous pouvez utiliser des prélèvements automatiques pour régler vos factures. Voici deux solutions simples :

1. **Payer vos factures par prélèvement automatique** : Vous pouvez configurer des prélèvements SEPA pour régler vos fournisseurs de manière sécurisée et automatisée.
2. **Recevoir des paiements par prélèvement** : Si vous êtes fournisseur, vous pouvez mettre en place des prélèvements pour encaissez les paiements de vos clients.

Ces méthodes sont pratiques et largement utilisées pour simplifier les transactions récurrentes. Pour plus de détails, consultez les liens suivants :
- [Comment encaisser des paiements par prélèvement](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/25012148623249-How-to-collect-payments-by-direct-debit-via-EBICS)
- [Comment fonctionnent les prélèvements SEPA](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947694535569-How-do-SEPA-Direct-Debits-work)

query: ¿Por qué no me aparece la opción para configurar los cobros domiciliados en mi cuenta?
answer:
La opción para configurar los cobros domiciliados no aparece en tu cuenta porque es posible que no cumplas con los criterios de elegibilidad establecidos por Qonto. Para poder acceder a esta funcionalidad, debes cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:

- Tu empresa debe estar registrada desde hace al menos 9 meses.
- Debes haber sido cliente de Qonto durante al menos 6 meses.
- Tu empresa debe estar completamente operativa y no en proceso de cierre.
- La autenticación en dos pasos debe estar activada en tu cuenta.
- No puedes ser una organización sin fines de lucro.
- Tu cuenta no debe haber sido deudora ni haber recibido un embargo.
- El índice de reembolso de tus domiciliaciones debe ser inferior al 20%.

Si no cumples alguno de estos requisitos, la opción no estará disponible. Sin embargo, la elegibilidad se evalúa mensualmente, por lo que puedes verificar tu estado al inicio de cada mes desde la sección **Cuenta de la empresa** > **Cobros domiciliados**. Si en algún momento cumples con los criterios, el botón para iniciar la configuración aparecerá automáticamente.

query: Quelle est la différence entre la libération partielle et le capital variable ?
answer:
La libération partielle et le capital variable sont deux mécanismes distincts et incompatibles.

La **libération partielle** permet de déposer uniquement une partie du capital social au moment de la création de la société, avec l'obligation de libérer le reste dans un délai maximal de 5 ans. Le montant minimum à libérer dépend de la forme juridique de la société (par exemple, 20 % pour une SARL ou 50 % pour une SAS).

Le **capital variable**, quant à lui, est un régime spécifique où le capital social peut être augmenté ou réduit sans formalités particulières, offrant une grande flexibilité. Cependant, ces deux options ne peuvent pas être combinées : une société ne peut pas avoir à la fois un capital libéré partiellement et un capital variable.

Si vous optez pour l'une ou l'autre, assurez-vous de bien préciser votre choix dans les statuts de votre société.

query: Comment puis-je éviter la fermeture de mon compte si ma société est radiée par erreur ?
answer:
Si votre société est radiée par erreur et que vous souhaitez éviter la fermeture de votre compte, vous devez nous envoyer rapidement l'un des documents suivants :

- Un **KBIS à jour** ne mentionnant plus la radiation de votre société.
- Un **avis de situation** confirmant que votre société est toujours active.

Ces documents nous permettront de vérifier que votre société est bien en activité et d'éviter la clôture de votre compte.

Si vous avez besoin de plus de temps pour régulariser la situation, contactez-nous par e-mail ou via le chat environ 10 jours avant la fin du préavis de 60 jours. Nous étudierons alors une éventuelle prolongation.

query: Can I use my PayPal account to transfer my share capital contribution?
answer: No, transfers from PayPal or other electronic payment services such as Lydia, Xoom, or Western Union are not accepted for share capital contributions. You must use a bank transfer via SEPA, Instant SEPA, or SWIFT (with certain country restrictions) from your personal or business account, depending on whether you are an individual or a legal entity.

query: Perché il mio bonifico internazionale in valuta estera non va a buon fine nonostante il conto sia attivo?
answer:
Potrebbero esserci diverse ragioni per cui il bonifico internazionale in valuta estera non va a buon fine, anche se il conto è attivo. Ecco le possibili cause:

1. **Validazione dell'azienda**: Se la tua azienda non è stata ancora validata completamente dal nostro team, la funzione potrebbe non essere disponibile. Una volta completato il processo di onboarding, potrai accedere ai bonifici in valuta estera.

2. **Registrazione recente dell’impresa**: Se la tua impresa è stata registrata di recente, alcune informazioni necessarie, come il codice ATECO, potrebbero non essere ancora disponibili nelle banche dati ufficiali. Verifichiamo queste informazioni automaticamente più volte a settimana, quindi il problema dovrebbe risolversi presto.

3. **Diritto di non pubblicazione**: Se un legale rappresentante della tua impresa ha esercitato il diritto di non pubblicazione nelle banche dati ufficiali, è necessario contattarci via chat per fornirci le informazioni richieste in privato. In questo modo, potremo aggiornare i dati e sbloccare la funzione.

4. **Moduli di amministrazione tedeschi**: Se la tua azienda è registrata in Germania, potrebbe essere necessario inviare ulteriori informazioni di registrazione. Il nostro team verificherà la conformità con i criteri del nostro fornitore di terze parti per abilitare i trasferimenti.

Se il problema persiste, ti invitiamo a contattare il nostro servizio clienti tramite chat per una risoluzione rapida. Per ulteriori dettagli sui bonifici in valuta estera, puoi consultare [questa guida](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/it/articles/23949990126737-Come-posso-effettuare-un-bonifico-in-valuta-estera-SWIFT).

query: Was muss ich tun, wenn ich im Ausland medizinische Hilfe brauche und eine Qonto Plus Karte habe?
answer:
Wenn Sie im Ausland medizinische Hilfe benötigen und eine Qonto Plus Karte besitzen, sind dringende medizinische Kosten durch Ihre Versicherung abgedeckt. Sie können den Hilfeanbieter AIG direkt kontaktieren:

- **Deutschland:** +49 69 22 22 80 17 oder [de.assistance@aig.com](mailto:de.assistance@aig.com)
- **Frankreich:** +33 1 49 02 46 70 oder [fr.assistance@aig.com](mailto:fr.assistance@aig.com)
- **Italien:** +39 02 36 00 06 83 oder [it.assistance@aig.com](mailto:it.assistance@aig.com)
- **Spanien:** +34 911 149 989 oder [es.assistance@aig.com](mailto:es.assistance@aig.com)

Wählen Sie die Kontaktdaten entsprechend dem Land, in dem Ihr Unternehmen ansässig ist. AIG wird Ihnen weiterhelfen und die notwendigen Schritte einleiten.

query: Can I connect my PayPal account to Qonto to see all my transactions in one place?
answer:
Yes, you can connect your PayPal account to Qonto to centralize and view all your transactions in one place. PayPal is a supported Payment Service Provider (PSP), so you can easily link it to your Qonto interface.

To set it up, follow these steps:

1. **On the web app**:
   - Go to your **Business Account** section, then click on **Accounts** and select **Add an account**.
   - Choose **External account** and select PayPal from the list of suggested institutions or search for it in the search bar.
   - Approve the connection by clicking **Allow and continue** and log in to your PayPal account to authorize the link.
   - Select the PayPal accounts you want to connect, and they will appear in your Qonto interface.

2. **On the mobile app**:
   - From the **Home** screen, go to the **Balance** section and tap the **➕** symbol.
   - Select **External account**, choose PayPal, and log in to authorize the connection.

Once connected, your PayPal transactions will be visible alongside your Qonto transactions, making it easier to manage your finances. You’ll also receive a confirmation email once the data is fully synced. If you encounter any issues, ensure PayPal is listed as an available institution, and if not, you can submit a request via [this form](https://qonto.typeform.com/to/VwUiU360) to notify Qonto’s team.

query: What should I do if my bulk transfer file has an error message?
answer:
If your bulk transfer file has an error message, check the following:

1. **File Format**: Ensure your file is in .CSV format and follows the required template with the correct columns: `beneficiary_name`, `iban`, `amount`, `currency`, and `reference`.
2. **Data Validity**: Verify that all fields are filled correctly, with no missing or invalid data (e.g., IBANs outside the SEPA scheme, special characters, or incorrect amounts).
3. **Error Details**: The error message will specify the issue—review it carefully and correct the highlighted problems (e.g., long beneficiary names, unsupported characters, or inverted columns).
4. **Re-upload**: After fixing the errors, re-upload the file and proceed with the transfer.

If the issue persists, consult the CSV guidelines in the Qonto app or contact support for further assistance.

query: Pourquoi une transaction refusée apparaît-elle quand même dans mon historique ?
answer:
Une transaction refusée peut apparaître dans votre historique sous la forme d'une transaction "en cours" car le commerçant a effectué une demande d'autorisation pour vérifier la disponibilité des fonds. Même si le paiement a été rejeté, cette autorisation reste temporairement visible dans votre historique.

En effet, Qonto peut autoriser le paiement, mais le commerçant ne reçoit pas toujours la confirmation en temps réel en raison d'un problème de connexion entre les banques. Le paiement est alors refusé au terminal du commerçant, mais comme Qonto n'a pas reçu de confirmation de "réglage", la transaction reste "ouverte" dans votre compte.

Rassurez-vous, cette transaction ne vous sera pas facturée. Elle disparaîtra automatiquement de votre historique dans un délai maximum de 9 jours, conformément à la réglementation Mastercard, et votre solde sera mis à jour.

query: Pourquoi mon virement en dollars vers l'Europe n'est-il pas possible aujourd'hui ?
answer: Votre virement en dollars vers l'Europe n'est peut-être pas possible aujourd'hui en raison d'un jour férié aux États-Unis, car les transactions en USD sont soumises aux jours ouvrables américains. Les virements internationaux en devises étrangères sont également indisponibles pendant les week-ends, les jours fériés européens ou internationaux, ainsi que la nuit pour certaines devises. Nous vous conseillons de réessayer pendant les heures ouvrables (9h-19h) un jour ouvrable suivant.

query: ¿Qué pasa si no tengo suficiente dinero en mi cuenta de Qonto para pagar una cuota del pago diferido?
answer: Si no tienes suficiente dinero en tu cuenta de Qonto para pagar una cuota del pago diferido, dispones de un período de gracia de cinco días para depositar los fondos necesarios y regularizar la situación. Si después de este plazo no se ha realizado el pago, el acceso a la función *Pay later* (pago diferido) se revocará de manera permanente. Es importante asegurarte de tener fondos suficientes en tu cuenta principal de Qonto para evitar esta situación. Para más detalles, puedes consultar [este artículo](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23950903380241).

query: What information do I need to provide about the people who own my company?
answer:
To register the ultimate beneficial owners of your company, you need to provide the following information for each person:

- First name
- Surname
- Date of birth
- City of birth
- Country of birth
- Zip code of birth
- Country of residence
- Nationality
- A copy of their ID

An ultimate beneficial owner is a natural person who either owns more than 25% of the company’s capital or voting rights or has controlling power over the company. This information is required to comply with regulatory standards and ensure transparency.

query: Why do I need to share details about my company's income and expenses when opening a Qonto account?
answer: Qonto is a regulated payment institution under the supervision of the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution), which requires us to comply with anti-money laundering regulations and internal security policies. By collecting information about your company's income and expenses, we ensure transparency and compliance while also gaining a better understanding of your business activities and financial situation. This helps us build a strong professional relationship with you and provide the best possible service tailored to your needs.

query: Se elimino una fattura dalla cartella "Processing" su Google Drive, cosa succede?
answer:
Se elimini una fattura dalla cartella "Processing" su Google Drive, l'integrazione potrebbe non funzionare correttamente. Per risolvere il problema, dovrai disinstallare e reinstallare l'integrazione seguendo questi passaggi:

1. Clicca su **Scollega da Google Drive → Qonto** in alto a destra nella pagina **Integrazioni e partnership** nell'applicazione web di Qonto.
2. Clicca su **Disconnect Google Drive → Qonto**.
3. Conferma nuovamente cliccando su **Disconnect Google Drive → Qonto**.

Questa operazione non influenzerà le fatture già abbinate alle transazioni Qonto, quindi non perderai quei dati.

query: Est-ce que je peux recevoir des notifications Qonto sur Slack même si je ne suis pas admin ?
answer: Oui, vous pouvez recevoir des notifications Qonto sur Slack même si vous n'êtes pas admin. Un seul utilisateur par compte (rôle Admin ou Titulaire) peut configurer l'intégration, mais une fois connectée, vous pouvez inviter d'autres membres de votre équipe à rejoindre le canal Slack choisi. Ainsi, chacun peut suivre les finances du compte courant en temps réel, sans avoir besoin d'un accès direct à Qonto.

query: Do I need to manually export my Qonto transactions to share them with my accountant if I use Macompta.fr?
answer: No, you don’t need to manually export your Qonto transactions if you use Macompta.fr. The integration between Qonto and Macompta.fr allows your transaction information to be automatically and securely synchronized. This eliminates the need for manual exports, saving you time and ensuring your data is transferred efficiently. The connection is protected by your Qonto login credentials, and the data is encrypted for security, complying with the EU’s PSD2 directive.

query: What should I do if I'm not happy with the solution provided by Qonto's support team?
answer:
If you are not satisfied with the solution provided by Qonto's support team, you can submit a formal complaint either online or by mail.

For an online submission, send your complaint to [reklamationen@qonto.com](mailto:reklamationen@qonto.com).

If you prefer to submit by mail, send your letter by registered mail with acknowledgment of receipt to:

OLINDA Zweigniederlassung Germany
Beschwerdemanagement Qonto
Warschauer Platz 11-13
10245 Berlin - Germany

You will receive an acknowledgment of receipt within 24 hours, and your complaint will be processed within 15 working days, or up to 35 working days in exceptional cases, with prior notice.

query: Can I use the online advertising card for platforms other than Facebook and Google Ads?
answer: Yes, you can use the online advertising card for a variety of platforms beyond Facebook and Google Ads. The card is compatible with leading ad platforms such as Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, Snapchat Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Apple Search Ads, Twitter Ads, and Leboncoin Publicité. This flexibility allows you to manage your marketing campaigns across multiple platforms seamlessly.

query: Pourquoi certains de mes documents sont marqués avec un symbole d'avertissement ?
answer:
Le symbole ⚠️ à côté d'un document indique un problème potentiel détecté par notre système. Cela peut signifier que le document n'est pas un fichier financier (comme une facture) ou qu'il s'agit d'un doublon d'un document déjà téléchargé.

Pour résoudre ce problème, vous pouvez :
1. Ouvrir le document signalé.
2. Si c'est un doublon, cliquez sur **Vérifier les factures** pour voir et supprimer les documents similaires.
3. Si le document n'est pas pertinent, supprimez-le directement depuis l'écran de révision.

Cette fonctionnalité vous aide à maintenir une bibliothèque de documents organisée et centrée sur les éléments essentiels pour votre gestion financière.

query: Why is there a small difference in the VAT amount on my invoice compared to what I calculated?
answer:
The small difference in the VAT amount on your invoice is due to rounding practices required by accounting standards. VAT calculations often result in fractions of a cent (e.g., 0.001 or 0.0001), which must be rounded to the nearest tenth of a cent for compliance.

Qonto uses the "sum of the roundings" method, where VAT is rounded for each individual product line before summing them up. This ensures precision and transparency, especially for invoices with multiple items. While this may cause minor variations compared to calculating VAT on the total amount, it aligns with regulatory guidelines and provides clearer line-item details.

For example, if you calculate VAT on the total invoice amount, you might get a slightly different result than rounding each line item first. This is a standard practice to maintain accuracy and compliance.

For more details, you can refer to the French tax authority’s guidelines on VAT rounding.

query: Wie kann ich nachträglich eine Rechnung zu einer Überweisung hinzufügen?
answer:
Sie können nachträglich eine Rechnung zu einer Überweisung hinzufügen, indem Sie folgende Schritte ausführen:

1. Gehen Sie in Ihrem Qonto-Konto zum Bereich **„Geschäftskonto“ > „Umsätze“**.
2. Wählen Sie die entsprechende Überweisung aus.
3. Laden Sie den Zahlungsnachweis (z. B. die Rechnung) hoch, den Sie hinzufügen möchten.

Falls es sich um eine geplante Überweisung handelt, die noch nicht in Bearbeitung ist, können Sie die Rechnung auch über den Bereich **„Überweisungen“** hinzufügen:
1. Wählen Sie die Überweisung aus und klicken Sie auf **„Bearbeiten“**.
2. Laden Sie den Zahlungsnachweis hoch.

Achten Sie darauf, dass das Dokument lesbar und sauber ist. Alternativ können Sie die Rechnung auch im Abschnitt **„Lieferantenrechnung“** hochladen.

query: Perché non riesco a modificare le informazioni della mia impresa dall'app?
answer: Le modifiche alle informazioni della tua impresa possono essere effettuate solo tramite computer, non è possibile farlo tramite l'app. Per aggiornare i dati, accedi al tuo conto dal computer, vai nelle **Impostazioni** (in basso a sinistra) e segui i passaggi indicati nella sezione **Attività > Profilo dell'attività**. Ricorda di caricare i documenti richiesti come giustificativo per le modifiche.

query: Can I open a Qonto account for my German GmbH in formation if I live abroad but have a co-founder who lives in Germany?
answer: Yes, you can open a Qonto account for your German GmbH in formation if you live abroad, provided that at least one of the co-founders is permanently resident in Germany. Qonto requires that at least one shareholder or legal representative of the company must be a resident in Germany to proceed with the account opening. Additionally, the company's registered office must be in Germany, and the legal form (GmbH i.G.) must be supported by Qonto. Ensure that all other requirements, such as shareholder structure and share capital, are also met.

query: Comment faire pour ajouter un emoji dans le nom de ma carte Qonto ?
answer:
Pour ajouter un emoji dans le nom de votre carte Qonto, suivez ces étapes :

1. Allez dans la section **‘Compte Pro’**, puis cliquez sur **‘Cartes’** et sélectionnez la carte que vous souhaitez personnaliser.
2. Cliquez sur l'icône du pinceau 🖋️ à droite de "Détails".
3. Dans le champ de nom, ajoutez l'emoji de votre choix depuis votre clavier ou en copiant-collant un emoji.
4. Sauvegardez les modifications.

C'est tout ! Votre carte affichera désormais l'emoji dans son nom. 😊

query: Warum wird meine Qonto IBAN bei einer Überweisung als ungültig abgelehnt?
answer:
Einige traditionelle Banken aktualisieren ihre IBAN-Datenbanken nicht regelmäßig, weshalb Ihre Qonto-IBAN fälschlicherweise als ungültig abgelehnt werden kann. In diesem Fall empfehlen wir Ihnen, den Kundendienst der betreffenden Bank zu kontaktieren und darauf hinzuweisen, dass Ihre IBAN korrekt ist und für den Zahlungsverkehr genutzt werden kann.

Zusätzlich können Sie versuchen, bei der Eingabe des BIC die drei „X“ zu entfernen (z. B. „QNTOFRP1“ für eine französische IBAN oder „QNTODEB2“ für eine deutsche IBAN) und die Überweisung erneut zu senden.

Falls das Problem weiterhin besteht, können Sie uns gerne kontaktieren, indem Sie eine Nachricht mit den relevanten Details (Fehlermeldung, Bankname, IBAN des Senderkontos und Transaktionsdaten) senden. Weitere Informationen finden Sie auch in unserem [Hilfeartikel zu Überweisungen](https://qonto9015-de.zendesk.com/hc/de/articles/23949246923409-Wie-kann-ich-eine-%C3%9Cberweisung-auf-mein-Qonto-Gesch%C3%A4ftskonto-vornehmen).

query: Can I apply for financing through the Qonto mobile app?
answer: No, the Financing section is only accessible via the **Qonto web app**. You can explore and apply for financing offers through the web app if you are an **Admin** or **Owner** with **Corporate Officer** or **Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)** status. The mobile app does not currently support this feature.

query: ¿Puedo usar mi carnet de conducir para abrir una cuenta en Qonto si soy autónomo en España?
answer: No, Qonto no acepta el carnet de conducir como documento de identidad para abrir una cuenta de empresa en España, incluso si eres autónomo. Según la normativa, solo se admiten documentos como el DNI nacional de un país de la UE o del EFTA con banda MRZ, pasaportes de la UE o del EEE (excepto los británicos desde el 01/10/2021), o permisos de residencia en España que autoricen a trabajar. El carnet de conducir no cumple con los requisitos legales para actividades profesionales en España.

query: ¿Puedo modificar los datos de las transacciones directamente en la hoja de Google Sheets sin perder la sincronización?
answer: No, no debes modificar directamente la pestaña **`Sync. Transactions - Do not edit`** en Google Sheets, ya que esto romperá la sincronización con Qonto. Si necesitas editar o analizar los datos de tus transacciones, te recomendamos crear una nueva pestaña en la misma hoja de cálculo y vincularla a la pestaña protegida. De esta manera, podrás trabajar con los datos sin afectar la conexión automática.

query: Kann ich meine Karte wieder freischalten, wenn ich sie versehentlich als verloren gemeldet habe?
answer: Nein, sobald Sie Ihre Karte als verloren oder gestohlen gemeldet haben, wird sie unwiderruflich gesperrt. Dies ist eine Sicherheitsmaßnahme, um Missbrauch zu verhindern. Sie können jedoch ganz einfach eine neue Karte über Ihre Qonto App bestellen. Gehen Sie dazu in den Abschnitt **Geschäftskonto > Karten** und wählen Sie die Option für eine neue Karte aus.

query: ¿Puede Zendesk ver los movimientos de mi cuenta bancaria?
answer: No, Zendesk no puede ver los movimientos de tu cuenta bancaria. Zendesk solo tiene acceso a los datos necesarios para ofrecerte un servicio personalizado, como tu nombre, apellidos y correo electrónico. No comparte ni accede a información personal o bancaria adicional, incluyendo los movimientos de tu cuenta. Qonto garantiza que todas las herramientas utilizadas cumplen con estrictas normas de seguridad para proteger la confidencialidad de tus datos.

query: Do I need to manually update my transactions in Comptalib after setting up the integration with Qonto?
answer: No, you don’t need to manually update your transactions in Comptalib after setting up the integration with Qonto. Once the integration is configured, your Qonto transaction information will be transferred to Comptalib automatically and securely. This eliminates the need for manual exports or updates, saving you time and ensuring your accounting data stays current.

query: What happens if I lose my phone and can't receive the confirmation code to pair a new one?
answer:
If you lose your phone and can't receive the confirmation code to pair a new one, you can still pair a new device by following these steps:

1. Open the Qonto app on your new phone and enter your credentials.
2. Click on **Change paired device**.
3. We will send you an email to verify your new phone—open it on your new device and click **Verify my phone**.
4. Back in the Qonto app, you’ll need to verify your identity by taking a picture of your face. Ensure your face is well-lit, straight, and your eyes are visible if you wear glasses.
5. Once verified, your new phone will be successfully paired.

If you believe your account security is at risk, contact us immediately for assistance. You can also log in from another device by requesting confirmation from your paired phone, but this option is only available if your old phone is still accessible.

query: Comment faire si la TVA n'est pas détectée automatiquement sur une transaction ?
answer:
Si la TVA n'est pas détectée automatiquement sur une transaction, vous pouvez la compléter manuellement directement depuis l'application Qonto. Voici comment procéder :

1. Rendez-vous dans la section **Compte pro**, puis **Historique**.
2. Appliquez un filtre pour afficher les transactions avec une TVA manquante :
   - Cliquez sur **Filtres**.
   - Sélectionnez **TVA** comme valeur, puis choisissez **"inclus"** et **"manquant"** comme critères.
3. Sélectionnez la transaction concernée et saisissez les informations relatives à la TVA dans la partie droite de l'interface.

Vous pouvez également ajouter jusqu'à 8 taux de TVA différents sur une même transaction si nécessaire.

Si vous souhaitez éviter de répéter cette opération, vous pouvez associer un taux de TVA directement à un fournisseur dans l'onglet **Fournisseurs** de la section **Achats**. Cela permettra une détection automatique pour les prochaines transactions avec ce fournisseur.

query: Comment savoir si un email qui demande des informations sur mon compte Qonto est vraiment envoyé par Qonto ?
answer:
Pour vérifier si un e-mail demandant des informations sur votre compte Qonto est légitime, suivez ces étapes :

1. **Vérifiez l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur** : Assurez-vous qu’elle provient bien d’un domaine officiel de Qonto (par exemple, *@qonto.com*). Méfiez-vous des adresses suspectes ou des fautes d’orthographe.

2. **Examinez le contenu du message** : Qonto ne vous demandera **jamais** d’informations sensibles (mot de passe, code d’authentification, etc.) par e-mail. Si le message semble urgent ou menace de suspendre votre compte, il s’agit probablement d’une tentative de fraude.

3. **Ne cliquez pas sur les liens** : Si l’e-mail contient un lien, ne cliquez pas dessus. Passez votre souris sur le lien (sans cliquer) pour voir l’URL réelle. Les liens frauduleux peuvent ressembler à ceux de Qonto mais rediriger vers des sites malveillants.

4. **Vérifiez la présence du cadenas et du *https*** : Si vous êtes redirigé vers un site, assurez-vous qu’il est sécurisé (cadenas dans la barre d’adresse et URL commençant par *https://*).

5. **Contactez Qonto directement** : En cas de doute, connectez-vous à votre compte via l’application officielle ou le site *app.qonto.com* et utilisez le chat intégré pour vérifier l’authenticité du message.

Si l’e-mail vous semble suspect, ignorez-le et signalez-le immédiatement via le chat de l’application Qonto en sélectionnant **"Pour une suspicion de fraude"**.

query: Come posso parlare con un operatore di Qonto se ho un problema urgente?
answer:
Per problemi urgenti, il modo più rapido per parlare con un operatore di Qonto è utilizzare la chat diretta dalla tua interfaccia Qonto, cliccando sull'icona della nuvoletta in basso a destra. Il servizio è attivo **24/7** e ti permetterà di ricevere assistenza immediata.

In alternativa, puoi contattarci telefonicamente al numero **+39 0282959848** per un supporto diretto. Ricorda che per motivi di sicurezza, non forniamo assistenza presso la sede fisica, quindi ti invitiamo a utilizzare esclusivamente i canali ufficiali indicati.

query: Do I need to manually enter my Amazon Business purchases into Qonto, or does the integration do it automatically?
answer: The integration between Amazon Business and Qonto automatically imports and reconciles your Amazon Business invoices with your Qonto transactions, eliminating the need for manual data entry. Once set up, your invoices are synced daily and attached to the corresponding transactions in your Qonto account. You can find them in the **Invoices → Supplier Invoices** section or directly from your transactions after reconciliation.

query: ¿Cómo puedo editar los detalles de una factura de proveedor que ya he subido?
answer:
Para editar los detalles de una factura de proveedor que ya has subido, sigue estos pasos:

1. Accede a la sección **Facturas** > **Facturas de proveedor** desde la aplicación web o móvil.
2. Selecciona la factura que deseas editar haciendo clic en ella.
3. Una vez abierta, podrás modificar la información escaneada por Qonto o añadir detalles faltantes, como:
   - Datos del proveedor
   - Número de factura
   - Fecha de vencimiento
   - Importe a pagar
   - Descripción

Guarda los cambios y la factura quedará actualizada con la nueva información. Esto te permitirá preparar el pago de manera correcta.

query: Puis-je ouvrir un compte Qonto pour mon association même si elle n'est pas encore déclarée ?
answer: Non, Qonto n'accepte que les associations déjà déclarées. Pour ouvrir un compte, votre association doit être officiellement déclarée et immatriculée. La création du compte se fait ensuite en ligne en quelques minutes. Vous trouverez plus de détails sur les types d'associations acceptés dans [cet article](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947660972689-Je-souhaite-ouvrir-un-compte-pour-mon-association-comment-faire).

query: Se ho dei soldi nel mio conto aziendale e un po' di contanti in cassa, fa parte del flusso di cassa dell'impresa?
answer: Sì, i soldi presenti nel tuo conto aziendale e i contanti in cassa fanno parte del flusso di cassa dell’impresa. Questi fondi rappresentano la liquidità immediatamente disponibile, che rientra nella definizione di cassa o tesoreria aziendale. La cassa include infatti tutte le risorse finanziarie liquide o facilmente mobilizzabili, come i fondi sui conti bancari e il denaro contante, che l’azienda può utilizzare per far fronte a spese correnti, imprevisti o altre necessità operative.

query: ¿Por qué no aparece la opción de hacer una transferencia internacional si tengo el rol de Colaborador?
answer:
Actualmente, la opción de realizar transferencias internacionales en divisas no está disponible para los usuarios con el rol de "Colaborador". Esta función está reservada exclusivamente para el Titular de la cuenta, los Administradores y los Managers.

Sin embargo, los Colaboradores sí pueden solicitar transferencias SEPA, que son transferencias en euros dentro de la zona SEPA. Estas solicitudes deben ser validadas posteriormente por un administrador, el titular de la cuenta o un Manager Avanzado, según los límites establecidos.

Si necesitas realizar una transferencia internacional, te recomendamos contactar a uno de los roles con permisos para ello dentro de tu organización.

query: Can I use my Qonto account to sell CBD products?
answer: The sale of CBD products is prohibited on Qonto if the THC content exceeds 0.3% for companies in France or 0.2% for companies in Germany, Italy, and Spain. Additionally, if the THC content is not clearly indicated, the activity is not allowed. Therefore, you cannot use your Qonto account for selling CBD products unless they strictly comply with these THC limits and all applicable regulations.

query: Can I keep using my old card after upgrading to a new one?
answer: No, you cannot keep using your old card indefinitely after upgrading. Your old card will automatically be canceled one month after the upgrade. For example, if you upgrade on June 14, the old card will stop working on July 14. However, the new card will be active immediately for both online and physical payments, including via Apple Pay and Google Pay, as soon as you confirm the order. The PIN for the new card will remain the same as your old one.

query: Can I use the Instant card for multiple purchases before it expires?
answer: Yes, you can use the Instant card for multiple purchases as long as it is within the budget you set and before the expiration date. The Instant card is designed for one-off expenses, but it allows for multiple transactions until it expires or the budget is exhausted. Once the card expires or the budget is fully used, it will no longer be valid for additional purchases.

query: Come posso vedere quanti soldi ho a disposizione sul mio conto in questo momento?
answer: Per vedere quanti soldi hai a disposizione sul tuo conto in questo momento, puoi consultare il grafico del **saldo disponibile** nella tua dashboard. L'importo visualizzato in alto a sinistra di questo grafico rappresenta i fondi attualmente disponibili sul tuo conto al momento esatto in cui consulti la dashboard. Questo indicatore ti permette di avere una visione immediata della tua disponibilità finanziaria.

query: What happens if I don't set up Strong Customer Authentication on my Qonto account?
answer:
If you don't set up Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) on your Qonto account, you may experience limitations or restrictions when performing sensitive operations. SCA is required to comply with the Payment Services Directive (PSD2) and ensures the security of transactions by validating them through a notification on your associated phone. Without SCA, you risk being unable to complete certain critical actions, such as high-value transactions or account modifications.

To avoid any disruptions, we strongly recommend setting up SCA by following [these steps](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23949957227025). This will ensure the smooth and secure use of your Qonto account.

query: Can I change the order of the columns on my invoices?
answer: Yes, you can change the order of the columns on your invoices, but this feature is only available with the **Advanced Account Receivable Add-On**. With this add-on, you can adjust the column order and define custom names for columns such as quantity, unit price, and VAT rate. If you don’t have the add-on, the default column order will apply. You can upgrade your plan to access this customization option.

query: Comment puis-je suivre les dépenses de mon équipe en temps réel ?
answer:
Avec le module Gestion des dépenses d'équipe, vous pouvez suivre les dépenses de votre équipe en temps réel grâce à plusieurs fonctionnalités :

1. **Budgets dédiés** : Vous pouvez définir des budgets spécifiques par équipe, projet ou catégorie de dépenses, et surveiller leur utilisation en direct.
2. **Comptes dédiés** : Créez des comptes avec des IBAN spécifiques pour chaque équipe, ce qui permet un suivi précis des transactions.
3. **Tableau de bord** : Visualisez les dépenses et l'état des budgets en temps réel via l'interface Qonto, avec des mises à jour instantanées.

Ces outils vous offrent une visibilité complète et immédiate sur les dépenses de votre équipe.

query: What happens if I don’t do anything before April 1st regarding the Accounts Receivable add-on?
answer:
If you don’t take any action before April 1st regarding the Accounts Receivable add-on, it will automatically transition to a paid subscription. Here’s what will happen:

1. **Pricing Changes**: Starting April 1st, the add-on will no longer be free. You will be billed at the public price:
   - **Monthly billing**: €45/month (excl. VAT)
   - **Annual billing**: €35/month (excl. VAT), billed as €420 once per year.

2. **Promotional Offers**: If you’re already using the AR add-on, you’ll benefit from a promotional monthly rate of €35/month (excl. VAT) for April, May, and June. If you prefer annual billing, you can switch to a discounted rate of €29/month (excl. VAT) by activating it in your account settings before June 30th.

3. **Continuity of Service**: Your access to advanced features like recurring invoices and automated payment reminders will continue uninterrupted, but you will be charged according to the new pricing.

If you wish to avoid charges, you can opt out of the add-on before April 1st. After April 1st, you can still cancel, but refunds won’t be granted for annual subscriptions. You’ll retain access to all standard invoicing features even if you remove the AR add-on.

query: Why do some months show a negative balance on the cash flow graph?
answer:
The cash flow graph may show a negative balance in certain months when your outflows (expenses) exceed your inflows (revenues) during that period. This is visually represented by the purple line dipping below the horizontal axis.

This situation can occur naturally in business cycles, such as when you have higher expenses at the beginning of the year due to investments or seasonal fluctuations. The dotted line for the current month also indicates that the balance may still change as the month progresses.

You can hover over the bars or the month itself to see detailed information about the inflows and outflows contributing to the balance.

query: Posso annullare un pagamento fatto con la carta se non sono d'accordo con l'importo addebitato?
answer:
Se non sei d'accordo con l'importo addebitato, non è tecnicamente possibile annullare direttamente una transazione in corso. Tuttavia, puoi seguire questi passaggi:

1. **Contatta l'esercente**: Se conosci l'esercente, cerca di risolvere la questione direttamente con lui. In molti casi, può procedere con un rimborso se l'addebito è ingiustificato o errato.

2. **Blocca la carta**: Se la transazione non è stata autorizzata da te, blocca immediatamente la carta per evitare ulteriori addebiti non desiderati.

3. **Contesta l'addebito**: Se non riesci a risolvere la questione con l'esercente, puoi avviare una contestazione seguendo la procedura indicata [qui](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/it/articles/23949967365137-Desideri-contestare-un-addebito-sulla-tua-carta). Puoi anche essere guidato direttamente dall'app desktop cliccando su questo link: [https://app.qonto.com?tdm=request-chargeback](https://app.qonto.com/?tdm=request-chargeback).

Ricorda che Qonto non può annullare una transazione in corso, ma possiamo assisterti nel processo di contestazione. Se necessario, contattaci allegando le comunicazioni con l'esercente per ulteriori supporto.

query: Can I use my Qonto account to pay my employees if my business deals with cryptocurrencies?
answer: Yes, you can use your Qonto account to pay your employees if your business deals with cryptocurrencies, as long as your main activity is not exclusively focused on collecting funds for third-party crypto transactions or operating a trading platform. Qonto allows the use of the account for corporate expenses, including salary payments, provided your business is properly registered or licensed under local regulations (e.g., PSAN registration with the AMF). However, you cannot use the account to handle client funds related to crypto transactions. If your activity involves investment advice on crypto-assets, ensure you are registered with ORIAS. Note that certain digital asset activities, such as mining or NFTs, may require additional compliance review.

query: Can I use the Pay later feature for an invoice under €150?
answer: No, the Pay later feature is only available for invoices of at least €150. The minimum amount required to use this financing option is €150, while the maximum amount depends on your available credit limit, up to €50,000.

query: Can I move a transaction to a different budget after it's been made?
answer: Yes, you can manually reallocate a transaction to a different budget or remove it from any budget after it has been made. As a Manager, you can do this by navigating to the **Transactions** section, selecting the transaction you want to reallocate, and then accessing the transaction details. From there, go to the budget section and choose the new budget you want to associate with the transaction. This allows you to adjust the allocation as needed.

query: How can I get a list of my transactions before my monthly statement is ready?
answer:
You can create a transaction export to get a list of your transactions before your monthly statement is ready. Here’s how:

1. Go to the **Transactions** tab in the **Business account** section.
2. Filter the transactions by settlement date.
3. Click on **Export transactions**.
4. Choose **Simple data export** or create a custom export template with the following columns:
   - Settlement date (UTC)
   - Counterparty name
   - Debit
   - Credit

This export will provide you with a detailed list of your transactions in Excel, CSV, OFX, or QIF format. For more details, you can refer to [this guide](https://support-es.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23951013272593-How-can-I-export-my-transactions).

query: ¿Puedo hacer una transferencia sin tener que subir una factura?
answer: Sí, puedes hacer una transferencia sin subir una factura. En la pestaña **Transferencias** desde **Cuenta de empresa**, selecciona la opción **"No tengo una factura"** y completa manualmente los detalles de la transferencia, como el beneficiario, el IBAN, el importe, la referencia y otros campos necesarios. También puedes configurar la recurrencia, añadir justificantes si el importe supera los 30.000 euros, notificar al beneficiario y agregar detalles de contabilidad. Una vez enviada la solicitud, los administradores o Managers Avanzados (si aplica) serán notificados para su aprobación.

query: ¿Puedo usar mi tarjeta Qonto mientras se verifica mi identidad?
answer: No podrás usar tu tarjeta Qonto hasta que se complete la verificación de tu identidad y se active tu cuenta. Sin embargo, podrás crear tarjetas durante el proceso de verificación, pero estas solo se validarán y estarán operativas una vez finalizadas todas las comprobaciones reglamentarias. Mientras tanto, podrás recibir transferencias en tu cuenta sin problemas.

query: Why hasn’t my direct debit limit increased even though I’ve been receiving more payments?
answer:
Your direct debit collection limit is recalculated at the beginning of each month based on multiple factors, including your account activity and risk assessment. Even if you’ve been receiving more payments, the limit may not increase immediately because:

1. **Timing of Recalculation**: The evaluation happens on the first day of the month, so changes in your inflows may not be reflected until the next assessment.
2. **Overall Account Activity**: While increased payments are positive, Qonto also considers other factors like turnover volume, risk assessment, and the consistency of your financial activity.
3. **External Account Visibility**: If you haven’t connected external accounts, Qonto may not have a full view of your financial situation, which could impact the limit adjustment.

To potentially increase your limit faster, ensure your inflows are centralized in your Qonto account and consider connecting external accounts for a more comprehensive evaluation. If you’ve already done this, the next monthly recalculation may reflect the changes. For further clarification, our support team is available 24/7 via chat.

query: What should I do if I can't find the password reset email from Qonto?
answer:
If you can't find the password reset email from Qonto, follow these steps:

1. **Check your spam or junk folder**: Sometimes, automated emails can be filtered incorrectly. Search for "Qonto" or "password reset" in these folders.
2. **Verify the email address**: Ensure you entered the correct email address associated with your Qonto account when requesting the reset.
3. **Request a new email**: Return to the login page and click **Forgot Password** again to resend the email.
4. **Wait a few minutes**: Emails can sometimes take a few minutes to arrive. Refresh your inbox after waiting.
5. **Contact Qonto support**: If you still don’t receive the email, reach out to Qonto’s customer support for further assistance.

If you’re using strong authentication, ensure your paired device is accessible to confirm the password change.

query: What kind of document should I upload if I want to pay my employee's salary?
answer: To pay your employee's salary, you should upload a payslip or provide the employee's IBAN. These documents are required to justify the transfer and ensure compliance with accounting and regulatory standards.

query: What happens if I enter the wrong account number for an AUD transfer?
answer: If you enter the wrong account number for an AUD transfer, the funds will be credited to the account associated with the incorrect number if it exists. There are no name checks for AUD transfers, so it is crucial to ensure the account number is accurate. If the incorrect account number does not belong to an existing account, the transfer may fail or be delayed. Always double-check the BSB code and account number before confirming the transfer to avoid misdirecting funds.

query: Come posso vedere tutte le carte associate ai membri di un team?
answer:
Per visualizzare tutte le carte associate ai membri di un team, segui questi passaggi:

1. Accedi alla sezione **Impostazioni > Gestione utenti > Gestione team**.
2. Seleziona il team di tuo interesse.
3. Clicca sulla seconda icona nel riquadro del team, raffigurante una carta. Questa opzione ti mostrerà tutte le carte attribuite ai membri del team selezionato.

In alternativa, puoi utilizzare i filtri team direttamente dalle sezioni **Gestione utenti**, **Transazioni** o **Carte** per un accesso più rapido.

Ricorda che questa funzionalità è disponibile solo per i piani Essential, Business ed Enterprise, e che i Titolari, gli Admin e i Manager possono visualizzare queste informazioni.

query: ¿Puedo usar una factura de internet como prueba de domicilio para abrir mi cuenta de autónomo en Qonto?
answer:
Sí, puedes usar una factura de internet como prueba de domicilio para abrir tu cuenta de autónomo en Qonto, siempre que cumpla con los siguientes requisitos:

- La factura debe ser reciente, es decir, emitida en los últimos 3 meses.
- Debe estar a tu nombre y reflejar claramente tu domicilio fiscal.
- Debe ser de un servicio básico, como internet, que esté vinculado a tu dirección.

Asegúrate de que el documento sea legible y que el código CSV (si aplica) sea visible al subirlo.

query: How long will it take for my transfers to go through while my account is being verified?
answer: While your account is being verified, you can initiate transfers, but they won’t be completed until your identity is confirmed. The regulatory checks typically take up to 5 business days for specific cases. Once the verification is complete, you’ll receive a confirmation email, and any restrictions on your transfers will be automatically removed. During this time, you can still receive incoming payments.

query: J'ai fait un virement à un fournisseur mais il ne répond plus et je n'ai pas reçu ma commande, comment récupérer mon argent ?
answer:
Si vous avez effectué un virement à un fournisseur qui ne répond plus et n’a pas honoré sa part du contrat, voici les étapes à suivre :

1. **Portez plainte** dans les plus brefs délais et obtenez une copie du procès-verbal.
2. **Transmettez-nous ce document** : notre service client initiera alors une demande de retour de fonds.

⚠️ Cette demande doit être effectuée **dans les 13 mois suivant le virement**.

Si vous n’êtes pas client Qonto, transmettez-nous les informations du compte concerné pour que nous puissions agir. Dans tous les cas, informez également votre banque de la situation.

query: Can I change the amount of an international transfer after scheduling it?
answer: No, you cannot change the amount of an international transfer after scheduling it. If you need to modify the amount, you will have to cancel the scheduled transfer and create a new one with the updated details.
