Other information, such as the account to be debited or the beneficiary, also cannot be edited once the transfer is scheduled.

query: Kann ich als Einzelperson ein GbR-Konto bei Qonto eröffnen, oder brauche ich dafür mindestens einen weiteren Partner?
answer:
Nein, ein GbR-Konto bei Qonto kann nicht von einer Einzelperson eröffnet werden. Eine Gesellschaft bürgerlichen Rechts (GbR) setzt per Definition mindestens zwei Partner voraus, die natürliche Personen sein müssen. Qonto akzeptiert die Kontoeröffnung nur für GbRs mit mindestens zwei Partnern, die gemeinsam oder einzeln vertretungsberechtigt sind.

Falls Sie als Einzelperson ein Geschäftskonto benötigen, könnten andere Kontoformen wie ein Einzelunternehmen oder Freiberufler-Konto bei Qonto infrage kommen.

query: ¿Por qué no puedo cancelar una transferencia que ya está "enviada"?
answer:
Una vez que una transferencia está marcada como "enviada", significa que los fondos ya han salido de tu cuenta y el proceso se ha completado. En este punto, la transferencia no puede cancelarse porque el dinero ya está en tránsito hacia el beneficiario.

Si necesitas anular la transferencia, te recomendamos ponerte en contacto directamente con el beneficiario para solicitar la devolución de los fondos. Si tienes alguna duda adicional, nuestro equipo de soporte está disponible para ayudarte a través del chat.

query: Can I export transactions with only specific columns, like just the date and amount?
answer: Yes, you can export transactions with only specific columns, such as just the date and amount. When creating or editing a custom export template in the **Transactions** section, you can select and deselect columns to include only the data you need. By default, three columns are proposed (settlement date, counterparty name, and total amount), but you can remove unwanted columns and keep only the date and amount. You can also rearrange the columns using drag-and-drop for better organization. Once your template is set up, save it and use it for future exports. This feature is available to Smart, Premium, Essential, Business, and Enterprise customers.

query: ¿Puedo usar la prueba gratis del Plan Smart si ya tengo el Plan Basic desde hace un tiempo?
answer: Sí, puedes disfrutar de la prueba gratis del Plan Smart si ya tienes el Plan Basic, siempre que no hayas activado previamente esta prueba, ya que la oferta es válida solo una vez por cuenta. Además, es necesario que hayas superado los primeros 30 días gratuitos iniciales de Qonto. La prueba está disponible tanto para clientes con facturación mensual como anual.

query: ¿Qué pasa si el vendedor no me responde después de contactarlo por un problema con mi compra?
answer: Si el vendedor no te responde después de contactarlo por un problema con tu compra, debes esperar un plazo de 7 días para proceder con la disputa. Durante este tiempo, es importante que documentes el intento de comunicación, por ejemplo, con capturas de pantalla o fotos que demuestren que has intentado resolver el problema directamente. Una vez transcurridos los 7 días sin respuesta, puedes iniciar el proceso de disputa a través de tu cuenta, seleccionando la transacción problemática y siguiendo los pasos indicados. Asegúrate de adjuntar las pruebas de tu intento de contacto y cualquier otro documento relevante que respalde tu reclamación.

query: Does the purchase protection cover my laptop if I bought it in parts with my Qonto Plus card?
answer: No, the purchase protection does not cover your laptop if you bought it in parts with your Qonto Plus card. The coverage applies only to products paid in full with your Qonto Plus or X card. Additionally, the purchase must have a minimum value of over €50 to be eligible for protection.

query: Se faccio un bonifico con Qonto, dove trovo il codice che serve per dimostrare che il pagamento è andato a buon fine?
answer:
Il codice che ti serve per dimostrare l'avvenuto pagamento è il **codice end-to-end**, un identificativo unico del bonifico SEPA. Puoi trovarlo direttamente nella **ricevuta di esecuzione del bonifico**, che Qonto genera automaticamente dopo ogni operazione.

Questo codice, composto da un massimo di 35 caratteri alfanumerici, è utile per tracciare il pagamento, dimostrarne l'avvenuta esecuzione al beneficiario o per scopi fiscali/contabili.

Per scaricare la ricevuta con il codice end-to-end, puoi seguire le istruzioni nella nostra FAQ: "[Come scaricare la prova di esecuzione di un bonifico?](https://support-it.qonto.com/hc/it/articles/23949975364625-Come-posso-scaricare-la-ricevuta-di-esecuzione-di-un-bonifico)".

query: Can I use my Qonto account to pay my employees if my business is mainly about trading cryptocurrencies?
answer:
Yes, you can use your Qonto account to pay your employees if your main business activity involves trading cryptocurrencies. Qonto allows businesses in the crypto-asset sector to open an account for corporate expenses, such as salary payments and bill payments.

However, ensure that your business is properly registered or licensed under local regulations (e.g., PSAN registration with the AMF in France). Additionally, note that you cannot use your Qonto account to collect funds from third parties for crypto-related transactions or platform operations.

query: Can I open a Qonto account if my business is a small freelance operation in Italy?
answer: Yes, you can open a Qonto account if your business is a small freelance operation in Italy. Qonto supports Italian freelancers under the legal entities **"Libero Professionista"** or **"Lavoratore Autonomo."** Simply ensure your business is registered accordingly, and you can proceed with opening an account.

query: Come faccio a sapere se la mia nuova carta è già stata spedita?
answer:
Se la tua nuova carta è già stata spedita, riceverai una notifica via email con i tempi di consegna stimati e l’indirizzo a cui è stata inviata. Questa comunicazione arriva circa **6 settimane prima della scadenza della vecchia carta**, dopo aver confermato o aggiornato il tuo indirizzo di consegna (se richiesto).

Puoi anche controllare lo stato della spedizione direttamente nell’app Qonto o nella tua area personale sul sito, dove troverai gli aggiornamenti in tempo reale. Se non hai ricevuto alcuna notifica, verifica nella tua casella email o nella sezione "Carte" dell’app per maggiori dettagli.

query: Posso inviare più richieste di rimborso chilometrico contemporaneamente?
answer: Al momento non è possibile inviare più richieste di rimborso chilometrico nello stesso momento su Qonto. Puoi inviare una richiesta alla volta, fornendo i dettagli necessari come la distanza percorsa, il motivo del viaggio e il tuo IBAN personale.

query: What documents do I need to provide if I'm not the legal representative of my company?
answer: If you are not the legal representative of your company, you will need to provide a **power of attorney** from the legal representative authorizing you to act on their behalf, as well as their **valid identity document**. Additionally, you must provide your own identity document and the details of the company’s beneficial owners.

query: Ho pagato una spesa per l'azienda con i miei soldi: come faccio a farmi rimborsare?
answer:
Per ottenere il rimborso di una spesa aziendale pagata con i tuoi soldi, puoi seguire questi passaggi:

1. **Se sei un Titolare, Admin o Manager**:
   - Vai nella sezione **Bonifici** del tuo account Qonto.
   - Effettua un bonifico verso il tuo conto bancario personale, allegando la ricevuta della spesa.
   - Per un rimborso più veloce, puoi utilizzare un bonifico istantaneo.

2. **Se sei un membro del team**:
   - Utilizza la funzione **Note spese** per inviare una richiesta di rimborso.
   - La richiesta verrà approvata da un Admin o Manager con i permessi necessari, e riceverai il rimborso tramite bonifico.

In entrambi i casi, assicurati di includere la documentazione giustificativa della spesa per facilitare il processo.

query: Perché non vedo le ricevute delle mie transazioni su Zoho Books?
answer: Per visualizzare le ricevute delle tue transazioni su Zoho Books, è necessario categorizzare le transazioni sincronizzate. Una volta applicata una categoria, gli allegati verranno automaticamente aggiunti durante la successiva sincronizzazione, che avviene ogni giorno alle 20:30. Assicurati di aver seguito questo passaggio per garantire che le ricevute vengano correttamente importate.

query: ¿Puedo elegir qué transacciones migrar o se transfieren todas automáticamente?
answer:
Con el servicio de migración de cuenta de Qonto, no se transfieren automáticamente todas tus transacciones. En su lugar, se analizan tus transacciones de los últimos 12 meses para identificar las acciones necesarias (como mandatos de adeudo directo, transferencias o pagos con tarjeta) que debes gestionar manualmente.

Tú decides qué transacciones o acciones completar durante el proceso de migración, guiado por un plan personalizado creado por tu asesor. No hay una transferencia automática de transacciones, sino un análisis que te ayuda a priorizar y gestionar los cambios necesarios.

query: Does my Qonto card cover my family members if they travel with me?
answer:
Yes, your Qonto Plus or X card provides travel insurance coverage for your family members under certain conditions. The eligible family members include:

- Your spouse
- Your unmarried children or grandchildren under the age of 25
- Your fiscally dependent ascendants

The trip must be purchased with your Qonto Plus or X card, be more than 100 km from your home or office, and last less than 90 days. Coverage applies worldwide, except in specified countries like North Korea, Cuba, Iran, Sudan, Syria, and Ukraine.

query: Pourquoi je n'arrive pas à ouvrir un nouveau compte après la fermeture du mien par Qonto ?
answer:
La fermeture de votre compte Qonto peut être due à plusieurs raisons administratives, comme une radiation, un redressement judiciaire, une interdiction de gérer, un compte débiteur, un conflit de gérance, une activité non supportée par Qonto ou une erreur lors de l’ouverture du compte. Ces situations peuvent parfois compliquer l’ouverture d’un nouveau compte dans un autre établissement bancaire.

Si vous rencontrez des difficultés pour ouvrir un nouveau compte, voici quelques pistes à explorer :
1. **Vérifiez les motifs de clôture** : Consultez l’e-mail de notification envoyé par Qonto pour comprendre la raison exacte de la fermeture. Cela peut vous aider à anticiper les éventuelles restrictions lors de l’ouverture d’un nouveau compte.
2. **Utilisez le droit au compte** : Si les banques refusent votre demande, vous pouvez faire appel à la procédure de **droit au compte**, qui permet à la Banque de France de désigner un établissement bancaire pour vous. Plus d’informations [ici](https://entreprendre.service-public.fr/vosdroits/F21118).
3. **Comparez les offres bancaires** : Certaines banques en ligne ou traditionnelles peuvent avoir des critères d’acceptation différents. Vous pouvez utiliser des comparateurs comme ceux proposés par Qonto pour trouver une alternative adaptée :
   - [Comparateur de banques en ligne](https://qonto.com/fr/comparators/online-banks)
   - [Comparateur de banques traditionnelles](https://qonto.com/fr/comparators/banks)

N’hésitez pas à contacter le support client de Qonto si vous avez besoin d’informations supplémentaires sur les motifs de clôture de votre compte.

query: ¿Puedo añadir a alguien como administrador si ya tengo uno en mi cuenta Qonto?
answer:
Sí, puedes añadir a alguien como administrador adicional en tu cuenta Qonto, incluso si ya tienes uno. Todos los planes para autónomos (Basic, Smart y Premium) permiten añadir administradores adicionales por un coste de 10 €/mes (IVA excluido). Para hacerlo, sigue estos pasos:

1. Ve a **Gestión de usuarios** > **Acceso usuarios** > **Invitar a un miembro** (en la aplicación web) o a **Menú** > Configuración "⚙️" > **Acceso Usuarios** (en la aplicación móvil).
2. Selecciona el rol de **Admin** para el nuevo miembro.
3. Asigna al nuevo administrador a un equipo (si aplica) y confirma la información.

El nuevo administrador recibirá un correo electrónico de invitación y deberá completar su verificación de identidad antes de poder gestionar la cuenta.

query: What should I do if I don’t receive the verification code to change my email address?
answer:
If you don’t receive the verification code to change your email address, follow these steps:

1. **Check your spam or junk folder** – The email might have been filtered incorrectly.
2. **Wait a few minutes** – Sometimes, delivery can be delayed.
3. **Request a new code** – If the email still hasn’t arrived, you can request a new verification code from the Qonto app or website.
4. **Ensure the email address is correct** – Double-check that you entered the correct new email address when initiating the change.

If you still encounter issues, contact Qonto support for further assistance.

query: Perché non riesco a confermare le operazioni nell'app Qonto anche se ho inserito le credenziali?
answer:
Se non riesci a confermare le operazioni nell'app Qonto nonostante l'inserimento delle credenziali, è probabile che il problema sia legato all'autenticazione a due fattori (2FA) o all'associazione del tuo telefono.

Ecco i passaggi da verificare:

1. **Assicurati che il tuo telefono sia correttamente associato al conto Qonto**. Se non l'hai ancora fatto, segui la procedura per associare il dispositivo:
   - Accedi all'app Qonto sul tuo telefono.
   - Clicca su "Associa il tuo telefono" (dopo aver attivato la 2FA).
   - Inserisci il codice ricevuto via SMS e attiva le notifiche.

2. **Controlla che la 2FA sia attivata**. Senza di essa, alcune operazioni potrebbero non essere confermabili.

3. **Verifica la connessione internet** e assicurati che l'app sia aggiornata all'ultima versione disponibile.

4. **Se hai cambiato telefono**, devi associare il nuovo dispositivo seguendo la procedura specifica:
   - Apri l'app Qonto sul nuovo telefono e inserisci le credenziali.
   - Clicca su "Associa questo dispositivo" o "Cambia dispositivo associato" e segui le istruzioni.

Se il problema persiste, contatta il supporto Qonto per assistenza personalizzata.

query: Can I use Tap to Pay if my phone has a thick case?
answer: A thick or metallic phone case can interfere with the NFC signal, potentially causing issues with Tap to Pay. If you encounter problems, try removing the case and placing the card directly on the back of your phone. The NFC chip is usually located near the camera or in the center of the device, so ensure the card is positioned correctly. If needed, refer to your phone's manual for the exact NFC chip location. Testing with your own card can help you find the best reading zone.

query: Est-ce que je dois payer quelque chose pour connecter mon expert-comptable à mon compte Qonto ?
answer: La connexion de votre expert-comptable en ligne à votre compte Qonto est généralement gratuite. Cependant, certains experts-comptables ou plateformes peuvent facturer des frais pour leurs services ou l'utilisation de leur solution de synchronisation. Pour être certain, nous vous recommandons de vérifier directement auprès de votre expert-comptable en ligne ou de consulter les conditions tarifaires de leur plateforme. Qonto ne facture aucun frais supplémentaire pour cette intégration.

query: Se ricevo un bonifico SWIFT in dollari, quanto mi verrà addebitato per la conversione in euro?
answer:
Per la conversione in euro di un bonifico SWIFT in dollari, Qonto applica una commissione di circa il 2% sul tasso di cambio interbancario, grazie a un accordo con la nostra banca corrispondente. Questa percentuale è una stima e può variare leggermente in base alla data, all'importo del bonifico e alla valuta specifica.

Tieni presente che se la conversione viene effettuata dalla banca emittente o da una banca intermediaria prima che i fondi arrivino a Qonto, non possiamo controllare le commissioni applicate, che potrebbero essere diverse. In questo caso, riceverai direttamente l'importo già convertito in euro, ma le commissioni potrebbero non essere visibili.

Per evitare costi aggiuntivi, ti consigliamo di chiedere al mittente di selezionare l'opzione **OUR** al momento dell'invio, in modo che tutte le spese, incluse quelle di conversione, siano a suo carico.

query: Was passiert mit meinem Geld, wenn Qonto pleitegeht?
answer: Ihr Geld ist auch im Falle einer Insolvenz von Qonto vollständig geschützt. Da Ihre Gelder gemäß den gesetzlichen Anforderungen strikt von den eigenen Finanzmitteln von Qonto getrennt werden, würden sie im Konkursfall zu 100 % von den Partnerbanken unter Aufsicht der ACPR an Sie zurückerstattet. Dies gilt unabhängig von der finanziellen Situation von Qonto, da Ihre Einlagen isoliert und durch verschiedene Sicherheitsmechanismen abgesichert sind.

query: Can I send a draft invoice to my client to check the details before finalizing it?
answer: Yes, you can send a draft invoice to your client to check the details before finalizing it. This provisional version, known as a proforma invoice, allows you to share a proposal or confirm details without any accounting effect. To do this, click on **Share draft** at the bottom of the screen, enter your client’s email address, customize your message, and click **Send email**. Alternatively, you can copy the document link to share it via another channel. Once the details are confirmed, you can convert the draft into a final invoice by clicking **Create invoice**.

query: Do I need to provide all the supporting documents at once when registering my business, or can I submit them later?
answer:
When registering your business with the Guichet Unique, you must provide all the required supporting documents at once during the registration process. The **Attachments** section of the application requires you to submit all necessary documents, such as identity documents, proof of address, the deposit certificate, bylaws, and any other relevant paperwork, before finalizing your submission.

Your file must be complete to avoid rejection. If any documents are missing, your registration may be delayed or denied. Therefore, it is essential to gather and upload all the required documents before submitting your application. Once submitted, you will receive a deposit summary, but this is not a proof of incorporation—it is merely a recap of your case. For more details on accepted proof of incorporation, you can refer to [Qonto's guidelines](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947579782545).

query: Come posso aggiungere la mia Carta Digital Advertising a Facebook Ads?
answer:
Per aggiungere la tua Carta Digital Advertising a Facebook Ads, segui questi passaggi:

1. Accedi al tuo account Qonto e vai alla sezione **Carte**.
2. Seleziona la tua Carta Digital Advertising e clicca su **Rivela** nel pannello laterale per visualizzare i dettagli della carta.
3. Copia i dati della carta (numero, data di scadenza e CVV).
4. Accedi al tuo account Facebook Ads e vai alle impostazioni di pagamento.
5. Aggiungi un nuovo metodo di pagamento e inserisci i dettagli della carta copiati in precedenza.

Se vuoi mantenere tutto organizzato, puoi anche rinominare la carta (ad esempio "Facebook Ads") dalla sezione **Dettagli** della carta.

query: What happens if I forget the first PIN I set when I received my card?
answer: If you forget the first PIN you set when you received your card, it won’t be possible to reset it for security reasons. In this case, you will need to delete the card and order a new one. You can do this from the Cards section in your Qonto account.

query: Can I connect my PayPal account to Qonto, and if so, how do I do it on my phone?
answer:
Yes, you can connect your PayPal account to Qonto. To do this on your phone, follow these steps:

1. Open the Qonto mobile app and go to the **Home** screen.
2. Navigate to the **Balance** section and tap the ➕ symbol.
3. Select **External account**.
4. Approve the connection by tapping **Allow and continue**.
5. Search for and select **PayPal** from the list of institutions.
6. Log in with your PayPal credentials and **allow the connection** to Qonto.

Once connected, your PayPal account will appear in the **Accounts** section of your Qonto interface, and you can view its transactions alongside your other accounts. If PayPal doesn’t appear in the list, you can request it by filling out [this form](https://help.qonto.com/en/articles/4359644-how-can-i-export-my-transactions), which will be forwarded to Qonto’s team.

query: Se la mia società è una SRL con più soci, ma nessuno ha il 25% delle quote, come faccio a sapere chi è il titolare effettivo?
answer:
Per una SRL in cui nessun socio possiede almeno il 25% delle quote, il titolare effettivo viene identificato seguendo questi criteri nell'ordine:

1. **Controllo della maggioranza dei voti** in assemblea ordinaria.
2. **Controllo dei voti sufficienti** per esercitare un’influenza dominante in assemblea ordinaria.
3. **Vincoli contrattuali** che consentano a una persona di esercitare un’influenza dominante sulla società.
4. **Potenze di rappresentanza legale, amministrazione o direzione** della società.

Se nessuno di questi criteri è soddisfatto, si considerano titolari effettivi i soggetti con poteri di amministrazione o direzione.

query: What happens if I don’t receive my tax number within 30 days?
answer: If you don’t receive your tax number within 30 days, your transactions on your Qonto business account will be blocked until you provide the tax number. Once you receive it, you can upload it to your Qonto account to reactivate your transactions. This measure is in place to comply with regulatory requirements.

query: Warum wurde meine Kartenzahlung im Supermarkt abgelehnt, obwohl ich Lebensmittel kaufen wollte?
answer:
Ihre Kartenzahlung im Supermarkt wurde möglicherweise abgelehnt, weil der Händler-Kategorie-Code (MCC) des Supermarkts nicht der von Ihnen genehmigten Kategorie „Lebensmittel“ entspricht.

Supermärkte können unterschiedliche MCC-Codes haben, die nicht immer eindeutig der Kategorie „Lebensmittel“ zugeordnet sind. Wenn der MCC des Händlers beispielsweise mit einer anderen Dienstleistung verknüpft ist, die nicht in Ihren genehmigten Ausgabenkategorien enthalten ist, wird die Transaktion abgelehnt.

In solchen Fällen erhalten Sie eine sofortige Benachrichtigung, in der Sie aufgefordert werden, sich an den Administrator zu wenden, um die Ausgabenkategorien anzupassen. Alternativ können Sie oder Ihr Administrator uns direkt per Chat über Ihr Qonto-Konto kontaktieren, indem Sie auf die Sprechblase in der rechten unteren Ecke klicken.

query: How long does it take to receive the deposit certificate in paper format?
answer: The deposit certificate in paper format is sent within 5 working days to the personal address of the account owner.

query: Warum kann ich die Daten in der Tabelle "Sync. Transactions - Do not edit" nicht direkt bearbeiten?
answer:
Die Tabelle "Sync. Transactions - Do not edit" ist vor direkten Bearbeitungen geschützt, um die automatische Synchronisierung Ihrer Qonto-Transaktionen zu gewährleisten. Wenn Sie diese Tabelle ändern, wird die Verbindung unterbrochen, und Ihre Transaktionen werden nicht mehr automatisch importiert.

Um die Daten dennoch zu nutzen, können Sie sie in ein neues Arbeitsblatt duplizieren, indem Sie die `=IMPORTRANGE`-Funktion verwenden. So bleiben die Originaldaten unangetastet, während Sie in der kopierten Version alle gewünschten Anpassungen vornehmen können. Weitere Details zur Funktion finden Sie in diesem [Google-Support-Artikel](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/3093340?hl=en).

query: Posso usare Qonto anche se non ho esperienza con la contabilità?
answer:
Sì, puoi usare Qonto anche senza esperienza con la contabilità. Qonto è progettato per essere intuitivo e user-friendly, semplificando la gestione finanziaria grazie a funzionalità come la corrispondenza automatica delle ricevute, l'etichettatura personalizzata delle transazioni e strumenti integrati per la fatturazione e il flusso di cassa.

Inoltre, Qonto ti aiuta a digitalizzare e categorizzare le operazioni, rendendo la contabilità più accessibile anche per chi non ha competenze specifiche. Se hai bisogno di supporto, il servizio clienti è disponibile 7 giorni su 7 per assisterti.

query: What happens if I accidentally give an integration too much access to my Qonto account?
answer: If you accidentally grant an integration more access than intended, you can easily revoke or adjust its permissions at any time. Simply go to the "Partners & Integrations" section in your Qonto account and modify or remove the access rights as needed. This ensures you maintain full control over your data and account security. Additionally, integrations are designed with targeted access, meaning they only interact with the necessary information, and sensitive actions require double authentication for extra protection. If you need assistance, each integration’s support team is available to help you directly.

query: Muss ich meine Transaktionen manuell in Xero übertragen oder passiert das automatisch?
answer: Sie müssen Ihre Transaktionen nicht manuell in Xero übertragen. Die Integration zwischen Qonto und Xero synchronisiert Ihre Transaktionen automatisch dreimal täglich (um 9 Uhr, 16 Uhr und 23 Uhr). Sobald neue Transaktionen in Qonto erfasst werden, werden sie ohne manuellen Export direkt in Xero übertragen und stehen dort zur Abgleichung oder Analyse bereit. Beachten Sie jedoch, dass Anhänge wie Belege nicht automatisch synchronisiert werden und manuell in Xero hochgeladen werden müssen.

query: What should I do if the merchant doesn't respond to my complaint before I start the dispute?
answer: If the merchant does not respond to your complaint within 7 days, you can proceed with initiating the dispute process. Make sure to provide proof of your attempt to contact the merchant, such as screenshots or photos showing your communication and the lack of response. This evidence will support your claim during the dispute process. Once you have this documentation, follow the steps in your account to dispute the transaction by selecting it, choosing the appropriate issue, and submitting the required details.

query: Why can't I send money to Japan right now even though it's a weekday?
answer: You may be unable to send money to Japan right now because it could be a Japanese banking holiday, even though it's a weekday. International transfers in foreign currencies are also unavailable during night hours or if the recipient country's banking system is closed due to local holidays. If this is the case, try again on the next business day during business hours (9 AM–7 PM).

query: Can I use a phone bill from 4 months ago as proof of address?
answer: No, a phone bill from 4 months ago cannot be used as proof of address. Qonto requires that invoices from internet or telephone providers be issued less than **3 months ago** to be considered valid. Please provide a more recent document from the accepted list to complete your account opening.

query: Why is there a "processing" transaction on my account that hasn’t been debited yet?
answer:
When you make a payment with your Qonto card, the merchant requests an authorization to check if you have sufficient funds. This authorization appears as a **"processing"** transaction in your account history, blocking the amount but not debiting it yet.

The merchant typically confirms the transaction within 2-3 days, after which it will be fully processed. If the transaction remains **"processing"** without confirmation, it can stay in this state for **up to 9 days** before being automatically canceled. Once canceled, the transaction will appear crossed out in your history, and the blocked amount will be released.

If the payment was declined but still shows as **"processing"**, don’t worry—the funds won’t be debited. This can happen if the authorization was approved by Qonto but the merchant didn’t receive confirmation due to technical issues. The transaction will disappear from your account within 9 days, and your balance will be updated accordingly.

query: What should I do if my transactions aren't showing up in Notion?
answer:
If your transactions aren't showing up in Notion, you can try disconnecting and reconnecting the integration. Here’s how to resolve the issue:

1. **Option 1 (New Notion Page):**
   a. Disconnect the Notion integration from your Qonto app.
   b. Go to **Integrations and Partnerships** in Qonto and set up a new Notion authentication, connecting it to a new Notion page.

2. **Option 2 (Keep the Same Notion Page):**
   a. Duplicate the current Notion page where your transactions should appear.
   b. Delete the old page.
   c. Disconnect the integration.
   d. Reconnect with a new Notion authentication from **Integrations and Partnerships** and grant access to the newly duplicated page.

Note that disconnecting the integration may temporarily remove access to your transactions, but reconnecting will restore the synchronization, which updates every three hours. If you need further assistance, you can refer to Notion’s [Guides](https://www.notion.so/help/guides) or [Help Center](https://www.notion.so/help).

query: Can I create different categories for my expenses and income using labels?
answer: Yes, you can create different categories for your expenses and income using analytics labels. You can set up to 10 lists, each representing a category (e.g., "Transport" or "Online Marketing"), and add specific labels within them (e.g., "Train" or "Facebook Ads"). This allows you to categorize and track your transactions effectively. You can then assign these labels to your transactions manually via the web or mobile app, helping you organize your finances and analyze your cash flow on your dashboard. For more details, you can refer to [this article](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/en-us/articles/23947632488465).

query: How do I share my IBAN with someone else from the app?
answer:
To share your IBAN with someone else from the Qonto app, follow these steps:

**Mobile App:**
1. Open the app and go to **"Menu"**.
2. Navigate to the **"Accounts (IBAN)"** section and select the desired account.
3. Tap **"Share IBAN"** to copy your account details in text format, which you can then paste and share via messaging, email, or any other platform.

**Web App:**
1. Click on the **"Business account"** section, then **"Transactions"**.
2. Click on the **"Bank details"** button.
3. Select **"Copy"** to get your IBAN in text format, which you can then share as needed.

This allows you to quickly and easily share your account details without downloading a file.

query: Est-ce que je peux utiliser l'argent réservé pendant les 8 semaines pour d'autres dépenses ?
answer: Non, l'argent réservé pendant les 8 semaines n'est pas disponible pour d'autres dépenses. Ce montant est temporairement bloqué pour couvrir d'éventuels remboursements ou litiges liés aux prélèvements automatiques. Il sera automatiquement libéré après la période de 8 semaines si aucun incident n'est signalé. Vous pouvez suivre le statut de ces réserves dans la section **Prélèvements automatiques entrants** de votre compte.

query: Can a manager pay an invoice if they don't have transfer permissions?
answer: If a Manager does not have transfer permissions, they cannot pay an invoice directly. However, they can request payment for invoices in euros directly from the Supplier invoices section. This request will then be sent for approval to an Owner, Admin, or authorized Manager, who can review and approve it either from the Supplier invoices section or the Requests section. This ensures that payments are still processed securely even when the Manager lacks direct transfer permissions.

query: Pourquoi est-ce que je reçois des notifications sur mon téléphone quand je fais des opérations sur mon compte ?
answer:
Vous recevez des notifications sur votre téléphone lors d'opérations sur votre compte car Qonto utilise l'**authentification forte (SCA)** pour sécuriser les actions sensibles. Cette méthode, conforme à la réglementation DSP2, valide l'origine et la légitimité de l'opération via une notification sur le téléphone associé à votre compte. Cela garantit une protection optimale contre les fraudes, en s'assurant que c'est bien vous qui effectuez l'opération.

Pour en savoir plus, consultez l'article dédié : [Qu'est-ce que l'authentification forte (SCA) ?](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947670125329-Qu-est-ce-que-l-authentification-forte-SCA).

query: Was mache ich, wenn mein Kunde die Rechnungsnummer nicht in die Überweisung eingetragen hat?
answer:
Wenn Ihr Kunde die Rechnungsnummer nicht in die Überweisung eingetragen hat, können Sie die Rechnung manuell mit der eingehenden Transaktion abgleichen. Gehen Sie dazu wie folgt vor:

1. Öffnen Sie die Rechnung in der Rubrik **Rechnungen**.
2. Klicken Sie auf **„Als bezahlt markieren“**.
3. Wählen Sie die passende Transaktion aus den empfohlenen Optionen aus oder suchen Sie nach dem Kundennamen, der Referenz oder dem Betrag.
4. Bestätigen Sie die Zuordnung.

Falls die Zahlung außerhalb von Qonto oder in bar erfolgt ist, können Sie dies ebenfalls manuell erfassen, indem Sie auf **„Wurden Sie außerhalb von Qonto bezahlt?“** klicken und das Zahlungsdatum angeben.

Diese Methode ist besonders nützlich, wenn Ihr Kunde die Rechnung in Raten bezahlt oder die Referenz fehlt.

query: Does Qonto follow any security standards besides ISO 27001?
answer:
Yes, Qonto follows several security standards and regulations in addition to ISO 27001. As a payment institution regulated by the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution), Qonto complies with strict security requirements, including:

- **EU Directive 2015/2366 on Payment Services (DSP2)**, which sets security and authentication standards for electronic payments.
- **EBA Guidelines on ICT and Security Risk Management**, ensuring robust information and communication technology security practices.
- **Decree of 3 November 2014** and the **ACPR notice on IT risk management** from 7 July 2021, which outline specific security measures for financial institutions.
- **PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)**, which governs the secure handling of payment card data.
- **Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)**, Regulation 2022/2554, which will further strengthen operational resilience in the financial sector when it takes effect in 2025.

These regulations ensure that Qonto maintains high security standards to protect your data and transactions.

query: What do I need to do if I signed up with Google and want to change my email address?
answer:
To change your email address if you signed up with Google, follow these steps:

1. **Access your Qonto app** on your computer or mobile device.
2. **Navigate to your personal profile**:
   - On **desktop**: Go to **Settings** > **Personal settings** > **Personal profile**.
   - On **mobile**: Go to the **Plus** tab > **Personal settings** > **Personal profile**.
3. Click the **Change** button next to your current email address and enter your new email.
4. Confirm the change by entering the **6-digit verification code** sent to your new email.
5. Since you signed up with Google, you’ll be prompted to **set up a password** after entering the verification code:
   - You’ll be signed out of your account.
   - Check your new email for a link to set up your password.
   - Click the link and follow the instructions to create your password.

Once completed, your email address will be updated, and you can log in with your new credentials.

query: ¿Por qué tengo que firmar un mandato SEPA si ya di mis datos bancarios al comerciante?
answer: Firmar un mandato SEPA es un requisito legal que autoriza explícitamente al comerciante a realizar cargos en tu cuenta bancaria. Aunque hayas proporcionado tus datos bancarios, el mandato actúa como un consentimiento formal y seguro, garantizando que solo el comerciante autorizado pueda realizar adeudos y protegiendo tus derechos como cliente. Además, el mandato incluye información clave como el ICS (Identificador Acreedor SEPA) y el RUM (Referencia Única Mandato), que son esenciales para identificar correctamente las transacciones y evitar errores. Sin este documento firmado, el comerciante no puede iniciar adeudos directos en tu cuenta.

query: Can I still use my Qonto card after reporting it as lost?
answer: No, once you report your Qonto card as lost or stolen, it is permanently blocked and cannot be used again. This action is irreversible, so make sure to check your recent transactions for any signs of fraudulent activity before confirming the report. If you need a new card, you can order one for a fee of 6 € HT (unless it was lost during shipping).

query: Kann ich meine monatlichen Abos einfach so auf Qonto umstellen, oder muss ich das bei jedem Anbieter einzeln machen?
answer:
Mit der Funktion **"Move Your Recurring Payments"** können Sie Ihre monatlichen Abos und wiederkehrenden Zahlungen einfach von einem externen Bankkonto zu Qonto übertragen. Qonto analysiert Ihre Transaktionen und gibt Ihnen Empfehlungen, welche Zahlungen übertragen werden können. Allerdings müssen Sie die Zahlungsdetails bei den jeweiligen Anbietern aktualisieren, um Unterbrechungen zu vermeiden.

Nach der Übertragung können Sie Ihre wiederkehrenden Zahlungen direkt in Ihrem Qonto-Konto verwalten. Für eine nahtlose Umstellung empfehlen wir, Ihre Dienstleister über die Änderung der Zahlungsmethode zu informieren. Falls Sie Unterstützung benötigen, steht Ihnen das Qonto-Support-Team gerne zur Verfügung.

query: ¿Por qué no aparecen todas mis transacciones en los gráficos de "Entradas por" y "Salidas por"?
answer:
Los gráficos de "Entradas por" y "Salidas por" en tu panel de control muestran hasta 7 elementos significativos de la categoría que estás analizando. Si hay más de 7 elementos, verás 6 de ellos y un séptimo que agrupa todos los restantes. Para ver los detalles de este grupo adicional, puedes pasar el ratón por encima del segmento correspondiente en el gráfico.

Además, ten en cuenta que las transferencias internas no se incluyen en los gráficos cuando se selecciona *Todas las cuentas*. También es importante que tus transacciones estén correctamente categorizadas, ya sea con las categorías preestablecidas o con tus etiquetas personalizadas, para que aparezcan en los gráficos.

Si necesitas un análisis más detallado, puedes usar los filtros disponibles en la versión de escritorio para personalizar la visualización según diferentes criterios.

query: ¿Puedo borrar mi tarjeta Qonto de Apple Wallet desde la app de Qonto?
answer: Sí, puedes borrar tu tarjeta Qonto de Apple Wallet directamente desde la app de Qonto. Solo tienes que ir a la sección **Tarjetas** en los **Ajustes** de la aplicación, hacer clic en **Gestionar desde Apple Wallet** y seguir los pasos para eliminar la tarjeta.

query: Can I get a contract for my business without talking to a lawyer directly?
answer: Yes, you can get a contract for your business without speaking directly to a lawyer through LexDo.it. Their platform allows you to select the type of contract you need and answer guided questions to customize it. Once completed, you can download the tailored contract, including personalized clauses, all from the comfort of your home. This process is designed to be quick and efficient, taking just about 6 minutes. If you need additional support, expert lawyers are available for consultation, but it’s not required to complete the initial contract creation.

query: Kann ich auch ohne Beleg eine Überweisung über 30.000 € tätigen?
answer: Für Standard-SEPA-Überweisungen über 30.000 € ist ein Zahlungsnachweis als Anlage erforderlich. Ohne diesen Beleg kann die Überweisung nicht ausgeführt werden. Für Überweisungen unter diesem Betrag ist kein zusätzlicher Nachweis nötig, allerdings empfehlen wir aus buchhalterischen Gründen stets einen Beleg beizufügen.

query: What happens if I delete my card by mistake?
answer: If you delete your card by mistake, it will be permanently deactivated, and you will not be able to reactivate it. This action also stops any fees associated with the card. If you still need a card, you will have to order a new one. For physical cards, you can request a replacement through your Qonto interface. However, please note that it is currently not possible to order a new virtual card. If you need further assistance, you can refer to the relevant articles or contact support for guidance.

query: Why hasn't my Qonto card arrived yet when it's been more than a week since I ordered it?
answer:
The delivery time for your Qonto card depends on the type of card and your location. For One/Plus cards in France, delivery typically takes **2 to 5 business days**, while X cards in France and all cards in Europe usually arrive within **24 to 48 hours**. Deliveries to the DOM-TOM or outside Europe may take longer than 5 business days.

If it has been more than a week since you ordered your card, it may be due to delays with the postal service (La Poste or DHL) or customs processing for international deliveries. You can track your card approximately 24 hours after receiving the confirmation email "Your card is on the way."

If your card still hasn’t arrived within the expected timeframe, please contact our customer support through the chat in your Qonto app for further assistance. Depending on your plan, delivery fees may apply, but these can be reimbursed if the card is lost during shipping. For deliveries outside the European Union, customs fees may also apply.

query: Pourquoi est-ce que je dois obligatoirement associer mon téléphone à mon compte Qonto ?
answer:
L'association de votre téléphone à votre compte Qonto est obligatoire car elle permet d'activer l'authentification forte (SCA), une mesure de sécurité imposée par la Directive européenne sur les services de paiement (PSD2). Cette procédure renforce la protection de votre compte en validant vos opérations et en confirmant votre identité de manière sécurisée.

En tant qu'établissement financier, Qonto doit se conformer à ces normes européennes pour garantir la sécurité de vos transactions et de vos données. L'application Qonto ne collecte aucune information personnelle depuis votre téléphone, et le processus est entièrement sécurisé.

Si vous n'avez pas de smartphone, nous vous encourageons à en obtenir un, car il est devenu essentiel pour de nombreuses activités quotidiennes et pour assurer la sécurité continue de votre compte.

query: Why am I being blocked from opening a second account for my business?
answer: Qonto has received an order from Banca d'Italia to enhance its anti-money laundering measures in its Italian branch. As a result, the opening of new accounts for Italian companies is temporarily suspended, which includes creating multiple accounts for the same business. This measure is in place to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We appreciate your understanding and patience during this period.

query: ¿Puedo seguir usando mi tarjeta antigua después de pedir la nueva?
answer: Sí, puedes seguir usando tu tarjeta antigua durante 1 mes después de haber pedido la nueva. La tarjeta antigua se cancelará automáticamente el mismo día del mes siguiente a la actualización. Por ejemplo, si actualizas tu tarjeta el 15 de junio, la antigua dejará de funcionar el 15 de julio. Durante este período, ambas tarjetas estarán activas, y podrás usarlas normalmente para pagos en línea y físicos, incluso a través de Apple Pay o Google Pay. El PIN de la nueva tarjeta será el mismo que el de la antigua.

query: Can I use the online advertising card for my Instagram and TikTok ad campaigns at the same time?
answer: Yes, you can use the online advertising card for both your Instagram and TikTok ad campaigns simultaneously. The card is designed to work across multiple platforms, including Instagram Ads and TikTok Ads, allowing you to manage your marketing campaigns seamlessly. Simply add the card as a payment method on both platforms, and you can run your campaigns without interruption. The card supports flexible controls and high spending limits, making it easy to allocate funds as needed.

query: Kann ich ein Angebot noch ändern, nachdem ich es an meinen Kunden geschickt habe?
answer:
Ja, Sie können ein Angebot noch ändern, nachdem Sie es an Ihren Kunden geschickt haben, **solange es den Status "Zur Genehmigung anstehend" hat**. In diesem Fall können Sie das Angebot in der Liste auswählen, auf **"Angebot bearbeiten"** klicken und die gewünschten Änderungen vornehmen. Anschließend können Sie das aktualisierte Angebot speichern und erneut mit Ihrem Kunden teilen.

Sobald das Angebot jedoch als **"Genehmigt"** oder **"Storniert"** markiert wurde, ist eine Bearbeitung nicht mehr möglich. Ein genehmigtes Angebot hat Vertragscharakter, und Änderungen müssen dann direkt mit Ihrem Kunden abgestimmt werden.

query: ¿Qué pasa si bloqueo mi tarjeta temporalmente y luego la encuentro?
answer:
Si bloqueas tu tarjeta temporalmente y luego la encuentras, puedes desbloquearla fácilmente siguiendo estos pasos:

1. Ve a la sección de **Tarjetas** en tu cuenta Qonto.
2. Selecciona la tarjeta que deseas reactivar.
3. Haz clic en "**Desbloquear**" en la parte inferior de la pantalla.
4. Confirma tu elección seleccionando nuevamente "**Desbloquear**".

Una vez completados estos pasos, tu tarjeta estará lista para usarse nuevamente. Recuerda que el bloqueo temporal no afecta la suscripción vinculada a la tarjeta, solo suspende su uso hasta que decidas desbloquearla.

query: Can I approve or reject a transfer request directly from Slack?
answer: Yes, you can approve or reject transfer requests directly from Slack. The Slack Requests integration allows you to manage pending requests, including transfers, multi-transfers, virtual cards, and flash cards, all within your Slack workspace. Once you receive the daily notification at 8:00 AM, you can take action on these requests, and your decision will be automatically reflected in the Qonto app.

query: What happens if I don’t submit a proof of identity for a Virtual card?
answer: If you don’t submit a proof of identity for a Virtual card, it won’t be usable. The validation of your identity is required to activate and use the Virtual card. Without this step, the card request process cannot be completed, even if it has been approved by an Admin or Manager. Make sure to provide the necessary identification to ensure your Virtual card is functional.

query: ¿Puedo pedir un reembolso si no tengo el recibo en papel, solo una foto?
answer: Sí, puedes solicitar un reembolso adjuntando una foto del recibo desde la aplicación Qonto. Sin embargo, es importante que conserves el recibo original en papel por si la empresa te lo solicita en el futuro. Ten en cuenta que, en España, la imagen del recibo no tiene valor probatorio legal, a diferencia de otros países europeos. Asegúrate de que la foto esté clara y legible para que la información se pueda procesar correctamente.

query: Se attivo l'estensione "Gestione fatture ai clienti", posso personalizzare il layout delle mie fatture con il logo della mia azienda?
answer: Sì, con l'estensione "Gestione fatture ai clienti" puoi personalizzare il layout delle tue fatture, inclusa l'aggiunta del logo della tua azienda. Questa estensione ti permette di adattare i layout delle fatture raggruppando gli articoli in sezioni, personalizzando titoli e colonne dei documenti, e includendo allegati PDF, garantendo che le tue fatture rispecchino l'identità del tuo brand.

query: Can I use my card for online purchases before it arrives in the mail?
answer: Yes, you can use your card for online purchases before the physical card arrives. Once you order your card, you can access its digital version through the Qonto app or other digital wallets. The card details are available immediately, allowing you to make secure online payments using 3DS protocols. You can find your new card details directly in the app to start shopping right away.

query: Can I use a different email address to sign in with Google or Apple than the one I used to create my Qonto account?
answer: No, you must use the same email address associated with your Qonto account when signing in with Google or Apple. For example, if you registered with **jane.doe@gmail.com** and set a password, you must use that same email address to log in via Google or Apple. This ensures consistency and security for your account access. If you used Apple's "Hide My Email" feature during registration, continue using the forwarded email address provided by Apple.

query: ¿Por qué no puedo cobrar más dinero por domiciliación aunque mi negocio está creciendo?
answer:
El límite de cobro por domiciliación bancaria en Qonto se recalcula cada primer día del mes, basado en el volumen de facturación depositado en tu cuenta y en la evaluación de la actividad y el riesgo de la misma. Aunque tu negocio esté creciendo, es posible que los fondos ingresados en tu cuenta Qonto o la información disponible sobre tu actividad financiera aún no reflejen este crecimiento.

Para aumentar tu límite, puedes centralizar más ingresos en tu cuenta Qonto o conectar cuentas externas a través de la función de agregación de cuentas. Esto proporciona una visión más completa de tus finanzas, lo que puede influir positivamente en la evaluación de tu límite. Si ya tienes domiciliaciones activas, puedes vincular cuentas externas desde el panel de control en la sección de domiciliaciones entrantes. De lo contrario, puedes hacerlo desde la sección "Cuentas" en la aplicación web o móvil.

Cualquier ajuste en tu límite dependerá de los fondos disponibles y de la evaluación general de Qonto. Si necesitas más ayuda, contacta con nuestro equipo de soporte.

query: Can I change the order of the columns in my custom export template?
answer: Yes, you can change the order of the columns in your custom export template. When creating or editing your template, you can rearrange the columns using the drag-and-drop option. Simply click on a column, drag it to your desired position, and release it to reorder the columns as needed. This allows you to customize the layout of your exported data to better suit your business requirements.

query: ¿Puedo usar el datáfono de Square con mi cuenta Qonto si no cumplo los requisitos para el TPV de Qonto?
answer: Sí, puedes usar el datáfono de Square con tu cuenta Qonto incluso si no cumples los requisitos para el TPV de Qonto. Qonto ha establecido una colaboración con Square para ofrecer una solución alternativa a los clientes que no sean elegibles para el programa beta del TPV Qonto. Square proporciona terminales de pago físicos y virtuales, y como cliente de Qonto, puedes beneficiarte de condiciones especiales, como comisiones reducidas (1.25% + 0,05 € por transacción), un datáfono gratuito y hasta 2000 € en procesamiento de pagos sin coste. Para solicitarlo, solo tienes que abrir una cuenta en Square a través del enlace exclusivo para clientes de Qonto.

query: Comment puis-je régler un fournisseur qui me demande une Lettre de Change Relevé ?
answer: Qonto ne propose pas encore la possibilité d'émettre une Lettre de Change Relevé (LCR) ou traite, que ce soit sous forme physique ou virtuelle. Cependant, vous pouvez utiliser d'autres moyens de paiement sécurisés pour régler votre fournisseur, comme les prélèvements SEPA ou les virements via EBICS. Ces solutions sont simples à mettre en place et largement utilisées pour les transactions professionnelles. Pour plus d'informations, vous pouvez consulter nos guides dédiés : [Prélever vos clients](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/25012148623249-Comment-pr%C3%A9lever-de-l-argent-aupr%C3%A8s-de-mes-clients-via-EBICS) ou [Vous faire prélever](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947694535569-Comment-fonctionnent-les-pr%C3%A9l%C3%A8vements-SEPA).

query: Comment puis-je payer en magasin avec une carte virtuelle ?
answer: Pour payer en magasin avec une carte virtuelle, vous pouvez l'ajouter à **Apple Pay** ou **Google Pay** depuis la section "Cartes" de votre compte. Une fois configurée, vous pourrez utiliser votre smartphone ou votre montre connectée pour effectuer des paiements sans contact. Les cartes virtuelles ne permettent pas de retirer des espèces.

query: Warum bekomme ich keine Bestätigungs-SMS von Qonto, obwohl ich Empfang habe?
answer:
Wenn Sie keine Bestätigungs-SMS von Qonto erhalten, obwohl Sie Empfang haben, kann dies verschiedene Ursachen haben. Hier sind einige Schritte, die Sie überprüfen können:

1. **WhatsApp als Alternative**: Falls die SMS nicht ankommt, versuchen wir automatisch, die Bestätigung über WhatsApp zu senden, sofern die App auf Ihrem Telefon installiert und aktiv ist. Stellen Sie sicher, dass WhatsApp installiert ist und Sie dort die Nachricht erhalten.

2. **Dual-SIM-Telefon**: Falls Sie ein Dual-SIM-Telefon nutzen, entfernen Sie die SIM-Karte, die nicht mit Ihrem Qonto-Konto verknüpft ist, und versuchen Sie es erneut.

3. **Roaming deaktivieren**: Falls Roaming aktiviert ist, schalten Sie es aus und versuchen Sie es noch einmal.

4. **Uhrzeit und Datum prüfen**: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Uhrzeit und das Datum Ihres Telefons automatisch eingestellt sind.

5. **Telefon neu starten**: Ein einfacher Neustart Ihres Telefons kann manchmal das Problem beheben.

6. **Telefonanbieter kontaktieren**: Wenn Sie sich im Ausland befinden, könnte Ihr Telefonanbieter den SMS-Empfang eingeschränkt haben. Kontaktieren Sie in diesem Fall Ihren Anbieter, um sicherzustellen, dass der SMS-Empfang aktiviert ist.

Falls das Problem weiterhin besteht, wenden Sie sich bitte an unseren [Kundendienst](https://support-de.qonto.com/hc/de/articles/23949246697873-Ich-brauche-Hilfe-wie-erreiche-ich-den-Kundenservice), um weitere Unterstützung zu erhalten.

query: Kann ich auch einen handschriftlichen Beleg als Nachweis für meine Auslagenerstattung hochladen?
answer: Ja, Sie können einen handschriftlichen Beleg als Nachweis für Ihre Auslagenerstattung hochladen. Digitale Belege, einschließlich gescannter oder fotografierter handschriftlicher Belege, haben den gleichen rechtlichen Wert wie Papierbelege, sofern sie klar lesbar sind. Achten Sie darauf, dass alle relevanten Informationen wie Betrag, Datum und Art der Ausgabe gut erkennbar sind, damit die Bearbeitung reibungslos verläuft.

query: Was soll ich tun, wenn mich jemand anruft und behauptet, von Qonto zu sein, um meine Kontoinformationen zu überprüfen?
answer: Legen Sie sofort auf und teilen Sie keine persönlichen oder vertraulichen Informationen mit. Qonto wird Sie niemals anrufen, um Kontoinformationen zu überprüfen, Kartentransaktionen zu bestätigen oder Überweisungen durchzuführen. Solche Anrufe sind betrügerisch und dienen dazu, Ihre Daten zu stehlen.

query: Can I use custom dates in the description of my invoice items?
answer: Yes, you can use custom dates in the description of your invoice items. When setting up or editing a recurring invoice, simply include the custom date placeholders (such as `%month%`, `%lastmonth%`, `%nextmonth%`, or `%year%`) in the item title or details under the **Products and services** section. These placeholders will automatically update to the correct date when the invoice is issued, ensuring accuracy without manual adjustments. For example, if you enter “Service fee for %month% %year%” as the description, it will display the current month and year when the invoice is generated.

query: Warum bekomme ich eine SMS mit einem Code, wenn ich mich bei Qonto anmelden will?
answer: Die SMS mit einem Code erhalten Sie, weil die Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung (2FA) für Ihr Qonto-Konto aktiviert ist. Diese Sicherheitsfunktion sendet Ihnen einen temporären 6-stelligen Verifizierungscode per SMS, den Sie zusätzlich zu Ihrem Passwort eingeben müssen, um Ihre Identität zu bestätigen. Dies schützt Ihr Konto vor unbefugtem Zugriff, indem eine zweite Sicherheitsebene hinzugefügt wird. Der Code ist nur 1 Minute gültig, sodass Sie ihn zeitnah eingeben müssen. Diese Methode ist eine Voraussetzung für die starke Authentifizierung, die bei Qonto obligatorisch ist.

query: Quel format de fichier dois-je utiliser pour faire un virement groupé avec Qonto ?
answer:
Pour effectuer un virement groupé avec Qonto, vous devez utiliser un fichier au format **.XML** conforme à la norme **ISO 20022**. Ce format vous permet d'initier jusqu'à 400 virements simultanément.

Vous pouvez générer ce fichier à partir de la plupart des solutions de gestion de paie (comme PayFit) ou des outils de comptabilité. Une fois le fichier créé, vous pouvez le télécharger directement dans l'application Qonto depuis l'onglet **Compte Pro** en sélectionnant l'option **Virement groupé en Euros** et en choisissant le format **.XML**.

Si vous avez besoin d'un modèle, vous pouvez télécharger un exemple de fichier .XML à la fin de l'article dans la documentation fournie.

query: What kinds of documents can I use to prove why I'm sending money abroad in a different currency?
answer:
For international transfers in foreign currency, you can use invoices or contracts to justify the transaction. Commonly accepted documents include supplier invoices, signed sales agreements, payslips, proof of payments, or rental contracts.

To ensure the document is valid:
- The invoice must be issued to your company, with your company as the recipient of the services or goods.
- Contracts must show your company’s full official name, legal information, and ideally the registration number.
- The recipient’s name and bank details in the document must match the beneficiary details in Qonto.
- Invoices should clearly state the value and purpose of the transaction.
- Contracts must be signed by both parties.
- For individual entrepreneurs, a contract justifying the transaction is required.
- Intra-community transfers must include the VAT number on the invoice.

Note that handwritten invoices or blurry images are not accepted. If the document is invalid, the transfer may be rejected, and the funds could take up to 72 working hours to return to your account.

query: What happens if I ignore the request for documents from Qonto?
answer: If you ignore the request for documents from Qonto, your account may be temporarily suspended or restricted until you provide the required information. Without a response and after a certain period, this could lead to the closure of your account, as outlined in article 9.2 of your Qonto contract. Additionally, pending transactions may be rejected until the necessary validation is completed. It's important to respond promptly to avoid disruptions to your account.

query: Posso usare la carta digitale per pagare in un negozio fisico prima che arrivi quella fisica?
answer: Sì, puoi utilizzare la carta digitale per pagare in un negozio fisico prima di ricevere quella fisica. Puoi aggiungere la tua carta digitale a Apple Pay o Google Pay tramite l'app Qonto e iniziare a effettuare pagamenti mobili in negozio in pochi clic.

query: Can I use my virtual card to pay for something in a physical store?
answer: Yes, you can use your virtual card to pay in a physical store by adding it to Apple Pay or Google Pay. This allows you to make contactless payments directly from your mobile device. However, you cannot withdraw cash with a virtual card.

query: Can I submit mileage expenses for multiple trips at once?
answer: No, it is currently not possible to submit mileage reimbursement requests in bulk. Each trip must be submitted individually with the necessary details such as distance traveled, purpose, and your personal IBAN. You can do this by going to the **Team expenses** section and clicking **Submit reimbursement > Mileage reimbursement**.

query: Posso inviare un bonifico in dollari americani a un amico in Italia?
answer: Sì, puoi inviare un bonifico in dollari americani (USD) a un amico in Italia. USD è una delle valute che puoi inviare a tutti i paesi supportati da Qonto, compresa l'Italia. Assicurati di utilizzare il servizio di bonifici internazionali tramite SWIFT o il nostro partner Wise per completare l'operazione.

query: ¿Puedo cancelar una domiciliación SEPA Core si ya no quiero que me cobren?
answer:
Sí, puedes cancelar una domiciliación SEPA Core en cualquier momento. Para hacerlo, sigue estos pasos:

1. Accede a tu aplicación web de Qonto.
2. Ve a la sección **Cuenta de la empresa** y luego a **Domiciliaciones salientes**.
3. Selecciona la domiciliación que deseas cancelar y elige la opción para suspenderla o cancelarla.

Una vez cancelada, el acreedor ya no podrá realizar cargos en tu cuenta. Si en el futuro decides reactivarla, también podrás hacerlo desde la misma sección.

query: Can I use a virtual card to pay in a physical store?
answer: Yes, you can use a virtual card to pay in a physical store by adding it to **Apple Pay or Google Pay**. Simply follow the instructions to link your virtual card to your preferred mobile payment service, and you’ll be able to make contactless payments in-store. However, virtual cards cannot be used to withdraw cash.

query: Cosa devo fare se ho caricato una fattura ma non riesco a trovare l'opzione per richiedere il pagamento?
answer:
Se hai caricato una fattura ma non riesci a trovare l'opzione per richiedere il pagamento, assicurati di aver compilato tutti i campi obbligatori della fattura: nome del fornitore, data di scadenza e importo. Una volta inseriti questi dati, l'opzione **Richiesta di bonifico** dovrebbe apparire.

Se non hai l'autorizzazione per effettuare bonifici o hai raggiunto il limite di bonifici, puoi comunque richiedere il pagamento seguendo questi passaggi:
1. Apri la fattura dalla sezione **Importate**.
2. Compila i campi mancanti.
3. Clicca su **Richiesta di bonifico**.

Se l'opzione non è visibile, verifica di avere i permessi necessari per gestire le fatture dei fornitori. In caso contrario, contatta l'**Admin** o il **Titolare del conto** per richiedere l'autorizzazione. Ricorda che al momento la richiesta di pagamento è disponibile solo per fatture in euro.

query: How do I get proof that I made a payment from my Qonto account?
answer:
To obtain proof of payment from your Qonto account, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your Qonto account via the web or mobile app.
2. Navigate to the **Transfers** tab.
3. Select the relevant transaction for which you need proof.
4. Download the proof of transfer directly from the transaction details.

If you need an official certificate, such as a "Proof of Payment" or "Certificate of Funds Provenance," you can request it by contacting Qonto Support through the chat bubble in your app (available on both mobile and web). The document will be sent to the account holder, who can then share it with you if necessary.

query: Can a manager see the company's account balance and transaction history?
answer:
Yes, a manager can see the company's account balance and transaction history, but this depends on their assigned permissions and scope level.

For plans chosen before October 1, 2024, a manager with **"whole company"** scope can view account balances, IBAN, transaction history, and export statements. If their scope is limited to a **team level**, their access will be restricted to the transactions and balances of their assigned team.

For plans chosen after October 1, 2024, **Basic Managers** cannot view account balances or IBAN, while **Advanced Managers** with "whole company" scope can. Advanced Managers can also access transaction history and download statements.

Admins or Account Holders define these permissions during the invitation process or can modify them later in the **User Access** section.

query: Se la mia azienda ha più debiti a breve termine rispetto ai soldi liquidi disponibili, cosa significa per la sua salute finanziaria?
answer: Se la tua azienda ha più debiti a breve termine rispetto alle attività liquide disponibili, significa che il margine di tesoreria è negativo. In questa situazione, l'azienda non dispone di risorse sufficienti per coprire le spese immediate e potrebbe avere bisogno di un sostegno finanziario esterno per continuare a operare. Questo scenario indica una potenziale difficoltà nel far fronte agli obblighi di pagamento a breve termine, come stipendi, fornitori o tasse, e richiede un'attenta gestione della liquidità per evitare squilibri finanziari.

query: Puis-je créer une SAS avec Qonto si mon associé est une entreprise basée au Canada ?
answer: Non, vous ne pouvez pas créer une SAS avec Qonto si votre associé est une entreprise basée au Canada. Qonto n'accepte que les associés personnes morales immatriculées en France, en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en Belgique, au Luxembourg, aux Pays-Bas, en Suisse ou au Royaume-Uni. Pour plus de détails sur les conditions d'éligibilité, vous pouvez consulter notre FAQ ou nous contacter pour des solutions alternatives.

query: What happens if I accidentally delete a folder in Dropbox that was created by the Qonto integration?
answer:
If you accidentally delete a folder in Dropbox that was created by the Qonto integration, the integration will no longer function properly.

For the **Qonto to Dropbox** integration:
- If you delete a file, it will be automatically re-imported into your Dropbox account.
- If you delete a folder, the receipts it contained will be removed from Dropbox. New receipts will still be exported as usual, but to retrieve the deleted files, you will need to reconfigure the integration.

For the **Dropbox to Qonto** integration:
- Deleting a file or folder will disrupt the integration. You will need to uninstall and reinstall the integration to restore its functionality. This can be done by clicking **Connected** in the top right of the Connect Dropbox page in the Qonto web app, then selecting **Disconnect Dropbox → Qonto** twice.

Note that this action will not affect supplier invoices that have already been matched with your Qonto transactions.

query: What should I do if the chat support doesn't solve my issue with Qonto?
answer:
If the chat support doesn't resolve your issue, you can escalate it by filing a formal claim. You have two options to do this:

1. **Online:** Send an email to [claims@qonto.com](mailto:claims@qonto.com).
2. **By post:** Send a registered letter with acknowledgment of receipt to: Qonto, Service Réclamations, 18 Rue de Navarin, 75009 Paris.

Once your claim is received, we will acknowledge it within 24 business hours. Your complaint will be processed by the relevant department, and you will receive a response within 15 working days, or up to 35 working days in exceptional cases, with prior notification.

We’re here to ensure your concern is addressed thoroughly.

query: Why do the VAT amounts on my invoice sometimes differ by a few cents compared to what I calculated?
answer:
The slight differences in VAT amounts on your invoice are due to rounding practices required by accounting standards. When calculating VAT, amounts can result in fractions of a cent (e.g., 0.001 or 0.0001), which must be rounded to the nearest tenth of a cent for compliance.

Qonto uses the "sum of the roundings" method, where VAT is rounded for each individual product line before summing them up. This ensures greater precision and transparency, especially for invoices with multiple items. While this may cause minor variations compared to calculating VAT on the total amount, it aligns with regulatory guidelines and provides clearer line-item details.

For example, if you calculate VAT on the total invoice amount, you might get a slightly different result than Qonto’s method, which rounds each line separately. This is a standard practice to ensure accuracy and compliance.

query: Come faccio a ricevere i pagamenti con carta direttamente sul mio conto Qonto?
answer:
Per ricevere i pagamenti con carta direttamente sul tuo conto Qonto, puoi utilizzare un lettore di carte (POS) Nexi, disponibile esclusivamente per i clienti italiani. Grazie alla collaborazione tra Qonto e Nexi, puoi scegliere tra diversi terminali con connessione Bluetooth, dati mobili o Wi-Fi.

Con il POS Nexi, accetti tutte le carte, compresi PagoBANCOMAT® (anche in modalità contactless) e i buoni pasto dei principali emittenti. Gli accrediti vengono ricevuti entro il giorno lavorativo successivo direttamente sul tuo conto Qonto. Inoltre, puoi incassare ovunque grazie alla funzione Pay-by-Link.

Per scoprire i costi e le condizioni riservate ai clienti Qonto, visita la [pagina dedicata](https://qonto.com/it/payment-methods/mobile-pos). È un servizio flessibile, sicuro e senza costi nascosti, perfettamente integrato con la filosofia Qonto.

query: What should I do if I didn’t receive the email to set my PIN code for my Qonto card?
answer: If you didn’t receive the email to set your PIN code for your Qonto card, first check your spam or junk folder to ensure the email wasn’t filtered incorrectly. If you still can’t find it, you can also set your PIN code directly from your personal space in the Qonto app or web platform. Make sure your proof of identity has been approved, as this is required before setting your PIN code. If you continue to experience issues, contact Qonto support for further assistance.

query: How can I download multiple Qonto invoices at once?
answer:
To download multiple Qonto invoices at once, follow these steps:

1. Go to the **Settings** section in your Qonto web interface (bottom left).
2. Select **Billing and Invoices**.
3. Click on the **Qonto Invoices** section.
4. Choose the invoices you want to download by selecting them in bulk.
5. A compressed file (.zip) containing all the selected invoices in PDF will be automatically sent to your email address.

This allows you to easily share the invoices with your accountant or anyone else if needed.

query: Pourquoi je ne vois pas l'option pour annuler un virement que je viens de faire ?
answer:
Il existe plusieurs raisons pour lesquelles vous ne voyez pas l'option d'annulation d'un virement :

1. **Virement intra-Qonto** : Si vous avez effectué un virement vers un autre compte Qonto, celui-ci est instantané et ne peut pas être annulé. Dans ce cas, contactez le bénéficiaire pour un éventuel remboursement ou contactez notre support.

2. **Virement déjà exécuté** : Si le virement a déjà été traité et que les fonds ont été transférés vers le compte du bénéficiaire, l'annulation n'est plus possible. Vous devrez contacter le bénéficiaire pour obtenir un remboursement.

3. **Virement SWIFT** : Les virements SWIFT ne peuvent pas être annulés une fois initiés.

Pour vérifier le statut de votre virement et comprendre pourquoi l'annulation n'est pas disponible, consultez les différents statuts des virements [ici](https://support-fr.qonto.com/hc/fr/articles/23947687064081-Quels-sont-les-diff%C3%A9rents-statuts-d-un-virement-sortant).

query: What documents do I need to provide to open a Qonto account for my company before it's officially registered?
answer: To open a Qonto account for your company before it's officially registered, you need to provide a copy of the **act of incorporation (atto costitutivo)** and the **bylaws of the company**. These documents allow Qonto to verify your company's details and activate your business account within 48 hours. Once opened, you’ll have 30 days to submit your proof of registration (*visura camerale*).

query: Can I deposit cash into my Qonto account at an ATM?
answer: No, you cannot deposit cash into your Qonto account at an ATM. For security reasons, Qonto does not process cash deposits. While you can withdraw money from ATMs using your Qonto card, depositing cash is not supported. As a payment institution, Qonto also does not offer a cash float service.

query: What does it mean if a company's net treasury is negative?
answer: If a company's net treasury is negative, it means the available funds are insufficient to cover its short-term debt. In this situation, the company is "in the red" or in deficit, indicating it lacks the financial resources needed to operate without external support. The company will require additional financing, such as loans or investments, to meet its obligations and continue its activities. This scenario highlights financial vulnerability and the need for corrective measures to restore balance.

query: Do I need to manually update all my direct debits and card payments when switching to Qonto?
answer:
No, you don’t need to manually update all your direct debits and card payments when switching to Qonto. The account transfer service uses a secure aggregation tool (Bridge by Bankin') to scan your transactions from the past 12 months and identify all incoming and outgoing payments that require action, such as direct debit mandates or card payments.

A dedicated Qonto agent will then create a customised transfer plan for you, outlining the specific changes you need to make. You’ll have access to a dashboard to track your progress, and your agent will guide you through each step, confirming when actions are complete. This ensures a smooth transition without the need for manual updates on your own.

query: Can I send payment reminders to multiple email addresses for the same client?
answer: Yes, you can send payment reminders to multiple email addresses for the same client. When setting up an automated payment reminder, you can add multiple recipient email addresses by separating them with commas. This ensures that all relevant contacts receive the reminders for unpaid invoices.

query: What happens if I reject a transfer request?
answer: If you reject a transfer request, the request will be declined, and the transaction will not be processed. You will have the option to add a comment explaining the reason for the rejection, which can provide clarity to the team member who initiated the request. The rejected request will no longer appear in the **Pending** tab and will be moved to the appropriate section for declined requests. This ensures that managers maintain control over company finances while keeping communication transparent.

query: What documents do I need if my company is still being set up and not fully registered yet?
answer:
If your company is still in formation and not fully registered yet, you will need to provide the notarized formation documents during registration. These documents must be stamped and signed or sealed and signed, and include:

1. **Registration in the commercial register**
2. **Certificate of incorporation**
3. **List of shareholders**

These documents are necessary to verify the legal integrity and transparency of your company during the formation process. If one of your shareholders is a legal entity, additional documents such as the certificate of incorporation of the legal entity, commercial register extract, list of shareholders, and transparency register extract (if applicable) will also be required.

query: Can a manager with limited transfer permissions still handle supplier invoices if they exceed their limit?
answer: Yes, a manager with limited transfer permissions can still handle supplier invoices even if the amount exceeds their transfer limit. In such cases, the manager can request payment for the invoice directly within the Supplier Invoices section. This request will then be sent for approval to an Owner, Admin, or another authorized Manager with sufficient permissions or higher transfer limits. The approver can review and process the payment either from the Supplier Invoices section or the Requests section. This ensures that invoices can still be managed efficiently while maintaining control over higher-value transactions.

query: How do I see how much money I have available right now in my Qonto account?
answer: To see how much money you have available right now in your Qonto account, go to the **Cash flow management** section in your web application and click on **Dashboard**. On the mobile app, tap on the **More** section at the bottom right and then select **Dashboard**. Your available balance, which shows the current cash in your account, will be displayed prominently on the dashboard. This gives you a real-time view of your funds.

query: What happens if my client sends a SWIFT transfer with the BEN option instead of OUR?
answer:
If your client sends a SWIFT transfer with the **BEN (beneficiary) option**, you, as the recipient, will be responsible for paying all the fixed fees associated with the transfer. These fees, which typically range from €10 to €50, will be deducted directly from the transfer amount before it reaches your Qonto account.

In contrast, if the **OUR option** is selected, the sender covers all the fees, ensuring you receive the full amount. To avoid unexpected deductions, we recommend asking your client or partner to use the **OUR option** when sending the transfer. You may also want to specify this preference in your business contracts to ensure clarity.

query: ¿Puedo enviar una transferencia internacional sin subir ningún documento si es por menos de 30.000 euros?
answer: Sí, puedes realizar una transferencia internacional sin subir ningún documento si el monto es inferior a 30.000 euros. Solo es necesario justificar la transacción con un documento cuando la transferencia en moneda extranjera supera ese importe.

query: Can I change the spending limit of a card before approving it?
answer: No, you cannot change the spending limit of a card before approving it. You can only edit the card settings, such as the amount, days of use, or authorized spending categories, after the card request has been approved. Once approved, you can adjust these details as needed.

query: Se uso la carta virtuale per pagare online, posso superare il limite di 20.000€ al mese?
answer: No, con una carta virtuale Qonto non è possibile superare il limite di 20.000€ al mese per i pagamenti online o in negozio tramite Apple Pay o Google Pay. Questo limite è fisso e non può essere modificato. Se hai bisogno di un limite più elevato, potresti valutare l'upgrade a una carta di livello superiore, come la carta Plus o X, che offrono limiti di pagamento più alti.

query: Will I still be able to use my card for online purchases during the maintenance?
answer: Yes, you will still be able to use your card for online purchases during the maintenance. Your cards will continue to work normally for payments, including online transactions. Only card management features, such as modifying settings or viewing sensitive information like PINs, will be temporarily unavailable.

query: What should I do if someone calls me pretending to be from Qonto and asks me to transfer money to secure my account?
answer:
If someone calls you pretending to be from Qonto and asks you to transfer money to secure your account, it is a scam. Qonto will never ask you to make a transfer or share confidential information such as your password, login credentials, or payment card number. Here’s what you should do:

1. **Hang up immediately** – Do not engage further with the caller.
2. **Do not perform any operations** – Never approve transfers, change passwords, or share sensitive details.
3. **Contact Qonto directly** – Use the in-app chat from your Qonto account to verify the call’s legitimacy.
4. **Report the incident** – Inform Qonto through the official chat or support channels so we can take appropriate action.

Fraudsters often use spoofing to impersonate Qonto’s phone number, creating a false sense of urgency. Always verify requests through official Qonto channels.
